verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh ih gufaa veechaare ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, search this cave.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam nira(n)jan a(n)tar vasai muraare ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the self.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavai sabadh suhaae mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and decorate yourself with the Shabad. Meeting with your Beloved, you shall find peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jam jaagaatee dhoojai bhai kar laae ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death imposes his tax on those who are attached to duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naavahu bhoole dhei sajaae ||
verses.translation: He inflicts punishment on those who forget the Name.

verses.original: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਰਤੀਅਹੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲ ਕਢਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ghaRee muhat kaa lekhaa levai rateeahu maasaa tol kaddaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: They are called to account for each instant and each moment. Every grain, every particle, is weighed and counted. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥ ਦੂਜੈ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai pir chete naahee || dhoojai muThee rovai dhaahee ||
verses.translation: One who does not remember her Husband Lord in this world is being cheated by duality; she shall weep bitterly in the end.

verses.original: ਖਰੀ ਕੁਆਲਿਓ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kharee kuaalio kuroop kulakhanee supanai pir nahee paavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: She is from an evil family; she is ugly and vile. Even in her dreams, she does not meet her Husband Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai pir ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: She who enshrines her Husband Lord in her mind in this world

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorai gur hadhoor dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: His Presence is revealed to her by the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kaaman pir raakhiaa ka(n)Th lai sabadhe pir raavai sej suhaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: That soul-bride keeps her Husband Lord clasped tightly to her heart, and through the Word of the Shabad, she enjoys her Husband Lord upon His Beautiful Bed. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਦਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhevai sadh bulaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself sends out the call, and He summons us to His Presence.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa naau ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: He enshrines His Name within our minds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੮॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee anadhin sadhaa gun gaavaniaa ||8||28||29||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who receives the greatness of the Naam night and day, constantly sings His Glorious Praises. ||8||28||29||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਹੈ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: uootam janam suthaan hai vaasaa ||
verses.translation: Sublime is their birth, and the place where they dwell.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh ghar maeh udhaasaa ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru remain detached in the home of their own being.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g raheh sadhaa ra(n)g raate har ras man tirapataavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: They abide in the Lord's Love, and constantly imbued with His Love, their minds are satisfied and fulfilled with the Lord's Essence. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree paR bujh ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who read of the Lord, who understand and enshrine Him within their minds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paReh har naam salaaheh dhar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs read and praise the Lord's Name; they are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: alakh abheau har rahiaa samaae ||
verses.translation: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਿਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aupai na kitee paiaa jaae ||
verses.translation: He cannot be obtained by any effort.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare taa satigur bheTai nadharee mel milaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: If the Lord grants His Grace, then we come to meet the True Guru. By His Kindness, we are united in His Union. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai paRai nahee boojhai ||
verses.translation: One who reads, while attached to duality, does not understand.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: tirabidh maiaa kaaran loojhai ||
verses.translation: He yearns for the three-phased Maya.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tirabidh ba(n)dhan tooTeh gur sabadhee gur sabadhee mukat karaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: The bonds of the three-phased Maya are broken by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Through the Guru's Shabad, liberation is achieved. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man cha(n)chal vas na aavai ||
verses.translation: This unstable mind cannot be held steady.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa laagai dheh dhis dhaavai ||
verses.translation: Attached to duality, it wanders in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bikh kaa keeRaa bikh meh raataa bikh hee maeh pachaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: It is a poisonous worm, drenched with poison, and in poison it rots away. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau kare tai aap janaae ||
verses.translation: Practicing egotism and selfishness, they try to impress others by showing off.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bahu karam karai kichh thai na paae ||
verses.translation: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they gain no acceptance.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hovai bakhase sabadh suhaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: Without You, Lord, nothing happens at all. You forgive those who are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad. ||5||

verses.original: ਉਪਜੈ ਪਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aupajai pachai har boojhai naahee ||
verses.translation: They are born, and they die, but they do not understand the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin dhoojai bhai firaahee ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they wander, in love with duality.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: manmukh janam giaa hai birathaa a(n)t giaa pachhutaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: The lives of the self-willed manmukhs are useless; in the end, they die, regretting and repenting. ||6||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pir paradhes sigaar banaae ||
verses.translation: The Husband is away, and the wife is getting dressed up.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁ ਐਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dh aaise karam kamaae ||
verses.translation: This is what the blind, self-willed manmukhs are doing.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: halat na sobhaa palat na ddoiee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: They are not honored in this world, and they shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. They are wasting their lives in vain. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam kinai viralai jaataa ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who know the Name of the Lord!

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kai sabadh pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, the Lord is realized.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kare dhin raatee sahaje hee sukh paavaniaa ||8||
verses.translation: Night and day, they perform the Lord's devotional service; day and night, they find intuitive peace. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh varatai eko soiee ||
verses.translation: That One Lord is pervading in all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh viralaa boojhai koiee ||
verses.translation: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੯॥੨੯॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate jan soheh kar kirapaa aap milaavaniaa ||9||29||30||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are beautiful. Granting His Grace, God unites them with Himself. ||9||29||30||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh paReh pa(n)ddit kahaaveh ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs read and recite; they are called Pandits-spiritual scholars.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai mahaa dhukh paaveh ||
verses.translation: But they are in love with duality, and they suffer in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa maate kichh soojhai naahee fir fir joonee aavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with vice, they understand nothing at all. They are reincarnated, over and over again. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree haumai maar milaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who subdue their ego, and unite with the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te har man vasiaa har ras sahaj peeaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They serve the Guru, and the Lord dwells within their minds; they intuitively drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vedh paReh har ras nahee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Pandits read the Vedas, but they do not obtain the Lord's essence.

verses.original: ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaadh vakhaaneh mohe maiaa ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with Maya, they argue and debate.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agiaanamatee sadhaa a(n)dhiaaraa gurmukh boojh har gaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: The foolish intellectuals are forever in spiritual darkness. The Gurmukhs understand, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਕਥੋ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: akatho katheeaai sabadh suhaavai ||
verses.translation: The Indescribable is described only through the beauteous Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee man sacho bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Truth becomes pleasing to the mind.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sacho sach raveh dhin raatee ih man sach ra(n)gaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Those who speak of the truest of the true, day and night-their minds are imbued with the Truth. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo sach rate tin sacho bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth, love the Truth.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhei na pachhotaavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself bestows this gift; He shall not take it back.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sadhaa sach jaataa mil sache sukh paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True Lord is known forever; meeting the True One, peace is found. ||4||

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kusat tinaa mail na laagai || gur parasaadhee anadhin jaagai ||
verses.translation: The filth of fraud and falsehood does not stick to those who, by Guru's Grace, remain awake and aware, night and day.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: niramal naam vasai ghaT bheetar jotee jot milaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; their light merges into the Light. ||5||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun paReh har tat na jaaneh ||
verses.translation: They read about the three qualities, but they do not know the essential reality of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: moolahu bhule gur sabadh na pachhaaneh ||
verses.translation: They forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all, and they do not recognize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: moh biaape kichh soojhai naahee gur sabadhee har paavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: They are engrossed in emotional attachment; they do not understand anything at all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. ||6||

verses.original: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vedh pukaarai tirabidh maiaa ||
verses.translation: The Vedas proclaim that Maya is of three qualities.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh na boojheh dhoojai bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, do not understand.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: trai gun paReh har ek na jaaneh bin boojhe dhukh paavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: They read of the three qualities, but they do not know the One Lord. Without understanding, they obtain only pain and suffering. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaavai taa aap milaae ||
verses.translation: When it pleases the Lord, He unites us with Himself.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee sahasaa dhookh chukaae ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, skepticism and suffering are dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੦॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naavai kee sachee vaddiaaiee naamo ma(n)n sukh paavaniaa ||8||30||31||
verses.translation: O Nanak, True is the Greatness of the Name. Believing in the Name, peace is obtained. ||8||30||31||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: niragun saragun aape soiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is Unmanifest and Unrelated; He is Manifest and Related as well.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tat pachhaanai so pa(n)ddit hoiee ||
verses.translation: Those who recognize this essential reality are the true Pandits, the spiritual scholars.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap tarai sagale kul taarai har naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well, when they enshrine the Lord's Name in the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har ras chakh saadh paavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who taste the essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ras chaakheh se jan niramal niramal naam dhiaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who taste this essence of the Lord are the pure, immaculate beings. They meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਨਿਹਕਰਮੀ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: so nihakaramee jo sabadh beechaare ||
verses.translation: Those who reflect upon the Shabad are beyond karma.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar tat giaan haumai maare ||
verses.translation: They subdue their ego, and find the essence of wisdom, deep within their being.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath nau nidh paae trai gun meT samaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: They obtain the nine treasures of the wealth of the Naam. Rising above the three qualities, they merge into the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਹਕਰਮੀ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai karai nihakaramee na hovai ||
verses.translation: Those who act in ego do not go beyond karma.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee haumai khovai ||
verses.translation: It is only by Guru's Grace that one is rid of ego.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar bibek sadhaa aap veechaare gur sabadhee gun gaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Those who have discriminating minds, continually examine their own selves. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they sing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਈ ॥ ਸੰਤ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har sar saagar niramal soiee || sa(n)t chugeh nit gurmukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the most pure and sublime Ocean. The Saintly Gurmukhs continually peck at the Naam, like swans pecking at pearls in the ocean.

verses.original: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eisanaan kareh sadhaa dhin raatee haumai mail chukaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: They bathe in it continually, day and night, and the filth of ego is washed away. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: niramal ha(n)saa prem piaar || har sar vasai haumai maar ||
verses.translation: The pure swans, with love and affection, dwell in the Ocean of the Lord, and subdue their ego.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ahinis preet sabadh saachai har sar vaasaa paavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: Day and night, they are in love with the True Word of the Shabad. They obtain their home in the Ocean of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh sadhaa bag mailaa haumai mal laiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs shall always be filthy cranes, smeared with the filth of ego.

verses.original: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਪਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eisanaan karai par mail na jaiee ||
verses.translation: They may bathe, but their filth is not removed.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai gur sabadh beechaarai haumai mail chukaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: One who dies while yet alive, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is rid of this filth of ego. ||6||

verses.original: ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ratan padhaarath ghar te paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Priceless Jewel is found, in the home of one's own being,

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorai satigur sabadh sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: when one listens to the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh miTiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ghaT chaanan aap pachhaananiaa ||7||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled; I have come to recognize the Divine Light within my own heart. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae tai aape vekhai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself creates, and He Himself beholds.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevai so jan lekhai ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, one becomes acceptable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੧॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasai ghaT a(n)tar gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||8||31||32||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the heart; by Guru's Grace, it is obtained. ||8||31||32||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh jagat sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: The whole world is engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun dheeseh mohe maiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are controlled by the three qualities are attached to Maya.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ko viralaa boojhai chauthai padh liv laavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, a few come to understand; they center their consciousness in the fourth state. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree maiaa moh sabadh jalaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who burn away their emotional attachment to Maya, through the Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh jalaae so har siau chit laae har dhar mahalee sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who burn away this attachment to Maya, and focus their consciousness on the Lord are honored in the True Court, and the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhevee dhevaa mool hai maiaa ||
verses.translation: The source, the root, of the gods and goddesses is Maya.

verses.original: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)mirat saasat ji(n)n upaiaa ||
verses.translation: For them, the Simritees and the Shaastras were composed.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh pasariaa sa(n)saare aai jai dhukh paavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Sexual desire and anger are diffused throughout the universe. Coming and going, people suffer in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich giaan ratan ik paiaa ||
verses.translation: The jewel of spiritual wisdom was placed within the universe.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, it is enshrined within the mind.

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jat sat sa(n)jam sach kamaavai gur poorai naam dhiaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Celibacy, chastity, self-discipline and the practice of truthfulness are obtained from the Perfect Guru, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai dhan bharam bhulaanee ||
verses.translation: In this world of her parents' home, the soul-bride has been deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai laagee fir pachhotaanee ||
verses.translation: Attached to duality, she later comes to regret it.

verses.original: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: halat palat dhovai gavaae supanai sukh na paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: She forfeits both this world and the next, and even in her dreams, she does not find peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai dhan ka(n)t samaale ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride who remembers her Husband Lord in this world,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee vekhai naale ||
verses.translation: by Guru's Grace, sees Him close at hand.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pir kai sahaj rahai ra(n)g raatee sabadh si(n)gaar banaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: She remains intuitively attuned to the Love of her Beloved; she makes the Word of His Shabad her decoration. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam jinaa satigur paiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who find the True Guru;

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa bhaau gur sabadh jalaiaa ||
verses.translation: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they burn their love of duality.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eko rav rahiaa ghaT a(n)tar mil satasa(n)gat har gun gaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: The One Lord is permeating and pervading deep within the heart. Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur na seve so kaahe aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru-why did they even come into this world?

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag jeevan birathaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Cursed are their lives; they have uselessly wasted this human life.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: manmukh naam chit na aavai bin naavai bahu dhukh paavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam. Without the Naam, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin sisaT saajee soiee jaanai ||
verses.translation: The One who created the Universe, He alone knows it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape melai sabadh pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: He unites with Himself those who realize the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੨॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam miliaa tin jan kau jin dhur masatak lekh likhaavaniaa ||8||1||32||33||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone receive the Naam, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is recorded. ||8||1||32||33||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh apara(n)par aape ||
verses.translation: The Primal Being is Himself remote and beyond.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape thaape thaap uthaape ||
verses.translation: He Himself establishes, and having established, He disestablishes.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh meh varatai eko soiee gurmukh sobhaa paavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading in all; those who become Gurmukh are honored. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree nira(n)kaaree naam dhiaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis roop na rekhiaa ghaT ghaT dhekhiaa gurmukh alakh lakhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has no form or shape; He is seen within each and every heart. The Gurmukh comes to know the unknowable. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: too dhiaal kirapaal prabh soiee ||
verses.translation: You are God, Kind and Merciful.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bin dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh kare naam dhevai naame naam samaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: When the Guru showers His Grace upon us, He blesses us with the Naam; through the Naam, we merge in the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape sachaa sirajanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the True Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagatee bhare tere bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your treasures are overflowing with devotional worship.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam milai man bheejai sahaj samaadh lagaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. Their minds are enraptured, and they easily and intuitively enter into Samaadhi. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin gun gaavaa prabh tere ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I sing Your Glorious Praises, God.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tudh saalaahee preetam mere ||
verses.translation: I praise You, O my Beloved.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tudh bin avar na koiee jaachaa gur parasaadhee too(n) paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other for me to seek out. It is only by Guru's Grace that You are found. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar mit nahee paiee ||
verses.translation: The limits of the Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord cannot be found.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: apanee kirapaa kareh too(n) laih milaiee ||
verses.translation: Bestowing Your Mercy, You merge us into Yourself.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: poore gur kai sabadh dhiaaieeaai sabadh sev sukh paavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Lord. Serving the Shabad, peace is found. ||5||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa gunava(n)tee gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Praiseworthy is the tongue which sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam salaahe sache bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Praising the Naam, one becomes pleasing to the True One.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa rahai ra(n)g raatee mil sache sobhaa paavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love. Meeting the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh karam kare aha(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego.

verses.original: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jooaai janam sabh baajee haaree ||
verses.translation: They lose their whole lives in the gamble.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar lobh mahaa gubaaraa fir fir aavan jaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: Within is the terrible darkness of greed, and so they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa dhe vaddiaaiee || jin kau aap likhat dhur paiee ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself bestows Glory on those whom He Himself has so pre-destined.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai bhau bha(n)jan gur sabadhee sukh paavaniaa ||8||1||34||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they receive the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find peace. ||8||1||34||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar alakh na jaiee lakhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Unseen Lord is within, but He cannot be seen.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਲੈ ਗੁਝਾ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan lai gujhaa rakhiaa ||
verses.translation: He has taken the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and He keeps it well concealed.

verses.original: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: agam agochar sabh te uoochaa gur kai sabadh lakhaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord is the highest of all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree kal meh naam sunaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who chant the Naam, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਧਾਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t piaare sachai dhaare vaddabhaagee dharasan paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Saints were established by the True Lord. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of their Darshan is obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਜਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhik sidh jisai kau firadhe ||
verses.translation: The One who is sought by the Siddhas and the seekers,

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: brahame i(n)dhr dhiaain hiradhe ||
verses.translation: upon whom Brahma and Indra meditate within their hearts,

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: koT teteesaa khojeh taa kau gur mil hiradhai gaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: whom the three hundred thirty million demi-gods search for-meeting the Guru, one comes to sing His Praises within the heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਪੇ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar tudh jaape pavanaa ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, the wind breathes Your Name.

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਾਇਕ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharatee sevak paik charanaa ||
verses.translation: The earth is Your servant, a slave at Your Feet.

verses.original: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khaanee baanee sarab nivaasee sabhanaa kai man bhaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: In the four sources of creation, and in all speech, You dwell. You are dear to the minds of all. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib gurmukh jaapai ||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master is known to the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kai sabadh sin(j)aapai ||
verses.translation: He is realized through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਅਘਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jin peeaa seiee tirapataase sache sach aghaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: Those who drink it in are satisfied. Through the Truest of the True, they are fulfilled. ||4||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਜਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis ghar sahajaa soiee suhelaa ||
verses.translation: In the home of their own beings, they are peacefully and comfortably at ease.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadh binodh kare sadh kelaa ||
verses.translation: They are blissful, enjoying pleasures, and eternally joyful.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: so dhanava(n)taa so vadd saahaa jo gur charanee man laavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: They are wealthy, and the greatest kings; they center their minds on the Guru's Feet. ||5||

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੋ ਦੇ ਤੈਂ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: pahilo dhe tai(n) rijak samaahaa ||
verses.translation: First, You created nourishment;

verses.original: ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਤੈਂ ਜੰਤੁ ਉਪਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: pichho dhe tai(n) ja(n)t upaahaa ||
verses.translation: then, You created the living beings.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd dhaataa avar na suaamee lavai na koiee laavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: There is no other Giver as Great as You, O my Lord and Master. None approach or equal You. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਠਾ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) tuThaa so tudh dhiaae ||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to You meditate on You.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa kaa ma(n)tr kamaae ||
verses.translation: They practice the Mantra of the Holy.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aap tarai sagale kul taare tis dharageh Thaak na paavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: They themselves swim across, and they save all their ancestors and families as well. In the Court of the Lord, they meet with no obstruction. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਤੂੰ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) vaddaa too(n) uoocho uoochaa ||
verses.translation: You are so Great! You are the Highest of the High!

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੂਚੋ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) bea(n)t at moocho moochaa ||
verses.translation: You are Infinite, You are Everything!

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: hau kurabaanee terai va(n)n(j)aa naanak dhaas dhasaavaniaa ||8||1||35||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to You. Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||8||1||35||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaunu su mukataa kaunu su jugataa ||
verses.translation: Who is liberated, and who is united?

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaunu su giaanee kaunu su bakataa ||
verses.translation: Who is a spiritual teacher, and who is a preacher?

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaunu su girahee kaun udhaasee kaunu su keemat paae jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Who is a house-holder, and who is a renunciate? Who can estimate the Lord's Value? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: kin bidh baadhaa kin bidh chhooTaa ||
verses.translation: How is one bound, and how is one freed of his bonds?

verses.original: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: kin bidh aavan jaavan tooTaa ||
verses.translation: How can one escape from the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation?

verses.original: ਕਉਣ ਕਰਮ ਕਉਣ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaun karam kaun nihakaramaa kaunu su kahai kahaae jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Who is subject to karma, and who is beyond karma? Who chants the Name, and inspires others to chant it? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaunu su sukheeaa kaunu su dhukheeaa ||
verses.translation: Who is happy, and who is sad?

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaunu su sanamukh kaun vemukheeaa ||
verses.translation: Who, as sunmukh, turns toward the Guru, and who, as vaymukh, turns away from the Guru?

verses.original: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kin bidh mileeaai kin bidh bichhurai ieh bidh kaun pragaTaae jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: How can one meet the Lord? How is one separated from Him? Who can reveal the way to me? ||3||

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaunu su akhar jit dhaavat rahataa ||
verses.translation: What is that Word, by which the wandering mind can be restrained?

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaun upadhes jit dhukh sukh sam sahataa ||
verses.translation: What are those teachings, by which we may endure pain and pleasure alike?

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kaunu su chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae kin bidh keeratan gaae jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: What is that lifestyle, by which we may come to meditate on the Supreme Lord? How may we sing the Kirtan of His Praises? ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mukataa gurmukh jugataa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is liberated, and the Gurmukh is linked.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh giaanee gurmukh bakataa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is the spiritual teacher, and the Gurmukh is the preacher.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n girahee udhaasee gurmukh gurmukh keemat paae jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: Blessed is the Gurmukh, the householder and the renunciate. The Gurmukh knows the Lord's Value. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਾਧਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai baadhaa gurmukh chhooTaa ||
verses.translation: Egotism is bondage; as Gurmukh, one is emancipated.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aavan jaavan tooTaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh escapes the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh karam gurmukh nihakaramaa gurmukh kare su subhaae jeeau ||6||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh performs actions of good karma, and the Gurmukh is beyond karma. Whatever the Gurmukh does, is done in good faith. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sukheeaa manmukh dhukheeaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is happy, while the self-willed manmukh is sad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sanamukh manmukh vemukheeaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh turns toward the Guru, and the self-willed manmukh turns away from the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mileeaai manmukh vichhurai gurmukh bidh pragaTaae jeeau ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is united with the Lord, while the manmukh is separated from Him. The Gurmukh reveals the way. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh akhar jit dhaavat rahataa ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Instruction is the Word, by which the wandering mind is restrained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh upadhes dhukh sukh sam sahataa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, we can endure pain and pleasure alike.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gurmukh chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae gurmukh keeratan gaae jeeau ||8||
verses.translation: To live as Gurmukh is the lifestyle by which we come to meditate on the Supreme Lord. The Gurmukh sings the Kirtan of His Praises. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee banat banaiee aape ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself created the entire creation.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae thaape ||
verses.translation: He Himself acts, and causes others to act. He Himself establishes.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥੨॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: eikas te hoio ana(n)taa naanak ekas maeh samaae jeeau ||9||2||36||
verses.translation: From oneness, He has brought forth the countless multitudes. O Nanak, they shall merge into the One once again. ||9||2||36||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh abinaasee taa kiaa kaaRaa ||
verses.translation: God is Eternal and Imperishable, so why should anyone be anxious?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagava(n)taa taa jan kharaa sukhaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is Wealthy and Prosperous, so His humble servant should feel totally secure.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeea praan maan sukhadhaataa too(n) kareh soiee sukh paavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Giver of peace of the soul, of life, of honor-as You ordain, I obtain peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gurmukh man tan bhaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that Gurmukh whose mind and body are pleased with You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meraa parabat too(n) meraa olaa tum sa(n)g lavai na laavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my mountain, You are my shelter and shield. No one can rival You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: teraa keetaa jis laagai meeThaa ||
verses.translation: That person, unto whom Your actions seem sweet,

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT paarabraham tin jan ddeeThaa ||
verses.translation: comes to see the Supreme Lord God in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar too(n)hai too(n)hai iko ik varataavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: In all places and interspaces, You exist. You are the One and Only Lord, pervading everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath too(n) dhevanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: You are the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagatee bhai bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your treasures are overflowing with love and devotion.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhaar raakhe tudh seiee poorai karam samaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Showering Your Mercy, You protect those who, through perfect destiny, merge into You. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕੰਢੈ ਚਾੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop te ka(n)ddai chaaRe ||
verses.translation: You pulled me out of the deep, dark well onto the dry ground.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਾਸ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa dhaas nadhar nihaale ||
verses.translation: Showering Your Mercy, You blessed Your servant with Your Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gun gaaveh pooran abinaasee keh sun toT na aavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Immortal Lord. By speaking and hearing these Praises, they are not used up. ||4||

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai othai too(n)hai rakhavaalaa ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, You are our Protector.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: maat garabh meh tum hee paalaa ||
verses.translation: In the womb of the mother, You cherish and nurture the baby.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: maiaa agan na pohai tin kau ra(n)g rate gun gaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: The fire of Maya does not affect those who are imbued with the Lord's Love; they sing His Glorious Praises. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gun tere aakh samaalee ||
verses.translation: What Praises of Yours can I chant and contemplate?

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar tudh nadhar nihaalee ||
verses.translation: Deep within my mind and body, I behold Your Presence.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: too(n) meraa meet saajan meraa suaamee tudh bin avar na jaananiaa ||6||
verses.translation: You are my Friend and Companion, my Lord and Master. Without You, I do not know any other at all. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kau too(n) prabh bhiaa sahaiee ||
verses.translation: O God, that one, unto whom You have given shelter,

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis tatee vaau na lagai kaiee ||
verses.translation: is not touched by the hot winds.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: too saahib saran sukhadhaataa satasa(n)gat jap pragaTaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are my Sanctuary, the Giver of peace. Chanting, meditating on You in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, You are revealed. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) uooch athaahu apaar amolaa ||
verses.translation: You are Exalted, Unfathomable, Infinite and Invaluable.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) saachaa saahib dhaas teraa golaa ||
verses.translation: You are my True Lord and Master. I am Your servant and slave.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: too(n) meeraa saachee Thakuraiee naanak bal bal jaavaniaa ||8||3||37||
verses.translation: You are the King, Your Sovereign Rule is True. Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||8||3||37||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਦਯੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit dhay samaaleeaai ||
verses.translation: Continually, continuously, remember the Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mool na manahu visaareeaai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Never forget Him from your mind. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Join the Society of the Saints,

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jit jam kai pa(n)th na jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: and you shall not have to go down the path of Death.

verses.original: ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੁਲਹਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tosaa har kaa naam lai tere kuleh na laagai gaal jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Take the Provisions of the Lord's Name with you, and no stain shall attach itself to your family. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੰਦੇ ਸਾਂਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jo simara(n)dhe saa(n)ieeaai ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Master

verses.original: ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਸੇਈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: narak na seiee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: shall not be thrown down into hell.

verses.original: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tatee vaau na lagiee jin man vuThaa aai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Even the hot winds shall not touch them. The Lord has come to dwell within their minds. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: seiee su(n)dhar sohane ||
verses.translation: They alone are beautiful and attractive,

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨ ਬੈਹਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jin baihane ||
verses.translation: who abide in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੰਜਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har dhan jinee sa(n)jiaa seiee ga(n)bheer apaar jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Those who have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name-they alone are deep and thoughtful and vast. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har amiau rasain peeveeaai ||
verses.translation: Drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name,

verses.original: ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: muh ddiThai jan kai jeeveeaai ||
verses.translation: and live by beholding the face of the Lord's servant.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਵ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kaaraj sabh savaar lai nit poojahu gur ke paav jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: Let all your affairs be resolved, by continually worshipping the Feet of the Guru. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ॥ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਜਾਪਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo har keetaa aapanaa || tineh gusaiee jaapanaa ||
verses.translation: He alone meditates on the Lord of the World, whom the Lord has made His Own.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: so sooraa paradhaan so masatak jis dhai bhaag jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: He alone is a warrior, and he alone is the chosen one, upon whose forehead good destiny is recorded. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੰਧੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਗਾਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: man ma(n)dhe prabh avagaaheeaa ||
verses.translation: Within my mind, I meditate on God.

verses.original: ਏਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: eh ras bhogan paatisaaheeaa ||
verses.translation: For me, this is like the enjoyment of princely pleasures.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਰੇ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa mool na upajio tare sachee kaarai laag jeeau ||6||
verses.translation: Evil does not well up within me, since I am saved, and dedicated to truthful actions. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: karataa ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined the Creator within my mind;

verses.original: ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: janamai kaa fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the fruits of life's rewards.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: man bhaava(n)dhaa ka(n)t har teraa thir hoaa sohaag jeeau ||7||
verses.translation: If your Husband Lord is pleasing to your mind, then your married life shall be eternal. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aTal padhaarath paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained everlasting wealth;

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bha(n)jan kee saranaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have found the Sanctuary of the Dispeller of fear.

verses.original: ਲਾਇ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੪॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: lai a(n)chal naanak taarian jitaa janam apaar jeeau ||8||4||38||
verses.translation: Grasping hold of the hem of the Lord's robe, Nanak is saved. He has won the incomparable life. ||8||4||38||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jap jape man dheere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the mind is held steady. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਭੈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: simar simar gurdheau miT ge bhai dhoore ||1||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Divine Guru, one's fears are erased and dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saran aavai paarabraham kee taa fir kaahe jhoore ||2||
verses.translation: Entering the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, how could anyone feel grief any longer? ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan sev sa(n)t saadh ke sagal manorath poore ||3||
verses.translation: Serving at the Feet of the Holy Saints, all desires are fulfilled. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT ek varatadhaa jal thal maheeal poore ||4||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, the One Lord is pervading. He is totally permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: paap binaasan seviaa pavitr sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||5||
verses.translation: I serve the Destroyer of sin, and I am sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਛਡਾਈ ਖਸਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਠਰੂਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sabh chhaddaiee khasam aap har jap bhiee Tharoore ||6||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master Himself has saved me completely; I am comforted by meditating on the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: karatai keeaa tapaavaso dhusaT mue hoi moore ||7||
verses.translation: The Creator has passed judgement, and the evil-doers have been silenced and killed. ||7||

verses.translit: naanak rataa sach nai har vekhai sadhaa hajoore ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||
verses.translation: Nanak is attuned to the True Name; he beholds the Presence of the Ever-present Lord. ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||

verses.original: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹਾ ਮਾਂਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: baareh maahaa maa(n)jh mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months: Maajh, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਵੀਛੁੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kirat karam ke veechhuRe kar kirapaa melahu raam ||
verses.translation: By the actions we have committed, we are separated from You. Please show Your Mercy, and unite us with Yourself, Lord.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਥਕਿ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: chaar ku(n)T dheh dhis bhrame thak aae prabh kee saam ||
verses.translation: We have grown weary of wandering to the four corners of the earth and in the ten directions. We have come to Your Sanctuary, God.

verses.original: ਧੇਨੁ ਦੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhen dhudhai te baaharee kitai na aavai kaam ||
verses.translation: Without milk, a cow serves no purpose.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਖ ਕੁਮਲਾਵਤੀ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jal bin saakh kumalaavatee upajeh naahee dhaam ||
verses.translation: Without water, the crop withers, and it will not bring a good price.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹ ਨ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਾਜਨੈ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har naeh na mileeaai saajanai kat paieeaai bisaraam ||
verses.translation: If we do not meet the Lord, our Friend, how can we find our place of rest?

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ਭਠਿ ਨਗਰ ਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jit ghar har ka(n)t na pragaTiee bhaTh nagar se graam ||
verses.translation: Those homes, those hearts, in which the Husband Lord is not manifest-those towns and villages are like burning furnaces.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਸਣੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: srab seegaar ta(n)bol ras san dhehee sabh khaam ||
verses.translation: All decorations, the chewing of betel to sweeten the breath, and the body itself, are all useless and vain.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਮੀਤ ਸਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: prabh suaamee ka(n)t vihooneeaa meet sajan sabh jaam ||
verses.translation: Without God, our Husband, our Lord and Master, all friends and companions are like the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa kar kirapaa dheejai naam ||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer: ""Please show Your Mercy, and bestow Your Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har melahu suaamee sa(n)g prabh jis kaa nihachal dhaam ||1||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with Yourself, O God, in the Eternal Mansion of Your Presence"". ||1||

verses.original: ਚੇਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: chet govi(n)dh araadheeaai hovai ana(n)dh ghanaa ||
verses.translation: In the month of Chayt, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, a deep and profound joy arises.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa mil paieeaai rasanaa naam bhanaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble Saints, the Lord is found, as we chant His Name with our tongues.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਗਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin paiaa prabh aapanaa aae tiseh ganaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have found God-blessed is their coming into this world.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik khin tis bin jeevanaa birathaa janam janaa ||
verses.translation: Those who live without Him, for even an instant-their lives are rendered useless.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਰਵਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal pooriaa raviaa vich vanaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is totally pervading the water, the land, and all space. He is contained in the forests as well.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕਿਤੜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh chit na aaviee kitaRaa dhukh ganaa ||
verses.translation: Those who do not remember God-how much pain must they suffer!

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jinee raaviaa so prabhoo ti(n)naa bhaag manaa ||
verses.translation: Those who dwell upon their God have great good fortune.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੰਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dharasan ka(n)au man lochadhaa naanak piaas manaa ||
verses.translation: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. O Nanak, my mind is so thirsty!

verses.original: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chet milaae so prabhoo tis kai pai lagaa ||2||
verses.translation: I touch the feet of one who unites me with God in the month of Chayt. ||2||

verses.original: ਵੈਸਾਖਿ ਧੀਰਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਵਾਢੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaisaakh dheeran kiau vaaddeeaa jinaa prem bichhoh ||
verses.translation: In the month of Vaisaakh, how can the bride be patient? She is separated from her Beloved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har saajan purakh visaar kai lagee maiaa dhoh ||
verses.translation: She has forgotten the Lord, her Life-companion, her Master; she has become attached to Maya, the deceitful one.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਓਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr na sa(n)g dhanaa har avinaasee oh ||
verses.translation: Neither son, nor spouse, nor wealth shall go along with you-only the Eternal Lord.

verses.original: ਪਲਚਿ ਪਲਚਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੁਈ ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: palach palach sagalee muiee jhooThai dha(n)dhai moh ||
verses.translation: Entangled and enmeshed in the love of false occupations, the whole world is perishing.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਲਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eikas har ke naam bin agai lie'eeh khoh ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, they lose their lives in the hereafter.

verses.original: ਦਯੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhay visaar viguchanaa prabh bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Merciful Lord, they are ruined. Without God, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: preetam charanee jo lage tin kee niramal soi ||
verses.translation: Pure is the reputation of those who are attached to the Feet of the Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kee prabh benatee prabh milahu paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: Nanak makes this prayer to God: ""Please, come and unite me with Yourself.""

verses.original: ਵੈਸਾਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਗੈ ਜਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vaisaakh suhaavaa taa(n) lagai jaa sa(n)t bheTai har soi ||3||
verses.translation: The month of Vaisaakh is beautiful and pleasant, when the Saint causes me to meet the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠਿ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jeTh juRa(n)dhaa loReeaai jis agai sabh niva(n)n ||
verses.translation: In the month of Jayt'h, the bride longs to meet with the Lord. All bow in humility before Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਦਾਵਣਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: har sajan dhaavan lagiaa kisai na dheiee ba(n)n ||
verses.translation: One who has grasped the hem of the robe of the Lord, the True Friend-no one can keep him in bondage.

verses.original: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਉਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: maanak motee naam prabh un lagai naahee sa(n)n ||
verses.translation: God's Name is the Jewel, the Pearl. It cannot be stolen or taken away.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਸਭੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g sabhe naarainai jete man bhaava(n)n ||
verses.translation: In the Lord are all pleasures which please the mind.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਅ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo har loRe so kare soiee jeea kara(n)n ||
verses.translation: As the Lord wishes, so He acts, and so His creatures act.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਈ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo prabh keete aapane seiee kahe'eeh dha(n)n ||
verses.translation: They alone are called blessed, whom God has made His Own.

verses.original: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਰੋਵੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapan leeaa je milai vichhuR kiau rova(n)n ||
verses.translation: If people could meet the Lord by their own efforts, why would they be crying out in the pain of separation?

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g paraapate naanak ra(n)g maana(n)n ||
verses.translation: Meeting Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, celestial bliss is enjoyed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har jeTh ra(n)geelaa tis dhanee jis kai bhaag matha(n)n ||4||
verses.translation: In the month of Jayt'h, the playful Husband Lord meets her, upon whose forehead such good destiny is recorded. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਤਪੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: aasaaR tapa(n)dhaa tis lagai har naahu na ji(n)naa paas ||
verses.translation: The month of Aasaarh seems burning hot, to those who are not close to their Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਸੰਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan purakh tiaag kai maanas sa(n)dhee aas ||
verses.translation: They have forsaken God the Primal Being, the Life of the World, and they have come to rely upon mere mortals.

verses.original: ਦੁਯੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਗਲਿ ਪਈਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: dhuyai bhai vigucheeaai gal piees jam kee faas ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, the soul-bride is ruined; around her neck she wears the noose of Death.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਮਥੈ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa beejai so lunai mathai jo likhiaas ||
verses.translation: As you plant, so shall you harvest; your destiny is recorded on your forehead.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਗਈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: rain vihaanee pachhutaanee uTh chalee giee niraas ||
verses.translation: The life-night passes away, and in the end, one comes to regret and repent, and then depart with no hope at all.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਾਧੂ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau saadhoo bheTeeaai so dharageh hoi khalaas ||
verses.translation: Those who meet with the Holy Saints are liberated in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee tere dharasan hoi piaas ||
verses.translation: Show Your Mercy to me, O God; I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh tudh bin dhoojaa ko nahee naanak kee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Without You, God, there is no other at all. This is Nanak's humble prayer.

verses.original: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aasaaR suha(n)dhaa tis lagai jis man har charan nivaas ||5||
verses.translation: The month of Aasaarh is pleasant, when the Feet of the Lord abide in the mind. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saavan sarasee kaamanee charan kamal siau piaar ||
verses.translation: In the month of Saawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she falls in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rataa sach ra(n)g iko naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: Her mind and body are imbued with the Love of the True One; His Name is her only Support.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਕੂੜਾਵਿਆ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa ra(n)g kooRaaviaa dhisan sabhe chhaar ||
verses.translation: The pleasures of corruption are false. All that is seen shall turn to ashes.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mirat boo(n)dh suhaavanee mil saadhoo peevanahaar ||
verses.translation: The drops of the Lord's Nectar are so beautiful! Meeting the Holy Saint, we drink these in.

verses.original: ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: van tin prabh sa(n)g mauliaa sa(n)mrath purakh apaar ||
verses.translation: The forests and the meadows are rejuvenated and refreshed with the Love of God, the All-powerful, Infinite Primal Being.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਨੋ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har milanai no man lochadhaa karam milaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: My mind yearns to meet the Lord. If only He would show His Mercy, and unite me with Himself!

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sakhe'ee prabh paiaa ha(n)au tin kai sadh balihaar ||
verses.translation: Those brides who have obtained God-I am forever a sacrifice to them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak har jee miaa kar sabadh savaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Dear Lord shows kindness, He adorns His bride with the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saavan tinaa suhaaganee jin raam naam ur haar ||6||
verses.translation: Saawan is delightful for those happy soul-brides whose hearts are adorned with the Necklace of the Lord's Name. ||6||

verses.original: ਭਾਦੁਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaadhui bharam bhulaaneeaa dhoojai lagaa het ||
verses.translation: In the month of Bhaadon, she is deluded by doubt, because of her attachment to duality.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: lakh seegaar banaiaa kaaraj naahee ket ||
verses.translation: She may wear thousands of ornaments, but they are of no use at all.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਸਸੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੈ ਕਹਸਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jit dhin dheh binasasee tit velai kahasan pret ||
verses.translation: On that day when the body perishes-at that time, she becomes a ghost.

verses.original: ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਨਿ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਨੀ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: pakaR chalain dhoot jam kisai na dhenee bhet ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death seizes and holds her, and does not tell anyone his secret.

verses.original: ਛਡਿ ਖੜੋਤੇ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chhadd khaRote khinai maeh jin siau lagaa het ||
verses.translation: And her loved ones-in an instant, they move on, leaving her all alone.

verses.original: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਪੇ ਸਿਆਹਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: hath maroRai tan kape siaahahu hoaa set ||
verses.translation: She wrings her hands, her body writhes in pain, and she turns from black to white.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮਾ ਸੰਦੜਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa beejai so lunai karamaa sa(n)dhaRaa khet ||
verses.translation: As she has planted, so does she harvest; such is the field of karma.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee charan bohith prabh dhet ||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks God's Sanctuary; God has given him the Boat of His Feet.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਾਦੁਇ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: se bhaadhui narak na paie'eeh gur rakhan vaalaa het ||7||
verses.translation: Those who love the Guru, the Protector and Savior, in Bhaadon, shall not be thrown down into hell. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਸੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਉਮਾਹੜਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: asun prem umaahaRaa kiau mileeaai har jai ||
verses.translation: In the month of Assu, my love for the Lord overwhelms me. How can I go and meet the Lord?

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਦਰਸਨ ਘਣੀ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan piaas dharasan ghanee koiee aan milaavai mai ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Won't someone please come and lead me to him, O my mother.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sahaiee prem ke hau tin kai laagaa pai ||
verses.translation: The Saints are the helpers of the Lord's lovers; I fall and touch their feet.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin prabh kiau sukh paieeaai dhoojee naahee jai ||
verses.translation: Without God, how can I find peace? There is nowhere else to go.

verses.original: ਜਿੰਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ji(n)n(h)ee chaakhiaa prem ras se tirapat rahe aaghai ||
verses.translation: Those who have tasted the sublime essence of His Love, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap tiaag binatee kareh leh prabhoo laR lai ||
verses.translation: They renounce their selfishness and conceit, and they pray, ""God, please attach me to the hem of Your robe.""

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ਸਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo har ka(n)t milaieeaa s vichhuR kateh na jai ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Husband Lord has united with Himself, shall not be separated from Him again.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh vin dhoojaa ko nahee naanak har saranai ||
verses.translation: Without God, there is no other at all. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਸੂ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸੰਦੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: asoo sukhee vasa(n)dheeaa jinaa miaa har rai ||8||
verses.translation: In Assu, the Lord, the Sovereign King, has granted His Mercy, and they dwell in peace. ||8||

verses.original: ਕਤਿਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: katik karam kamaavane dhos na kaahoo jog ||
verses.translation: In the month of Katak, do good deeds. Do not try to blame anyone else.

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਤੇ ਭੁਲਿਆਂ ਵਿਆਪਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: paramesar te bhuliaa(n) viaapan sabhe rog ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Transcendent Lord, all sorts of illnesses are contracted.

verses.original: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਲਗਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: vemukh hoe raam te lagan janam vijog ||
verses.translation: Those who turn their backs on the Lord shall be separated from Him and consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਉੜੇ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਜਿਤੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh kauRe hoi ge jitaRe maiaa bhog ||
verses.translation: In an instant, all of Maya's sensual pleasures turn bitter.

verses.original: ਵਿਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
verses.translit: vich na koiee kar sakai kis thai roveh roj ||
verses.translation: No one can then serve as your intermediary. Unto whom can we turn and cry?

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa kichhoo na hoviee likhiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: By one's own actions, nothing can be done; destiny was pre-determined from the very beginning.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਓਗ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee meraa prabh milai taa(n) utareh sabh biog ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I meet my God, and then all pain of separation departs.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kau prabh raakh leh mere saahib ba(n)dhee moch ||
verses.translation: Please protect Nanak, God; O my Lord and Master, please release me from bondage.

verses.original: ਕਤਿਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਸੋਚ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: katik hovai saadhasa(n)g binaseh sabhe soch ||9||
verses.translation: In Katak, in the Company of the Holy, all anxiety vanishes. ||9||

verses.original: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ghir maeh soha(n)dheeaa har pir sa(n)g baiThaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: In the month of Maghar, those who sit with their Beloved Husband Lord are beautiful.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਮੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee sobhaa kiaa ganee j saahib melaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: How can their glory be measured? Their Lord and Master blends them with Himself.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: tan man mauliaa raam siau sa(n)g saadh sahelaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Their bodies and minds blossom forth in the Lord; they have the companionship of the Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa te baaharee se rahan ikelaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who lack the Company of the Holy, remain all alone.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੇ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: tin dhukh na kabahoo utarai se jam kai vas paReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Their pain never departs, and they fall into the grip of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: jinee raaviaa prabh aapanaa se dhisan nit khaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who have ravished and enjoyed their God, are seen to be continually exalted and uplifted.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: ratan javehar laal har ka(n)Th tinaa jaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: They wear the Necklace of the jewels, emeralds and rubies of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: naanak baa(n)chhai dhooR tin prabh saranee dhar paReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door.

verses.original: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੜੀਆਹ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ghir prabh aaraadhanaa bahuR na janamaReeaaeh ||10||
verses.translation: Those who worship and adore God in Maghar, do not suffer the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||10||

verses.original: ਪੋਖਿ ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: pokh tukhaar na viaapiee ka(n)Th miliaa har naahu ||
verses.translation: In the month of Poh, the cold does not touch those, whom the Husband Lord hugs close in His Embrace.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਲਗੜਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: man bedhiaa charanaarabi(n)dh dharasan lagaRaa saahu ||
verses.translation: Their minds are transfixed by His Lotus Feet. They are attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਓਟ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: oT govi(n)dh gopaal rai sevaa suaamee laahu ||
verses.translation: Seek the Protection of the Lord of the Universe; His service is truly profitable.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa poh na sakiee mil saadhoo gun gaahu ||
verses.translation: Corruption shall not touch you, when you join the Holy Saints and sing the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥
