verses.translit: jeh te upajee teh milee sachee preet samaahu ||
verses.translation: From where it originated, there the soul is blended again. It is absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੀਆਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar geh leenee paarabraham bahuR na vichhuReeaahu ||
verses.translation: When the Supreme Lord God grasps someone's hand, he shall never again suffer separation from Him.

verses.original: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: baar jaau lakh bereeaa har sajan agam agaahu ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, 100,000 times, to the Lord, my Friend, the Unapproachable and Unfathomable.

verses.original: ਸਰਮ ਪਈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਈਆਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: saram piee naarainai naanak dhar pieeaahu ||
verses.translation: Please preserve my honor, Lord; Nanak begs at Your Door.

verses.original: ਪੋਖੁ ਸੋੁਹੰਦਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: pokh suoha(n)dhaa sarab sukh jis bakhase veparavaahu ||11||
verses.translation: Poh is beautiful, and all comforts come to that one, whom the Carefree Lord has forgiven. ||11||

verses.original: ਮਾਘਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਧੂੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: maagh majan sa(n)g saadhooaa dhooRee kar isanaan ||
verses.translation: In the month of Maagh, let your cleansing bath be the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam dhiaai sun sabhanaa no kar dhaan ||
verses.translation: Meditate and listen to the Name of the Lord, and give it to everyone.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਕਰਮ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: janam karam mal utarai man te jai gumaan ||
verses.translation: In this way, the filth of lifetimes of karma shall be removed, and egotistical pride shall vanish from your mind.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh na moheeaai binasai lobh suaan ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire and anger shall not seduce you, and the dog of greed shall depart.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachai maarag chaladhiaa usatat kare jahaan ||
verses.translation: Those who walk on the Path of Truth shall be praised throughout the world.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਗਲ ਪੁੰਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath sagal pu(n)n jeea dhiaa paravaan ||
verses.translation: Be kind to all beings-this is more meritorious than bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the giving of charity.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis no dhevai dhiaa kar soiee purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Mercy, is a wise person.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa miliaa prabh aapanaa naanak tin kurabaan ||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have merged with God.

verses.original: ਮਾਘਿ ਸੁਚੇ ਸੇ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: maagh suche se kaa(n)dde'eeh jin pooraa gur miharavaan ||12||
verses.translation: In Maagh, they alone are known as true, unto whom the Perfect Guru is Merciful. ||12||

verses.original: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: falagun ana(n)dh upaarajanaa har sajan pragaTe aai ||
verses.translation: In the month of Phalgun, bliss comes to those, unto whom the Lord, the Friend, has been revealed.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sahaiee raam ke kar kirapaa dheeaa milai ||
verses.translation: The Saints, the Lord's helpers, in their mercy, have united me with Him.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹੁਣਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sej suhaavee sarab sukh hun dhukhaa naahee jai ||
verses.translation: My bed is beautiful, and I have all comforts. I feel no sadness at all.

verses.original: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eichh punee vaddabhaaganee var paiaa har rai ||
verses.translation: My desires have been fulfilled-by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sovereign Lord as my Husband.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਹੀਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੀ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mil saheeaa ma(n)gal gaavahee geet govi(n)dh alai ||
verses.translation: Join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of rejoicing and the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jehaa avar na dhisiee koiee dhoojaa lavai na lai ||
verses.translation: There is no other like the Lord-there is no equal to Him.

verses.original: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat savaarion nihachal dhiteean jai ||
verses.translation: He embellishes this world and the world hereafter, and He gives us our permanent home there.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar te rakhian bahuR na janamai dhai ||
verses.translation: He rescues us from the world-ocean; never again do we have to run the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਗੁਣ ਤਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa ek anek gun tare naanak charanee pai ||
verses.translation: I have only one tongue, but Your Glorious Virtues are beyond counting. Nanak is saved, falling at Your Feet.

verses.original: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: falagun nit salaaheeaai jis no til na tamai ||13||
verses.translation: In Phalgun, praise Him continually; He has not even an iota of greed. ||13||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin jin naam dhiaaiaa tin ke kaaj sare ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord-their affairs are all resolved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har gur pooraa aaraadhiaa dharageh sach khare ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Perfect Guru, the Lord-Incarnate-they are judged true in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa nidh charan har bhaujal bikham tare ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Feet are the Treasure of all peace and comfort for them; they cross over the terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat tin paieeaa bikhiaa naeh jare ||
verses.translation: They obtain love and devotion, and they do not burn in corruption.

verses.original: ਕੂੜ ਗਏ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਸੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਚਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kooR ge dhubidhaa nasee pooran sach bhare ||
verses.translation: Falsehood has vanished, duality has been erased, and they are totally overflowing with Truth.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh sevadhe man a(n)dhar ek dhare ||
verses.translation: They serve the Supreme Lord God, and enshrine the One Lord within their minds.

verses.original: ਮਾਹ ਦਿਵਸ ਮੂਰਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maeh dhivas moorat bhale jis kau nadhar kare ||
verses.translation: The months, the days, and the moments are auspicious, for those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਰਸ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ma(n)gai dharas dhaan kirapaa karahu hare ||14||1||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the blessing of Your Vision, O Lord. Please, shower Your Mercy upon me! ||14||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਣਿ
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa dhin rain
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla: Day And Night:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਰੈਣ ॥
verses.translit: sevee satigur aapanaa har simaree dhin sabh rain ||
verses.translation: I serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵਾਂ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਿਠੜੇ ਵੈਣ ॥
verses.translit: aap tiaag saranee pavaa(n) mukh bolee miThaRe vain ||
verses.translation: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, I seek His Sanctuary, and speak sweet words to Him.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kaa vichhuRiaa har melahu sajan sain ||
verses.translation: Through countless lifetimes and incarnations, I was separated from Him. O Lord, you are my Friend and Companion-please unite me with Yourself.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਸੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨ ਵਸਨਿ ਭੈਣ ॥
verses.translit: jo jeea har te vichhuRe se sukh na vasan bhain ||
verses.translation: Those who are separated from the Lord do not dwell in peace, O sister.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਗੈਣ ॥
verses.translit: har pir bin chain na paieeaai khoj ddiThe sabh gain ||
verses.translation: Without their Husband Lord, they find no comfort. I have searched and seen all realms.

verses.original: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੇਣ ॥
verses.translit: aap kamaanai vichhuRee dhos na kaahoo dhen ||
verses.translation: My own evil actions have kept me separate from Him; why should I accuse anyone else?

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਣ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh raakh leh hor naahee karan karen ||
verses.translation: Bestow Your Mercy, God, and save me! No one else can bestow Your Mercy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਖਾਕੂ ਰੂਲਣਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਥੈ ਵੈਣ ॥
verses.translit: har tudh vin khaakoo roolanaa kaheeaai kithai vain ||
verses.translation: Without You, Lord, we roll around in the dust. Unto whom should we utter our cries of distress?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa har surajan dhekhaa nain ||1||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer: ""May my eyes behold the Lord, the Angelic Being.""||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kee birathaa so sune har sa(n)mrith purakh apaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord hears the anguish of the soul; He is the All-powerful and Infinite Primal Being.

verses.original: ਮਰਣਿ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maran jeevan aaraadhanaa sabhanaa kaa aadhaar ||
verses.translation: In death and in life, worship and adore the Lord, the Support of all.

verses.original: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਵਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sasurai peieeaai tis ka(n)t kee vaddaa jis paravaar ||
verses.translation: In this world and in the next, the soul-bride belongs to her Husband Lord, who has such a vast family.

verses.original: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: uoochaa agam agaadh bodh kichh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: He is Lofty and Inaccessible. His Wisdom is Unfathomable.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa saa tis bhaavasee sa(n)taa kee hoi chhaar ||
verses.translation: He has no end or limitation. That service is pleasing to Him, which makes one humble, like the dust of the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੈਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath dhaiaal dhev patit udhaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: He is the Patron of the poor, the Merciful, Luminous Lord, the Redeemer of sinners.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee rakhadhaa sach naam karataar ||
verses.translation: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the True Name of the Creator has been our Saving Grace.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: keemat koi na jaaniee ko naahee tolanahaar ||
verses.translation: No one can know His Value; no one can weigh it.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar vas rahe naanak nahee sumaar ||
verses.translation: He dwells deep within the mind and body. O Nanak, He cannot be measured.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੰਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhin rain j prabh ka(n)au sevadhe tin kai sadh balihaar ||2||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve God, day and night. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t araadhan sadh sadhaa sabhanaa kaa bakhasi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Saints worship and adore Him forever and ever; He is the Forgiver of all.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਿਤੀਨੁ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd jin saajiaa kar kirapaa dhiteen ji(n)dh ||
verses.translation: He fashioned the soul and the body, and by His Kindness, He bestowed the soul.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee aaraadheeaai japeeaai niramal ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, worship and adore Him, and chant His Pure Mantra.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kahan na jaieeaai paramesur bea(n)t ||
verses.translation: His Value cannot be evaluated. The Transcendent Lord is endless.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis man vasai naraino so kaheeaai bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: That one, within whose mind the Lord abides, is said to be most fortunate.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kee lochaa pooreeaai milai suaamee ka(n)t ||
verses.translation: The soul's desires are fulfilled, upon meeting the Master, our Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਦੋਖ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਹੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jeevai jap haree dhokh sabhe hee ha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Nanak lives by chanting the Lord's Name; all sorrows have been erased.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੰਤੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhin rain jis na visarai so hariaa hovai ja(n)t ||3||
verses.translation: One who does not forget Him, day and night, is continually rejuvenated. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਣੋ ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa prabh poorano ma(n)n(j) nimaanee thaau ||
verses.translation: God is overflowing with all powers. I have no honor-He is my resting place.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har oT gahee man a(n)dhare jap jap jeevaa(n) naau ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the Support of the Lord within my mind; I live by chanting and meditating on His Name.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਨ ਧੂੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee jan dhooRee sa(n)g samaau ||
verses.translation: Grant Your Grace, God, and bless me, that I may merge into the dust of the feet of the humble.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau too(n) raakheh tiau rahaa teraa dhitaa painaa khaau ||
verses.translation: As You keep me, so do I live. I wear and eat whatever You give me.

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: audham soiee karai prabh mil saadhoo gun gaau ||
verses.translation: May I make the effort, O God, to sing Your Glorious Praises in the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਕੂਕਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojee jai na sujhiee kithai kookan jaau ||
verses.translation: I can conceive of no other place; where could I go to lodge a complaint?

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਤਮ ਹਰਣ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan binaasan tam haran uooche agam amaau ||
verses.translation: You are the Dispeller of ignorance, the Destroyer of darkness, O Lofty, Unfathomable and Unapproachable Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: man vichhuRiaa har meleeaai naanak eh suaau ||
verses.translation: Please unite this separated one with Yourself; this is Nanak's yearning.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab kaliaanaa tit dhin har parasee gur ke paau ||4||1||
verses.translation: That day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਵਾਰ ਮਾਝ ਕੀ ਤਥਾ ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧  ਮਲਕ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਤਥਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹੜਾ ਸੋਹੀਆ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: vaar maajh kee tathaa salok mahalaa pehilaa  malak mureedh tathaa cha(n)dhrahaRaa soheeaa kee dhunee gaavanee ||
verses.translation: Vaar In Maajh, And Shaloks Of The First Mehla: To Be Sung To The Tune Of ""Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa""

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤਿਹ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhaataa gur hivai ghar gur dheepak teh loi ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Giver; the Guru is the House of ice. The Guru is the Light of the three worlds.

verses.original: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: amar padhaarath naanakaa man maaniaai sukh hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਥਣ ਦੁਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: pahilai piaar lagaa than dhudh ||
verses.translation: First, the baby loves mother's milk;

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai mai baap kee sudh ||
verses.translation: second, he learns of his mother and father;

verses.original: ਤੀਜੈ ਭਯਾ ਭਾਭੀ ਬੇਬ ॥
verses.translit: teejai bhayaa bhaabhee beb ||
verses.translation: third, his brothers, sisters-in-law and sisters;

verses.original: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਉਪੰਨੀ ਖੇਡ ॥
verses.translit: chauthai piaar upa(n)nee khedd ||
verses.translation: fourth, the love of play awakens.

verses.original: ਪੰਜਵੈ ਖਾਣ ਪੀਅਣ ਕੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)javai khaan peean kee dhaat ||
verses.translation: Fifth, he runs after food and drink;

verses.original: ਛਿਵੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: chhivai kaam na puchhai jaat ||
verses.translation: sixth, in his sexual desire, he does not respect social customs.

verses.original: ਸਤਵੈ ਸੰਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: satavai sa(n)j keeaa ghar vaas ||
verses.translation: Seventh, he gathers wealth and dwells in his house;

verses.original: ਅਠਵੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਨ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aThavai karodh hoaa tan naas ||
verses.translation: eighth, he becomes angry, and his body is consumed.

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਧਉਲੇ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: naavai dhaule ubhe saeh ||
verses.translation: Ninth, he turns grey, and his breathing becomes labored;

verses.original: ਦਸਵੈ ਦਧਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: dhasavai dhadhaa hoaa suaaeh ||
verses.translation: tenth, he is cremated, and turns to ashes.

verses.original: ਗਏ ਸਿਗੀਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਧਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: ge sigeet pukaaree dhaeh ||
verses.translation: His companions send him off, crying out and lamenting.

verses.original: ਉਡਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਦਸਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: auddiaa ha(n)s dhasaae raeh ||
verses.translation: The swan of the soul takes flight, and asks which way to go.

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaa giaa muiaa naau ||
verses.translation: He came and he went, and now, even his name has died.

verses.original: ਪਿਛੈ ਪਤਲਿ ਸਦਿਹੁ ਕਾਵ ॥
verses.translit: pichhai patal sadhih kaav ||
verses.translation: After he left, food was offered on leaves, and the birds were called to come and eat.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak manmukh a(n)dh piaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs love the darkness.

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਡੁਬਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo ddubaa sa(n)saar ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the world is drowning. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਸ ਬਾਲਤਣਿ ਬੀਸ ਰਵਣਿ ਤੀਸਾ ਕਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhas baalatan bees ravan teesaa kaa su(n)dhar kahaavai ||
verses.translation: At the age of ten, he is a child; at twenty, a youth, and at thirty, he is called handsome.

verses.original: ਚਾਲੀਸੀ ਪੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਚਾਸੀ ਪਗੁ ਖਿਸੈ ਸਠੀ ਕੇ ਬੋਢੇਪਾ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: chaaleesee pur hoi pachaasee pag khisai saThee ke boddepaa aavai ||
verses.translation: At forty, he is full of life; at fifty, his foot slips, and at sixty, old age is upon him.

verses.original: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਅਸੀਹਾਂ ਕਾ ਵਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satar kaa matiheen aseehaa(n) kaa viauhaar na paavai ||
verses.translation: At seventy, he loses his intellect, and at eighty, he cannot perform his duties.

verses.original: ਨਵੈ ਕਾ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਣੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਪ ਬਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: navai kaa sihajaasanee mool na jaanai ap bal ||
verses.translation: At ninety, he lies in his bed, and he cannot understand his weakness.

verses.original: ਢੰਢੋਲਿਮੁ ਢੂਢਿਮੁ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਧੂਏ ਕਾ ਧਵਲਹਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dda(n)ddolim ddooddim ddiTh mai naanak jag dhooe kaa dhavalahar ||3||
verses.translation: After seeking and searching for such a long time, O Nanak, I have seen that the world is just a mansion of smoke. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) karataa purakh aga(n)m hai aap sirasaT upaatee ||
verses.translation: You, O Creator Lord, are Unfathomable. You Yourself created the Universe,

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g para(n)g upaarajanaa bahu bahu bidh bhaatee ||
verses.translation: its colors, qualities and varieties, in so many ways and forms.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) jaaneh jin upaieeaai sabh khel tumaatee ||
verses.translation: You created it, and You alone understand it. It is all Your Play.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik aaveh ik jaeh uTh bin naavai mar jaatee ||
verses.translation: Some come, and some arise and depart; but without the Name, all are bound to die.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ra(n)g chalooliaa ra(n)g har ra(n)g raatee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the deep crimson color of the poppy; they are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: so sevahu sat nira(n)jano har purakh bidhaatee ||
verses.translation: So serve the True and Pure Lord, the Supremely Powerful Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਡਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape aap sujaan hai vadd purakh vaddaatee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are All-knowing. O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great!

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਚਿਆ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo man chit tudh dhiaaidhe mere sachiaa bal bal hau tin jaatee ||1||
verses.translation: O my True Lord, I am a sacrifice, a humble sacrifice, to those who meditate on You within their conscious mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pai tan saajiaa rakhiaa banat banai ||
verses.translation: He placed the soul in the body which He had fashioned. He protects the Creation which He has created.

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: akhee dhekhai jihavaa bolai ka(n)nee surat samai ||
verses.translation: With their eyes, they see, and with their tongues, they speak; with their ears, they bring the mind to awareness.

verses.original: ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲੈ ਹਥੀ ਕਰਣਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pairee chalai hathee karanaa dhitaa painai khai ||
verses.translation: With their feet, they walk, and with their hands, they work; they wear and eat whatever is given.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin rach rachiaa tiseh na jaanai a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamai ||
verses.translation: They do not know the One who created the Creation. The blind fools do their dark deeds.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਭਜੈ ਤਾ ਠੀਕਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾੜਤ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa bhajai taa Theekar hovai ghaaRat ghaRee na jai ||
verses.translation: When the pitcher of the body breaks and shatters into pieces, it cannot be re-created again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gur bin naeh pat pat vin paar na pai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Guru, there is no honor; without honor, no one is carried across. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhe(n)dhe thaavahu dhitaa cha(n)gaa manmukh aaisaa jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: They prefer the gift, instead of the Giver; such is the way of the self-willed manmukhs.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: surat mat chaturaiee taa kee kiaa kar aakh vakhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: What can anyone say about their intelligence, their understanding or their cleverness?

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar beh kai karam kamaavai so chahu ku(n)ddee jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: The deeds which one commits, while sitting in one's own home, are known far and wide, in the four directions.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਨਾਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jo dharam kamaavai tis dharam naau hovai paap kamaanai paapee jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: One who lives righteously is known as righteous; one who commits sins is known as a sinner.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape khel kareh sabh karate kiaa dhoojaa aakh vakhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself enact the entire play, O Creator. Why should we speak of any other?

verses.original: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਦਿਖਾ ਸਿਆਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jichar teree jot tichar jotee vich too(n) boleh vin jotee koiee kichh karih dhikhaa siaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: As long as Your Light is within the body, You speak through that Light. Without Your Light, who can do anything? Show me any such cleverness!

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh nadharee aaiaa har iko sughaR sujaaneeaai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord alone is Perfect and All-knowing; He is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape jagat upai kai tudh aape dha(n)dhai laiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself put it to work.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: moh Thagaulee pai kai tudh aapahu jagat khuaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Administering the drug of emotional attachment, You Yourself have led the world astray.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਹੈ ਨਹ ਤਿਪਤੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tisanaa a(n)dhar agan hai neh tipatai bhukhaa tihaiaa ||
verses.translation: The fire of desire is deep within; unsatisfied, people remain hungry and thirsty.

verses.original: ਸਹਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sahasaa ih sa(n)saar hai mar ja(n)mai aaiaa jaiaa ||
verses.translation: This world is an illusion; it dies and it is re-born-it comes and it goes in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਸਭਿ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur moh na tuTiee sabh thake karam kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, emotional attachment is not broken. All have grown weary of performing empty rituals.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਜਾ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee naam dhiaaieeaai sukh rajaa jaa tudh bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Filled with a joyful peace, they surrender to Your Will.

verses.original: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kul udhaare aapanaa dha(n)n janedhee maiaa ||
verses.translation: They save their families and ancestors; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sobhaa surat suhaavanee jin har setee chit laiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Beautiful and sublime is the glory and the understanding of those who focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕੰਨਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: akhee baajhahu vekhanaa vin ka(n)naa sunanaa ||
verses.translation: To see without eyes; to hear without ears;

verses.original: ਪੈਰਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਚਲਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਥਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: pairaa baajhahu chalanaa vin hathaa karanaa ||
verses.translation: to walk without feet; to work without hands;

verses.original: ਜੀਭੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਇਉ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeebhai baajhahu bolanaa iau jeevat maranaa ||
verses.translation: to speak without a tongue-like this, one remains dead while yet alive.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਤਉ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam pachhaan kai tau khasamai milanaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merge with your Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਿਸੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhisai suneeaai jaaneeaai saau na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: He is seen, heard and known, but His subtle essence is not obtained.

verses.original: ਰੁਹਲਾ ਟੁੰਡਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਗਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ruhalaa Tu(n)ddaa a(n)dhulaa kiau gal lagai dhai ||
verses.translation: How can the lame, armless and blind person run to embrace the Lord?

verses.original: ਭੈ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਭਾਵ ਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai ke charan kar bhaav ke loin surat karei ||
verses.translation: Let the Fear of God be your feet, and let His Love be your hands; let His Understanding be your eyes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ ਇਵ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai siaane'ee iv ka(n)t milaavaa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in this way, O wise soul-bride, you shall be united with your Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa too(n) ek hai tudh dhoojaa khel rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, You are the only One; You set the play of duality in motion.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: haumai garab upai kai lobh a(n)tar ja(n)taa paiaa ||
verses.translation: You created egotism and arrogant pride, and You placed greed within our beings.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too sabh kare teraa karaiaa ||
verses.translation: Keep me as it pleases Your Will; everyone acts as You cause them to act.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa bakhaseh mel laih gurmatee tudhai laiaa ||
verses.translation: Some are forgiven, and merge with You; through the Guru's Teachings, we are joined to You.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik khaRe kareh teree chaakaree vin naavai hor na bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Some stand and serve You; without the Name, nothing else pleases them.

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਾਰ ਵੇਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hor kaar vekaar hai ik sachee kaarai laiaa ||
verses.translation: Any other task would be worthless to them-You have enjoined them to Your True Service.

verses.original: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: put kalat kuTa(n)b hai ik alipat rahe jo tudh bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the midst of children, spouse and relations, some still remain detached; they are pleasing to Your Will.

verses.original: ਓਹਿ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oh a(n)dharahu baaharahu niramale sachai nai samaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, they are pure, and they are absorbed in the True Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੈ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਕਰੀ ਕੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: suine kai parabat gufaa karee kai paanee piaal ||
verses.translation: I may make a cave, in a mountain of gold, or in the water of the nether regions;

verses.original: ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਕੈ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਉਰਧਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kai vich dharatee kai aakaasee uradh rahaa sir bhaar ||
verses.translation: I may remain standing on my head, upside-down, on the earth or up in the sky;

verses.original: ਪੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਾ ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pur kar kaiaa kapaR pahiraa dhovaa sadhaa kaar ||
verses.translation: I may totally cover my body with clothes, and wash them continually;

verses.original: ਬਗਾ ਰਤਾ ਪੀਅਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bagaa rataa peealaa kaalaa bedhaa karee pukaar ||
verses.translation: I may shout out loud, the white, red, yellow and black Vedas;

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਰਹਾ ਮਲੁ ਧਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hoi kucheel rahaa mal dhaaree dhuramat mat vikaar ||
verses.translation: I may even live in dirt and filth. And yet, all this is just a product of evil-mindedness, and intellectual corruption.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਹੋਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa hau naa mai naa hau hovaa naanak sabadh veechaar ||1||
verses.translation: I was not, I am not, and I will never be anything at all! O Nanak, I dwell only on the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਖਾਲਿ ਪਖਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: vasatr pakhaal pakhaale kaiaa aape sa(n)jam hovai ||
verses.translation: They wash their clothes, and scrub their bodies, and try to practice self-discipline.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mail lagee nahee jaanai baaharahu mal mal dhovai ||
verses.translation: But they are not aware of the filth staining their inner being, while they try and try to wash off the outer dirt.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa bhool piaa jam jaale ||
verses.translation: The blind go astray, caught by the noose of Death.

verses.original: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: vasat paraiee apunee kar jaanai haumai vich dhukh ghaale ||
verses.translation: They see other people's property as their own, and in egotism, they suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh haumai tuTai taa har har naam dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the egotism of the Gurmukhs is broken, and then, they meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam jape naamo aaraadhe naame sukh samaavai ||2||
verses.translation: They chant the Naam, meditate on the Naam, and through the Naam, they are absorbed in peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pavaRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa ha(n)s sa(n)jog mel milaiaa ||
verses.translation: Destiny has brought together and united the body and the soul-swan.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin hee keeaa vijog jin upaiaa ||
verses.translation: He who created them, also separates them.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗੁ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh bhoge bhog dhukh sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: The fools enjoy their pleasures; they must also endure all their pains.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਹੁ ਉਠੇ ਰੋਗ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sukhahu uThe rog paap kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: From pleasures, arise diseases and the commission of sins.

verses.original: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: harakhahu sog vijog upai khapaiaa ||
verses.translation: From sinful pleasures come sorrow, separation, birth and death.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh ganat ganai jhagaRaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: The fools try to account for their misdeeds, and argue uselessly.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hath nibeR jhagaR chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: The judgement is in the Hands of the True Guru, who puts an end to the argument.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: karataa kare su hog na chalai chalaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. It cannot be changed by anyone's efforts. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kooR bol muradhaar khai ||
verses.translation: Telling lies, they eat dead bodies.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੀ ਨੋ ਸਮਝਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: avaree no samajhaavan jai ||
verses.translation: And yet, they go out to teach others.

verses.original: ਮੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
verses.translit: muThaa aap muhaae saathai ||
verses.translation: They are deceived, and they deceive their companions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aaisaa aagoo jaapai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, such are the leaders of men. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhai a(n)dhar sach hai so sachaa naam mukh sach alaae ||
verses.translation: Those, within whom the Truth dwells, obtain the True Name; they speak only the Truth.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਦਾ ਹੋਰਨਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: oh har maarag aap chaladhaa horanaa no har maarag paae ||
verses.translation: They walk on the Lord's Path, and inspire others to walk on the Lord's Path as well.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਅਗੈ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਹੈ ਛਪੜਿ ਨਾਤੈ ਸਗਵੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: je agai teerath hoi taa mal lahai chhapaR naatai sagavee mal laae ||
verses.translation: Bathing in a pool of holy water, they are washed clean of filth. But, by bathing in a stagnant pond, they are contaminated with even more filth.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: teerath pooraa satiguroo jo anadhin har har naam dhiaae ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Perfect Pool of Holy Water. Night and day, He meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: oh aap chhuTaa kuTa(n)b siau dhe har har naam sabh sirasaT chhaddaae ||
verses.translation: He is saved, along with his family; bestowing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, He saves the whole world.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo aap japai avaraa naam japaae ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to one who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it as well. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik ka(n)dh mool chun khaeh van kha(n)dd vaasaa ||
verses.translation: Some pick and eat fruits and roots, and live in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਵਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik bhagavaa ves kar fireh jogee sa(n)niaasaa ||
verses.translation: Some wander around wearing saffron robes, as Yogis and Sanyaasees.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar tirasanaa bahut chhaadhan bhojan kee aasaa ||
verses.translation: But there is still so much desire within them-they still yearn for clothes and food.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਨ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: birathaa janam gavai na girahee na udhaasaa ||
verses.translation: They waste their lives uselessly; they are neither householders nor renunciates.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jamakaal sirahu na utarai tirabidh manasaa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death hangs over their heads, and they cannot escape the three-phased desire.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee kaal na aavai neRai jaa hovai dhaasan dhaasaa ||
verses.translation: Death does not even approach those who follow the Guru's Teachings, and become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh sach man ghar hee maeh udhaasaa ||
verses.translation: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their true minds; within the home of their own inner beings, they remain detached.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur sevan aapanaa se aasaa te niraasaa ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who serve their True Guru, rise from desire to desirelessness. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਰਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਕਪੜੈ ਜਾਮਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਲੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: je rat lagai kapaRai jaamaa hoi paleet ||
verses.translation: If one's clothes are stained with blood, the garment becomes polluted.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਰਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo rat peeveh maanasaa tin kiau niramal cheet ||
verses.translation: Those who suck the blood of human beings-how can their consciousness be pure?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਿਲਿ ਹਛੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naau khudhai kaa dhil hachhai mukh leh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant the Name of God, with heart-felt devotion.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਦਿਵਾਜੇ ਦੁਨੀ ਕੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਮਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avar dhivaaje dhunee ke jhooThe amal kareh ||1||
verses.translation: Everything else is just a pompous worldly show, and the practice of false deeds. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa hau naahee taa kiaa aakhaa kih naahee kiaa hovaa ||
verses.translation: Since I am no one, what can I say? Since I am nothing, what can I be?

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਥਨਾ ਭਰਿਆ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa karanaa kahiaa kathanaa bhariaa bhar bhar dhovaa(n) ||
verses.translation: As He created me, so I act. As He causes me to speak, so I speak. I am full and overflowing with sins-if only I could wash them away!

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਾ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਹੋਵਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: aap na bujhaa lok bujhaiee aaisaa aagoo hovaa(n) ||
verses.translation: I do not understand myself, and yet I try to teach others. Such is the guide I am!

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਸੇ ਰਾਹੈ ਸਭਸੁ ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)dhaa hoi kai dhase raahai sabhas muhaae saathai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the one who is blind shows others the way, and misleads all his companions.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ਸੁ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agai giaa muhe muh paeh su aaisaa aagoo jaapai ||2||
verses.translation: But, going to the world hereafter, he shall be beaten and kicked in the face; then, it will be obvious, what sort of guide he was! ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੂੰ ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: maahaa rutee sabh too(n) ghaRee moorat veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through all the months and the seasons, the minutes and the hours, I dwell upon You, O Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਗਣਤੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) ganatai kinai na paio sache alakh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: No one has attained You by clever calculations, O True, Unseen and Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: paRiaa moorakh aakheeaai jis lab lobh aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: That scholar who is full of greed, arrogant pride and egotism, is known to be a fool.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਪੜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naau paReeaai naau bujheeaai gurmatee veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: So read the Name, and realize the Name, and contemplate the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee naam dhan khaTiaa bhagatee bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have earned the wealth of the Naam; I possess the storehouses, overflowing with devotion to the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: niramal naam ma(n)niaa dhar sachai sachiaaraa ||
verses.translation: Believing in the Immaculate Naam, one is hailed as true, in the True Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhaa jeeau paraan hai a(n)tar jot apaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light of the Infinite Lord, who owns the soul and the breath of life, is deep within the inner being.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahu ik too(n) hor jagat vanajaaraa ||6||
verses.translation: You alone are the True Banker, O Lord; the rest of the world is just Your petty trader. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਹਕੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: mihar maseet sidhak musalaa hak halaal kuraan ||
verses.translation: Let mercy be your mosque, faith your prayer-mat, and honest living your Koran.

verses.original: ਸਰਮ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਰੋਜਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: saram su(n)nat seel rojaa hoh musalamaan ||
verses.translation: Make modesty your circumcision, and good conduct your fast. In this way, you shall be a true Muslim.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਬਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਕਲਮਾ ਕਰਮ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: karanee kaabaa sach peer kalamaa karam nivaaj ||
verses.translation: Let good conduct be your Kaabaa, Truth your spiritual guide, and the karma of good deeds your prayer and chant.

verses.original: ਤਸਬੀ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖੈ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tasabee saa tis bhaavasee naanak rakhai laaj ||1||
verses.translation: Let your rosary be that which is pleasing to His Will. O Nanak, God shall preserve your honor. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla

verses.original: ਹਕੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੂਅਰ ਉਸੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hak paraiaa naanakaa us sooar us gai ||
verses.translation: : To take what rightfully belongs to another, is like a Muslim eating pork, or a Hindu eating beef.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਹਾਮਾ ਤਾ ਭਰੇ ਜਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur peer haamaa taa bhare jaa muradhaar na khai ||
verses.translation: Our Guru, our Spiritual Guide, stands by us, if we do not eat those carcasses.

verses.original: ਗਲੀ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: galee bhisat na jaieeaai chhuTai sach kamai ||
verses.translation: By mere talk, people do not earn passage to Heaven. Salvation comes only from the practice of Truth.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਣ ਪਾਹਿ ਹਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maaran paeh haraam meh hoi halaal na jai ||
verses.translation: By adding spices to forbidden foods, they are not made acceptable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਈ ਕੂੜੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak galee kooReeiee kooRo palai pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, from false talk, only falsehood is obtained. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੰਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਵਖਤ ਪੰਜਿ ਪੰਜਾ ਪੰਜੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)j nivaajaa vakhat pa(n)j pa(n)jaa pa(n)je naau ||
verses.translation: There are five prayers and five times of day for prayer; the five have five names.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਲਾਲ ਦੁਇ ਤੀਜਾ ਖੈਰ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pahilaa sach halaal dhui teejaa khair khudhai ||
verses.translation: Let the first be truthfulness, the second honest living, and the third charity in the Name of God.

verses.original: ਚਉਥੀ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਜਵੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chauthee neeat raas man pa(n)javee sifat sanai ||
verses.translation: Let the fourth be good will to all, and the fifth the praise of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਲਮਾ ਆਖਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: karanee kalamaa aakh kai taa musalamaan sadhai ||
verses.translation: Repeat the prayer of good deeds, and then, you may call yourself a Muslim.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jete kooRiaar kooRai kooRee pai ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the false obtain falsehood, and only falsehood. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜਦੇ ਇਕਿ ਕਚੈ ਦੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik ratan padhaarath vanajadhe ik kachai dhe vaapaaraa ||
verses.translation: Some trade in priceless jewels, while others deal in mere glass.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur tuThai paieean a(n)dhar ratan bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is pleased, we find the treasure of the jewel, deep within the self.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: vin gur kinai na ladhiaa a(n)dhe bhauk mue kooRiaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one has found this treasure. The blind and the false have died in their endless wanderings.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhoojai pach mue naa boojheh veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in duality. They do not understand contemplative meditation.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eikas baajhahu dhoojaa ko nahee kis agai kareh pukaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. Unto whom should they complain?

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਸਦਾ ਭਉਕਦੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਰੇ ਤੁਜਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik niradhan sadhaa bhaukadhe ikanaa bhare tujaaraa ||
verses.translation: Some are destitute, and wander around endlessly, while others have storehouses of wealth.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai hor dhan naahee hor bikhiaa sabh chhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without God's Name, there is no other wealth. Everything else is just poison and ashes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak aap karaae kare aap hukam savaaranahaaraa ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself acts, and causes others to act; by the Hukam of His Command, we are embellished and exalted. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵਣੁ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: musalamaan kahaavan musakal jaa hoi taa musalamaan kahaavai ||
verses.translation: It is difficult to be called a Muslim; if one is truly a Muslim, then he may be called one.

verses.original: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਉਲਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਸਕਲ ਮਾਨਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਸਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aval aaul dheen kar miThaa masakal maanaa maal musaavai ||
verses.translation: First, let him savor the religion of the Prophet as sweet; then, let his pride of his possessions be scraped away.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਮੁਸਲਿਮੁ ਦੀਨ ਮੁਹਾਣੈ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hoi musalim dheen muhaanai maran jeevan kaa bharam chukaavai ||
verses.translation: Becoming a true Muslim, a disciple of the faith of Mohammed, let him put aside the delusion of death and life.

verses.original: ਰਬ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: rab kee rajai ma(n)ne sir upar karataa ma(n)ne aap gavaavai ||
verses.translation: As he submits to God's Will, and surrenders to the Creator, he is rid of selfishness and conceit.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਿਹਰੰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau naanak sarab jeeaa mihara(n)mat hoi ta musalamaan kahaavai ||1||
verses.translation: And when, O Nanak, he is merciful to all beings, only then shall he be called a Muslim. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: parahar kaam karodh jhooTh ni(n)dhaa taj maiaa aha(n)kaar chukaavai ||
verses.translation: Renounce sexual desire, anger, falsehood and slander; forsake Maya and eliminate egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: taj kaam kaaminee moh tajai taa a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan paavai ||
verses.translation: Renounce sexual desire and promiscuity, and give up emotional attachment. Only then shall you obtain the Immaculate Lord amidst the darkness of the world.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਤਜਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: taj maan abhimaan preet sut dhaaraa taj piaas aas raam liv laavai ||
verses.translation: Renounce selfishness, conceit and arrogant pride, and your love for your children and spouse. Abandon your thirsty hopes and desires, and embrace love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saachaa man vasai saach sabadh har naam samaavai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True One shall come to dwell in your mind. Through the True Word of the Shabad, you shall be absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਯਤਿ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਹਸੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: raaje rayat sikadhaar koi na rahaseeo ||
verses.translation: Neither the kings, nor their subjects, nor the leaders shall remain.

verses.original: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਹਸੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: haT paTan baajaar hukamee ddahaseeo ||
verses.translation: The shops, the cities and the streets shall eventually disintegrate, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਪਕੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: pake ba(n)k dhuaar moorakh jaanai aapane ||
verses.translation: Those solid and beautiful mansions-the fools think that they belong to them.

verses.original: ਦਰਬਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਰੀਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: dharab bhare bha(n)ddaar reete ik khane ||
verses.translation: The treasure-houses, filled with wealth, shall be emptied out in an instant.

verses.original: ਤਾਜੀ ਰਥ ਤੁਖਾਰ ਹਾਥੀ ਪਾਖਰੇ ॥ ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ਕਿਥੈ ਸਿ ਆਪਣੇ ॥ ਤੰਬੂ ਪਲੰਘ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਲਾਲਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: taajee rath tukhaar haathee paakhare || baag milakh ghar baar kithai s aapane || ta(n)boo pala(n)gh nivaar saraiche laalatee ||
verses.translation: The horses, chariots, camels and elephants, with all their decorations; the gardens, lands, houses, tents, soft beds and satin pavilions-Oh, where are those things, which they believe to be their own?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਿਨਾਖਤੁ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak sach dhaataar sinaakhat kudharatee ||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True One is the Giver of all; He is revealed through His All-powerful Creative Nature. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਦੀਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਧੇਣਵਾ ਸੁੰਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਘੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: nadheeaa hoveh dhenavaa su(n)m hoveh dhudh gheeau ||
verses.translation: If the rivers became cows, giving milk, and the spring water became milk and ghee;

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਕਰ ਹੋਵੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee dharatee sakar hovai khusee kare nit jeeau ||
verses.translation: If all the earth became sugar, to continually excite the mind;

verses.original: ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: parabat suinaa rupaa hovai heere laal jaRaau ||
verses.translation: if the mountains became gold and silver, studded with gems and jewels

verses.original: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhee too(n)hai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||1||
verses.translation: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਰੁੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaar aThaareh mevaa hovai garuRaa hoi suaau ||
verses.translation: If all the eighteen loads of vegetation became fruits,

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui firadhe rakhe'eeh nihachal hovai thaau ||
verses.translation: and the growing grass became sweet rice; if I were able to stop the sun and the moon in their orbits and hold them perfectly steady

verses.original: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhee too(n)hai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||2||
verses.translation: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਦੇਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਾਪ ਗਰਹ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: je dhehai dhukh laieeaai paap gareh dhui raahu ||
verses.translation: If my body were afflicted with pain, under the evil influence of unlucky stars;

verses.original: ਰਤੁ ਪੀਣੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rat peene raaje sirai upar rakhe'eeh evai jaapai bhaau ||
verses.translation: and if the blood-sucking kings were to hold power over me

verses.original: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhee too(n)hai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||3||
verses.translation: -even if this were my condition, I would still worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||3||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਗੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: agee paalaa kapaR hovai khaanaa hovai vaau ||
verses.translation: If fire and ice were my clothes, and the wind was my food;

verses.original: ਸੁਰਗੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੋ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: suragai dheeaa mohaneeaa isatareeaa hovan naanak sabho jaau ||
verses.translation: and even if the enticing heavenly beauties were my wives, O Nanak-all this shall pass away!

verses.original: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bhee toohai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||4||
verses.translation: Even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pavaRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਗੈਬਾਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ॥
verses.translit: badhafailee gaibaanaa khasam na jaaniee ||
verses.translation: The foolish demon, who does evil deeds, does not know his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ॥
verses.translit: so kaheeaai dhevaanaa aap na pachhaaniee ||
verses.translation: Call him a mad-man, if he does not understand himself.

verses.original: ਕਲਹਿ ਬੁਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਵਾਦੇ ਖਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kaleh buree sa(n)saar vaadhe khapeeaai ||
verses.translation: The strife of this world is evil; these struggles are consuming it.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਪਚੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai vekaar bharame pacheeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, life is worthless. Through doubt, the people are being destroyed.

verses.original: ਰਾਹ ਦੋਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਝਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: raeh dhovai ik jaanai soiee sijhasee ||
verses.translation: One who recognizes that all spiritual paths lead to the One shall be emancipated.

verses.original: ਕੁਫਰ ਗੋਅ ਕੁਫਰਾਣੈ ਪਇਆ ਦਝਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kufar goa kufaraanai piaa dhajhasee ||
verses.translation: One who speaks lies shall fall into hell and burn.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੁਬਹਾਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhuneeaa subahaan sach samaieeaai ||
verses.translation: In all the world, the most blessed and sanctified are those who remain absorbed in Truth.

verses.original: ਸਿਝੈ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਵਾਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sijhai dhar dheevaan aap gavaieeaai ||9||
verses.translation: One who eliminates selfishness and conceit is redeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਮਃ ੧ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa salok ||
verses.translation: First Mehla, Shalok:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: so jeeviaa jis man vasiaa soi ||
verses.translation: They alone are truly alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak avar na jeevai koi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, no one else is truly alive;

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜੀਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਲਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je jeevai pat lathee jai ||
verses.translation: those who merely live shall depart in dishonor;

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਹਰਾਮੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh haraam jetaa kichh khai ||
verses.translation: everything they eat is impure.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਲਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਨਚੈ ਨੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: raaj ra(n)g maal ra(n)g || ra(n)g rataa nachai na(n)g ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with power and thrilled with wealth, they delight in their pleasures, and dance about shamelessly.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak Thagiaa muThaa jai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are deluded and defrauded.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vin naavai pat giaa gavai ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, they lose their honor and depart. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਖਾਧੈ ਕਿਆ ਪੈਧੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa khaadhai kiaa paidhai hoi ||
verses.translation: What good is food, and what good are clothes,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa man naahee sachaa soi ||
verses.translation: if the True Lord does not abide within the mind?

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਮੇਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਘਿਉ ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੈਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa mevaa kiaa ghiau guR miThaa kiaa maidhaa kiaa maas ||
verses.translation: What good are fruits, what good is ghee, sweet jaggery, what good is flour, and what good is meat?

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa kapaR kiaa sej sukhaalee keejeh bhog bilaas ||
verses.translation: What good are clothes, and what good is a soft bed, to enjoy pleasures and sensual delights?

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਲਸਕਰ ਕਿਆ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸੀ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa lasakar kiaa neb khavaasee aavai mahalee vaas ||
verses.translation: What good is an army, and what good are soldiers, servants and mansions to live in?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੇ ਟੋਲ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam vin sabhe Tol vinaas ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, all this paraphernalia shall disappear. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pavaRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਾਤੀ ਦੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਥਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jaatee dhai kiaa hath sach parakheeaai ||
verses.translation: What good is social class and status? Truthfulness is measured within.

verses.original: ਮਹੁਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਥਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਚਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mahuraa hovai hath mareeaai chakheeaai ||
verses.translation: Pride in one's status is like poison-holding it in your hand and eating it, you shall die.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sache kee sirakaar jug jug jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: The True Lord's Sovereign Rule is known throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰਦਾਰੁ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hukam ma(n)ne siradhaar dhar dheebaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: One who respects the Hukam of the Lord's Command is honored and respected in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਰ ਖਸਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: furamaanee hai kaar khasam paThaiaa ||
verses.translation: By the Order of our Lord and Master, we have been brought into this world.

verses.original: ਤਬਲਬਾਜ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tabalabaaj beechaar sabadh sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Drummer, the Guru, has announced the Lord's meditation, through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਏ ਅਸਵਾਰ ਇਕਨਾ ਸਾਖਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik hoe asavaar ikanaa saakhatee ||
verses.translation: Some have mounted their horses in response, and others are saddling up.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੀ ਬਧੇ ਭਾਰ ਇਕਨਾ ਤਾਖਤੀ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: eikanee badhe bhaar ikanaa taakhatee ||10||
verses.translation: Some have tied up their bridles, and others have already ridden off. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਪਕਾ ਤਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਰਹੀ ਸੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਵਾੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa pakaa taa kaTiaa rahee su palar vaaR ||
verses.translation: When the crop is ripe, then it is cut down; only the stalks are left standing.

verses.original: ਸਣੁ ਕੀਸਾਰਾ ਚਿਥਿਆ ਕਣੁ ਲਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਝਾੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: san keesaaraa chithiaa kan liaa tan jhaaR ||
verses.translation: The corn on the cob is put into the thresher, and the kernels are separated from the cobs.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਚਕੀ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣ ਆਇ ਬਹਿਠੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhui puR chakee joR kai peesan aai bahiTh ||
verses.translation: Placing the kernels between the two mill-stones, people sit and grind the corn.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੁ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਬੁ ਡਿਠੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo dhar rahe su ubare naanak ajab ddiTh ||1||
verses.translation: Those kernels which stick to the central axle are spared-Nanak has seen this wonderful vision! ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵੇਖੁ ਜਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਬਧਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vekh j miThaa kaTiaa kaT kuT badhaa pai ||
verses.translation: Look, and see how the sugar-cane is cut down. After cutting away its branches, its feet are bound together into bundles,

verses.original: ਖੁੰਢਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਮਲ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khu(n)ddaa a(n)dhar rakh kai dhen su mal sajai ||
verses.translation: and then, it is placed between the wooden rollers and crushed.

verses.original: ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਟਟਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਪੈ ਤੈ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ras kas TaTar paieeaai tapai tai vilalai ||
verses.translation: What punishment is inflicted upon it! Its juice is extracted and placed in the cauldron; as it is heated, it groans and cries out.

verses.original: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਫੋਗੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਦਿਚੈ ਅਗਿ ਜਾਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhee so fog samaaleeaai dhichai ag jaalai ||
verses.translation: And then, the crushed cane is collected and burnt in the fire below.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਠੈ ਪਤਰੀਐ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak miThai patareeaai vekhahu lokaa aai ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak: come, people, and see how the sweet sugar-cane is treated! ||2||

verses.original: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pavaRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਸ ਘਣੇਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa maran na chit aas ghaneriaa ||
verses.translation: Some do not think of death; they entertain great hopes.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mar mar ja(n)meh nit kisai na keriaa ||
verses.translation: They die, and are re-born, and die, over and over again. They are of no use at all!

verses.original: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹਨਿ ਚੰਗੇਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaRai man chit kahan cha(n)geriaa ||
verses.translation: In their conscious minds, they call themselves good.

verses.original: ਜਮਰਾਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੇਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jamaraajai nit nit manmukh heriaa ||
verses.translation: The King of the Angels of Death hunts down those self-willed manmukhs, over and over again.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲੂਣ ਹਾਰਾਮ ਕਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh loon haaraam kiaa na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The manmukhs are false to their own selves; they feel no gratitude for what they have been given.

verses.original: ਬਧੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਲਾਮ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: badhe karan salaam khasam na bhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Those who merely perform rituals of worship are not pleasing to their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach milai mukh naam saahib bhaavasee ||
verses.translation: Those who attain the True Lord and chant His Name are pleasing to the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਸਨਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸੀ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: karasan takhat salaam likhiaa paavasee ||11||
verses.translation: They worship the Lord and bow at His Throne. They fulfill their pre-ordained destiny. ||11||

verses.original: ਮਃ ੧ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa salok ||
verses.translation: First Mehla, Shalok:

verses.original: ਮਛੀ ਤਾਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਕਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: machhee taaroo kiaa kare pa(n)khee kiaa aakaas ||
verses.translation: What can deep water do to a fish? What can the vast sky do to a bird?

verses.original: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਸਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: pathar paalaa kiaa kare khusare kiaa ghar vaas ||
verses.translation: What can cold do to a stone? What is married life to a eunuch?

verses.original: ਕੁਤੇ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਕੁਤੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kute cha(n)dhan laieeaai bhee so kutee dhaat ||
verses.translation: You may apply sandalwood oil to a dog, but he will still be a dog.

verses.original: ਬੋਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠ ॥
verses.translit: bolaa je samajhaieeaai paRe'eh si(n)mirat paaTh ||
verses.translation: You may try to teach a deaf person by reading the Simritees to him, but how will he learn?

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਦੀਵੇ ਬਲਹਿ ਪਚਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa chaanan rakheeaai dheeve baleh pachaas ||
verses.translation: You may place a light before a blind man and burn fifty lamps, but how will he see?

verses.original: ਚਉਣੇ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਵੈ ਘਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaune suinaa paieeaai chun chun khaavai ghaas ||
verses.translation: You may place gold before a herd of cattle, but they will pick out the grass to eat.

verses.original: ਲੋਹਾ ਮਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਢਹੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਪਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: lohaa maaran paieeaai ddahai na hoi kapaas ||
verses.translation: You may add flux to iron and melt it, but it will not become soft like cotton.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖ ਏਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak moorakh eh gun bole sadhaa vinaas ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this is the nature of a fool-everything he speaks is useless and wasted. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੈਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaihaa ka(n)chan tuTai saar ||
verses.translation: When pieces of bronze or gold or iron break,

verses.original: ਅਗਨੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਏ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aganee ga(n)dd paae lohaar ||
verses.translation: the metal-smith welds them together again in the fire, and the bond is established.

verses.original: ਗੋਰੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਤੁਟੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: goree setee tuTai bhataar ||
verses.translation: If a husband leaves his wife,

verses.original: ਪੁਤਂੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: puta(n)ee ga(n)dd pavai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: their children may bring them back together in the world, and the bond is established.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa ma(n)gai dhitai ga(n)dd pai ||
verses.translation: When the king makes a demand, and it is met, the bond is established.

verses.original: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਜਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhukhiaa ga(n)dd pavai jaa khai ||
verses.translation: When the hungry man eats, he is satisfied, and the bond is established.

verses.original: ਕਾਲਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਨਦੀਆ ਮੀਹ ਝੋਲ ॥
verses.translit: kaalaa ga(n)dd nadheeaa meeh jhol ||
verses.translation: In the famine, the rain fills the streams to overflowing, and the bond is established.

verses.original: ਗੰਢੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ ਮਿਠੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)dd pareetee miThe bol ||
verses.translation: There is a bond between love and words of sweetness.

verses.original: ਬੇਦਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bedhaa ga(n)dd bole sach koi ||
verses.translation: When one speaks the Truth, a bond is established with the Holy Scriptures.

verses.original: ਮੁਇਆ ਗੰਢੁ ਨੇਕੀ ਸਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: muiaa ga(n)dd nekee sat hoi ||
verses.translation: Through goodness and truth, the dead establish a bond with the living.

verses.original: ਏਤੁ ਗੰਢਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: et ga(n)dd varatai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Such are the bonds which prevail in the world.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh ga(n)dd pavai muh maar ||
verses.translation: The fool establishes his bonds only when he is slapped in the face.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhai eh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Nanak says this after deep reflection:

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sifatee ga(n)dd pavai dharabaar ||2||
verses.translation: through the Lord's Praise, we establish a bond with His Court. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape kudharat saaj kai aape kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself created and adorned the Universe, and He Himself contemplates it.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik khoTe ik khare aape parakhanahaar ||
verses.translation: Some are counterfeit, and some are genuine. He Himself is the Appraiser.

verses.original: ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਹਰ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: khare khajaanai paie'eeh khoTe saTe'eeh baahar vaar ||
verses.translation: The genuine are placed in His Treasury, while the counterfeit are thrown away.

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਟੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: khoTe sachee dharageh suTe'eeh kis aagai kareh pukaar ||
verses.translation: The counterfeit are thrown out of the True Court-unto whom should they complain?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur pichhai bhaj paveh ehaa karanee saar ||
verses.translation: They should worship and follow the True Guru-this is the lifestyle of excellence.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਟਿਅਹੁ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur khoTiahu khare kare sabadh savaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru converts the counterfeit into genuine; through the Word of the Shabad, He embellishes and exalts us.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sachee dharageh ma(n)neean gur kai prem piaar ||
verses.translation: Those who have enshrined love and affection for the Guru, are honored in the True Court.

verses.original: ਗਣਤ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: ganat tinaa dhee ko kiaa kare jo aap bakhase karataar ||12||
verses.translation: Who can estimate the value of those who have been forgiven by the Creator Lord Himself? ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਪੀਰਾ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ham jer jimee dhuneeaa peeraa masaikaa raiaa ||
verses.translation: All the spiritual teachers, their disciples and the rulers of the world shall be buried under the ground.

verses.original: ਮੇ ਰਵਦਿ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹਾ ਅਫਜੂ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: me ravadh baadhisaahaa afajoo khudhai ||
verses.translation: The emperors shall also pass away; God alone is Eternal.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek toohee ek tuhee ||1||
verses.translation: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵਾ ਨਰਾ ॥ ਨ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: n dhev dhaanavaa naraa || na sidh saadhikaa dharaa ||
verses.translation: Neither the angels, nor the demons, nor human beings, nor the Siddhas, nor the seekers shall remain on the earth.

verses.original: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਦਿਗਰਿ ਕੁਈ ॥
verses.translit: asat ek dhigar kuiee ||
verses.translation: Who else is there?

verses.original: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ek tuiee ek tuiee ||2||
verses.translation: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨ ਦਾਦੇ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਆਦਮੀ ॥ ਨ ਸਪਤ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: n dhaadhe dhiha(n)dh aadhamee || na sapat jer jimee ||
verses.translation: Neither the just, nor the generous, nor any humans at all, nor the seven realms beneath the earth, shall remain.

verses.original: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਦਿਗਰਿ ਕੁਈ ॥
verses.translit: asat ek dhigar kuiee ||
verses.translation: The One Lord alone exists. Who else is there?

verses.original: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek tuiee ek tuiee ||3||
verses.translation: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||3||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨ ਸੂਰ ਸਸਿ ਮੰਡਲੋ ॥ ਨ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਨਹ ਜਲੋ ॥ ਅੰਨ ਪਉਣ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਕੁਈ ॥
verses.translit: n soor sas ma(n)ddalo || na sapat dheep neh jalo || a(n)n paun thir na kuiee ||
verses.translation: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the planets, nor the seven continents, nor the oceans, nor food, nor the wind-nothing is permanent.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ek tuiee ek tuiee ||4||
verses.translation: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||4||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦਸਤ ਆ ਕਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: n rijak dhasat aa kase ||
verses.translation: Our sustenance is not in the hands of any person.

verses.original: ਹਮਾ ਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਆਸ ਵਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: hamaa raa ek aas vase ||
verses.translation: The hopes of all rest in the One Lord.

verses.original: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਗਰ ਕੁਈ ॥
verses.translit: asat ek dhigar kuiee ||
verses.translation: The One Lord alone exists-who else is there?

verses.original: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ek tuiee ek tuiee ||5||
verses.translation: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||5||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਰੰਦਏ ਨ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਜਰ ॥
verses.translit: para(n)dhe na giraeh jar ||
verses.translation: The birds have no money in their pockets.

verses.original: ਦਰਖਤ ਆਬ ਆਸ ਕਰ ॥
verses.translit: dharakhat aab aas kar ||
verses.translation: They place their hopes on trees and water.

verses.original: ਦਿਹੰਦ ਸੁਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhiha(n)dh suiee ||
verses.translation: He alone is the Giver.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ek tuiee ek tuiee ||6||
verses.translation: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||6||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਲਾਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak lilaar likhiaa soi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that destiny which is pre-ordained and written on one's forehead

verses.original: ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: meT na saakai koi ||
verses.translation: no one can erase it.

verses.original: ਕਲਾ ਧਰੈ ਹਿਰੈ ਸੁਈ ॥
verses.translit: kalaa dharai hirai suiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord infuses strength, and He takes it away again.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ek tuiee ek tuiee ||7||
verses.translation: You alone, O Lord, You alone. ||7||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
