verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa teraa hukam gurmukh jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: True is the Hukam of Your Command. To the Gurmukh, it is known.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee aap gavai sach pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, selfishness and conceit are eradicated, and the Truth is realized.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach teraa dharabaar sabadh neesaaniaa ||
verses.translation: True is Your Court. It is proclaimed and revealed through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh veechaar sach samaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating deeply on the True Word of the Shabad, I have merged into the Truth.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh sadhaa kooRiaar bharam bhulaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are always false; they are deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: visaTaa a(n)dhar vaas saadh na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: They dwell in manure, and they do not know the taste of the Name.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai dhukh pai aavan jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, they suffer the agonies of coming and going.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak paarakh aap jin khoTaa kharaa pachhaaniaa ||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Appraiser, who distinguishes the counterfeit from the genuine. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੀਹਾ ਬਾਜਾ ਚਰਗਾ ਕੁਹੀਆ ਏਨਾ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਘਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: seehaa baajaa charagaa kuheeaa enaa khavaale ghaeh ||
verses.translation: Tigers, hawks, falcons and eagles-the Lord could make them eat grass.

verses.original: ਘਾਹੁ ਖਾਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: ghaahu khaan tinaa maas khavaale eh chalaae raeh ||
verses.translation: And those animals which eat grass-He could make them eat meat. He could make them follow this way of life.

verses.original: ਨਦੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਟਿਬੇ ਦੇਖਾਲੇ ਥਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: nadheeaa vich Tibe dhekhaale thalee kare asagaeh ||
verses.translation: He could raise dry land from the rivers, and turn the deserts into bottomless oceans.

verses.original: ਕੀੜਾ ਥਾਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਲਸਕਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: keeRaa thaap dhei paatisaahee lasakar kare suaaeh ||
verses.translation: He could appoint a worm as king, and reduce an army to ashes.

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਲੈ ਸਾਹਾ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਕਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: jete jeea jeeveh lai saahaa jeevaale taa k asaeh ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures live by breathing, but He could keep us alive, even without the breath.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਦੇਇ ਗਿਰਾਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jiau jiau sache bhaavai tiau tiau dhei giraeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as it pleases the True Lord, He gives us sustenance. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮਾਸਹਾਰੀ ਇਕਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik maasahaaree ik tiran khaeh ||
verses.translation: Some eat meat, while others eat grass.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa chhateeh a(n)mirat paeh ||
verses.translation: Some have all the thirty-six varieties of delicacies,

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮਿਟੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਟੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik miTeeaa meh miTeeaa khaeh ||
verses.translation: while others live in the dirt and eat mud.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਪਉਣ ਸੁਮਾਰੀ ਪਉਣ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik paun sumaaree paun sumaar ||
verses.translation: Some control the breath, and regulate their breathing.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik nira(n)kaaree naam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Some live by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeevai dhaataa marai na koi ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver lives; no one dies.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak muThe jaeh naahee man soi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who do not enshrine the Lord within their minds are deluded. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kee kaar karam kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: By the karma of good actions, some come to serve the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee aap gavai naam dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, some eliminate selfishness and conceit, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojee kaarai lag janam gavaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Undertaking any other task, they waste their lives in vain.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਵਿਸੁ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai sabh vis paijhai khaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, all that they wear and eat is poison.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh saalaeh sach samaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Praising the True Word of the Shabad, they merge with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vin satigur seve naahee sukh nivaas fir fir aaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, they do not obtain the home of peace; they are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa khoTee raas kooR kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Investing counterfeit capital, they earn only falsehood in the world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sach kharaa saalaeh pat siau jaieeaai ||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, singing the Praises of the Pure, True Lord, they depart with honor. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਵਾਵਹਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai taa vaaveh gaaveh tudh bhaavai jal naaveh ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, we play music and sing; when it pleases You, we bathe in water.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaaveh taa kareh bibhootaa si(n)n(g)ee naadh vajaaveh ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, we smear our bodies with ashes, and blow the horn and the conch shell.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਮੁਲਾ ਸੇਖ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaavai taa paReh katebaa mulaa sekh kahaaveh ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, we read the Islamic Scriptures, and are acclaimed as Mullahs and Shaykhs.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaavai taa hoveh raaje ras kas bahut kamaaveh ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, we become kings, and enjoy all sorts of tastes and pleasures.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਰ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaavai teg vagaaveh sir mu(n)ddee kaT jaaveh ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, we wield the sword, and cut off the heads of our enemies.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaavai jaeh dhisa(n)tar sun galaa ghar aaveh ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, we go out to foreign lands; hearing news of home, we come back again.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaavai nai rachaaveh tudh bhaane too(n) bhaaveh ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, we are attuned to the Name, and when it pleases You, we become pleasing to You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee hor sagale kooR kamaaveh ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak utters this one prayer; everything else is just the practice of falsehood. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਸਭਿ ਵਡਿਆਂਈਆ ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too(n) vaddaa sabh vaddiaa(n)ieeaa cha(n)gai cha(n)gaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: You are so Great-all Greatness flows from You. You are So Good-Goodness radiates from You.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too(n) sachaa taa sabh ko sachaa kooRaa koi na koiee ||
verses.translation: You are True-all that flows from You is True. Nothing at all is false.

verses.original: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਚਲਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan vekhan bolan chalan jeevan maranaa dhaat ||
verses.translation: Talking, seeing, speaking, walking, living and dying-all these are transitory.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hukam saaj hukamai vich rakhai naanak sachaa aap ||2||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates, and in His Command, He keeps us. O Nanak, He Himself is True. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev nisa(n)g bharam chukaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Serve the True Guru fearlessly, and your doubt shall be dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਕਾਰ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur aakhai kaar su kaar kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Do that work which the True Guru asks you to do.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hoi dhiaal ta naam dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru becomes merciful, we meditate on the Naam.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa bhagat su saar gurmukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The profit of devotional worship is excellent. It is obtained by the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kooR gubaar kooR kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are trapped in the darkness of falsehood; they practice nothing but falsehood.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਦੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਚਵਾਂਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sache dhai dhar jai sach chavaa(n)ieeaai ||
verses.translation: Go to the Gate of Truth, and speak the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sachai a(n)dhar mahal sach bulaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The True Lord calls the true ones to the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak sach sadhaa sachiaar sach samaieeaai ||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the true ones are forever true; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਕਾਸਾਈ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੰਖ ਕਰਿ ਉਡਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kal kaatee raaje kaasaiee dharam pa(n)kh kar uddariaa ||
verses.translation: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the knife, and the kings are butchers; righteousness has sprouted wings and flown away.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਸਚੁ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹ ਚੜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kooR amaavas sach cha(n)dhramaa dheesai naahee keh chaRiaa ||
verses.translation: In this dark night of falsehood, the moon of Truth is not visible anywhere.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਭਾਲਿ ਵਿਕੁੰਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਆਧੇਰੈ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: hau bhaal viku(n)nee hoiee || aadherai raahu na koiee ||
verses.translation: I have searched in vain, and I am so confused; in this darkness, I cannot find the path.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: vich haumai kar dhukh roiee ||
verses.translation: In egotism, they cry out in pain.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak kin bidh gat hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, how will they be saved? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kal keerat paragaT chaanan sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has appeared as a Light in the world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh koiee utarai paar ||
verses.translation: How rare are those few Gurmukhs who swim across to the other side!

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare tis dhevai ||
verses.translation: The Lord bestows His Glance of Grace;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh ratan so levai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh receives the jewel. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਤੈ ਸੈਸਾਰੀਆ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa tai saisaareeaa joR kadhe na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Between the Lord's devotees and the people of the world, there can never be any true alliance.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: karataa aap abhul hai na bhulai kisai dhaa bhulaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself is infallible. He cannot be fooled; no one can fool Him.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat aape melian jinee sacho sach kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: He blends His devotees with Himself; they practice Truth, and only Truth.

verses.original: ਸੈਸਾਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saisaaree aap khuaaian jinee kooR bol bol bikh khaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself leads the people of the world astray; they tell lies, and by telling lies, they eat poison.

verses.original: ਚਲਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chalan saar na jaananee kaam karodh vis vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: They do not recognize the ultimate reality, that we all must go; they continue to cultivate the poisons of sexual desire and anger.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਕਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat karan har chaakaree jinee anadhin naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: The devotees serve the Lord; night and day, they meditate on the Naam.

verses.original: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhaasan dhaas hoi kai jinee vichahu aap gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Becoming the slaves of the Lord's slaves, they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: onaa khasamai kai dhar mukh ujale sachai sabadh suhaiaa ||16||
verses.translation: In the Court of their Lord and Master, their faces are radiant; they are embellished and exalted with the True Word of the Shabad. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabaahee saalaeh jinee dhiaaiaa ik man ||
verses.translation: Those who praise the Lord in the early hours of the morning and meditate on Him single-mindedly,

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਖਤੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਮੁਏ ॥
verses.translit: seiee poore saeh vakhatai upar laR mue ||
verses.translation: are the perfect kings; at the right time, they die fighting.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਰਾਹ ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਮਤੀ ਖਿੰਡੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bahute raeh man keeaa matee khi(n)ddeeaa ||
verses.translation: In the second watch, the focus of the mind is scattered in all sorts of ways.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਏ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਹਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bahut pe asagaeh gote khaeh na nikaleh ||
verses.translation: So many fall into the bottomless pit; they are dragged under, and they cannot get out again.

verses.original: ਤੀਜੈ ਮੁਹੀ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਖਾ ਦੁਇ ਭਉਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: teejai muhee giraeh bhukh tikhaa dhui bhaukeeaa ||
verses.translation: In the third watch, both hunger and thirst bark for attention, and food is put into the mouth.

verses.original: ਖਾਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਹ ਭੀ ਖਾਣੇ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: khaadhaa hoi suaaeh bhee khaane siau dhosatee ||
verses.translation: That which is eaten becomes dust, but they are still attached to eating.

verses.original: ਚਉਥੈ ਆਈ ਊਂਘ ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਪਵਾਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chauthai aaiee uoo(n)gh akhee meeT pavaar giaa ||
verses.translation: In the fourth watch, they become drowsy. They close their eyes and begin to dream.

verses.original: ਭੀ ਉਠਿ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਵਾਦੁ ਸੈ ਵਰਿੑਆ ਕੀ ਪਿੜ ਬਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhee uTh rachion vaadh sai vari(h)aa kee piR badhee ||
verses.translation: Rising up again, they engage in conflicts; they set the stage as if they will live for 100 years.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੇ ਅਠੀ ਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe velaa vakhat sabh je aThee bhau hoi ||
verses.translation: If at all times, at each and every moment, they live in the fear of God

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saahib man vasai sachaa naavan hoi ||1||
verses.translation: -O Nanak, the Lord dwells within their minds, and their cleansing bath is true. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: seiee poore saeh jinee pooraa paiaa ||
verses.translation: They are the perfect kings, who have found the Perfect Lord.

verses.original: ਅਠੀ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: aThee veparavaeh rahan ikatai ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, they remain unconcerned, imbued with the Love of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਥਾਹ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan roop athaeh virale paie'eeh ||
verses.translation: Only a few obtain the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Unimaginably Beauteous Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: karam poorai pooraa guroo pooraa jaa kaa bol ||
verses.translation: Through the perfect karma of good deeds, one meets the Perfect Guru, whose speech is perfect.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak pooraa je kare ghaTai naahee tol ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Guru makes one perfect, one's weight does not decrease. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too(n) taa kiaa hor mai sach sunaieeaai ||
verses.translation: When You are with me, what more could I want? I speak only the Truth.

verses.original: ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: muThee dha(n)dhai chor mahal na paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Plundered by the thieves of worldly affairs, she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਏਨੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: enai chit kaThor sev gavaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Being so stone-hearted, she has lost her chance to serve the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਸੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jit ghaT sach na pai su bha(n)n ghaRaieeaai ||
verses.translation: That heart, in which the True Lord is not found, should be torn down and re-built.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਟਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar poorai vaT tol tulaieeaai ||
verses.translation: How can she be weighed accurately, upon the scale of perfection?

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਘਟਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: koi na aakhai ghaT haumai jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: No one will say that her weight has been shorted, if she rids herself of egotism.

verses.original: ਲਈਅਨਿ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਦਰਿ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: lieean khare parakh dhar beenaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The genuine are assayed, and accepted in the Court of the All-knowing Lord.

verses.original: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: saudhaa ikat haT poorai gur paieeaai ||17||
verses.translation: The genuine merchandise is found only in one shop-it is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਠੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਅਠ ਖੰਡ ਨਾਵਾ ਖੰਡੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aThee paharee aTh kha(n)dd naavaa kha(n)dd sareer ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, destroy the eight things, and in the ninth place, conquer the body.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich nau nidh naam ek bhaaleh gunee gaheer ||
verses.translation: Within the body are the nine treasures of the Name of the Lord-seek the depths of these virtues.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karamava(n)tee saalaahiaa naanak kar gur peer ||
verses.translation: Those blessed with the karma of good actions praise the Lord. O Nanak, they make the Guru their spiritual teacher.

verses.original: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰਿ ਸਬਾਹ ਕੈ ਸੁਰਤਿਆ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chauthai pahar sabaeh kai suratiaa upajai chaau ||
verses.translation: In the fourth watch of the early morning hours, a longing arises in their higher consciousness.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰੀਆਵਾ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tinaa dhareeaavaa siau dhosatee man mukh sachaa naau ||
verses.translation: They are attuned to the river of life; the True Name is in their minds and on their lips.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: othai a(n)mrit va(n)ddeeaai karamee hoi pasaau ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar is distributed, and those with good karma receive this gift.

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਸੀਐ ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan kaiaa kaseeaai va(n)nee chaRai chaRaau ||
verses.translation: Their bodies become golden, and take on the color of spirituality.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਤਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je hovai nadhar saraaf kee bahuR na paiee taau ||
verses.translation: If the Jeweller casts His Glance of Grace, they are not placed in the fire again.

verses.original: ਸਤੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਬਹੀਐ ਪੜਿਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: satee paharee sat bhalaa baheeaai paRiaa paas ||
verses.translation: Throughout the other seven watches of the day, it is good to speak the Truth, and sit with the spiritually wise.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਘਟੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: othai paap pu(n)n beechaareeaai kooRai ghaTai raas ||
verses.translation: There, vice and virtue are distinguished, and the capital of falsehood is decreased.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਖਰੇ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: othai khoTe saTe'eeh khare keecheh saabaas ||
verses.translation: There, the counterfeit are cast aside, and the genuine are cheered.

verses.original: ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਾਦਲੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bolan faadhal naanakaa dhukh sukh khasamai paas ||1||
verses.translation: Speech is vain and useless. O Nanak, pain and pleasure are in the power of our Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: paun guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
verses.translation: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhinas raat dhui dhaiee dhaiaa khelai sagal jagat ||
verses.translation: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.

verses.original: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਵਾਚੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)giaaieeaa buriaaieeaa vaache dharam hadhoor ||
verses.translation: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke dhoor ||
verses.translation: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee naam dhiaaiaa ge masakat ghaal ||
verses.translation: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brow

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak te mukh ujale hor ketee chhuTee naal ||2||
verses.translation: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many others are saved along with them! ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa bhojan bhaau satigur dhasiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Food is the Love of the Lord; the True Guru has spoken.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sache hee pateeaai sach vigasiaa ||
verses.translation: With this True Food, I am satisfied, and with the Truth, I am delighted.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰਾਂਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachai koT giraa(n)i nij ghar vasiaa ||
verses.translation: True are the cities and the villages, where one abides in the True Home of the self.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਾਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur tuThai naau prem rahasiaa ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is pleased, one receives the Lord's Name, and blossoms forth in His Love.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਦੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sachai dhai dheebaan kooR na jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: No one enters the Court of the True Lord through falsehood.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTho jhooTh vakhaan su mahal khuaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: By uttering falsehood and only falsehood, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh neesaan Thaak na paieeaai ||
verses.translation: No one blocks the way of those who are blessed with the Banner of the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: sach sun bujh vakhaan mahal bulaieeaai ||18||
verses.translation: Hearing, understanding and speaking Truth, one is called to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਰਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pahiraa agan hivai ghar baadhaa bhojan saar karaiee ||
verses.translation: If I dressed myself in fire, and built my house of snow, and made iron my food;

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਾਕ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sagale dhookh paanee kar peevaa dharatee haak chalaiee ||
verses.translation: and if I were to drink in all pain like water, and drive the entire earth before me;

verses.original: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਤੋਲੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhar taaraajee a(n)bar tolee pichhai Ta(n)k chaRaiee ||
verses.translation: and if I were to place the earth upon a scale and balance it with a single copper coin;

verses.original: ਏਵਡੁ ਵਧਾ ਮਾਵਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਨਥਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: evadd vadhaa maavaa naahee sabhasai nath chalaiee ||
verses.translation: and if I were to become so great that I could not be contained, and if I were to control and lead all;

verses.original: ਏਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: etaa taan hovai man a(n)dhar karee bh aakh karaiee ||
verses.translation: and if I were to possess so much power within my mind that I could cause others to do my bidding-so what?

verses.original: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਤੇਵਡ ਦਾਤੀ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jevadd saahib tevadd dhaatee dhe dhe kare rajaiee ||
verses.translation: As Great as our Lord and Master is, so great are His gifts. He bestows them according to His Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nadhar kare jis upar sach naam vaddiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਜਿਆ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਨ ਰਜੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan aakh na rajiaa sunan na raje ka(n)n ||
verses.translation: The mouth is not satisfied by speaking, and the ears are not satisfied by hearing.

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕ ਇਕ ਵੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: akhee dhekh na rajeeaa gun gaahak ik va(n)n ||
verses.translation: The eyes are not satisfied by seeing-each organ seeks out one sensory quality.

verses.original: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਲੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhukhiaa bhukh na utarai galee bhukh na jai ||
verses.translation: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased; by mere words, hunger is not relieved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਾ ਰਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhukhaa taa rajai jaa gun keh gunee samai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, hunger is relieved only when one utters the Glorious Praises of the Praiseworthy Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vin sache sabh kooR kooR kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the True One, all are false, and all practice falsehood.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਬੰਨਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vin sache kooRiaar ba(n)n chalaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the True One, the false ones are bound and gagged and driven off.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਰਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vin sache tan chhaar chhaar ralaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the True One, the body is just ashes, and it mingles again with ashes.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਜਿ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vin sache sabh bhukh j paijhai khaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the True Ome, all food and clothes are unsatisfying.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vin sache dharabaar kooR na paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the True One, the false ones do not attain the Lord's Court.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kooRai laalach lag mahal khuaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Attached to false attachments, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਓ ਠਗਿ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag Thagio Thag aaieeaai jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The whole world is deceived by deception, coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: tan meh tirasanaa ag sabadh bujhaieeaai ||19||
verses.translation: Within the body is the fire of desire; through the Word of the Shabad, it is quenched. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gur sa(n)tokh rukh dharam ful fal giaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Guru is the tree of contentment, with flowers of faith, and fruits of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਪਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: ras rasiaa hariaa sadhaa pakai karam dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Watered with the Lord's Love, it remains forever green; through the karma of good deeds and meditation, it ripens.

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਖਾਦਾ ਲਹੈ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pat ke saadh khaadhaa lahai dhaanaa kai sir dhaan ||1||
verses.translation: Honor is obtained by eating this tasty dish; of all gifts, this is the greatest gift. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪਤ ਪਰਵਾਲਾ ਫੁਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: suine kaa birakh pat paravaalaa ful javehar laal ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the tree of gold, with leaves of coral, and blossoms of jewels and rubies.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਫਲ ਰਤਨ ਲਗਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਖਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: tit fal ratan lageh mukh bhaakhit hiradhai ridhai nihaal ||
verses.translation: The Words from His Mouth are fruits of jewels. Within His Heart, He beholds the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak karam hovai mukh masatak likhiaa hovai lekh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He is obtained by those, upon whose faces and foreheads such pre-recorded destiny is written.

verses.original: ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪੂਜੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: aThisaTh teerath gur kee charanee poojai sadhaa visekh ||
verses.translation: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are contained in the constant worship of the feet of the Exalted Guru.

verses.original: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕੋਪੁ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਦੀਆ ਅਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s het lobh kop chaare nadheeaa ag ||
verses.translation: Cruelty, material attachment, greed and anger are the four rivers of fire.

verses.original: ਪਵਹਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਰੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਲਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paveh dhajheh naanakaa tareeaai karamee lag ||2||
verses.translation: Falling into them, one is burned, O Nanak! One is saved only by holding tight to good deeds. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jeevadhiaa mar maar na pachhotaieeaai ||
verses.translation: While you are alive, conquer death, and you shall have no regrets in the end.

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa ih sa(n)saar kin samajhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: This world is false, but only a few understand this.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sach na dhare piaar dha(n)dhai dhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: People do not enshrine love for the Truth; they chase after worldly affairs instead.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kaal buraa khai kaal sir dhuneeaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The terrible time of death and annihilation hovers over the heads of the world.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਦਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee sir ja(n)dhaar maare dhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the Messenger of Death smashes his club over their heads.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhei piaar ma(n)n vasaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself gives His Love, and enshrines it within their minds.

verses.original: ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਲੰਮੁ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: muhat na chasaa vila(n)m bhareeaai paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Not a moment or an instant's delay is permitted, when one's measure of life is full.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee bujh sach samaieeaai ||20||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the True One, and is absorbed into Him. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਮੀ ਤੁਮਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਅਕੁ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਨਿਮੁ ਫਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: tumee tumaa vis ak dhatooraa nim fal ||
verses.translation: Bitter melon, swallow-wort, thorn-apple and nim fruit

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: man mukh vaseh tis jis too(n) chit na aavahee ||
verses.translation: these bitter poisons lodge in the minds and mouths of those who do not remember You

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੰਢਨਿ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaheeaai kis ha(n)ddan karamaa baahare ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how shall I tell them this? Without the karma of good deeds, they are only destroying themselves. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚ ॥
verses.translit: mat pa(n)kheroo kirat saath kab utam kab neech ||
verses.translation: The intellect is a bird; on account of its actions, it is sometimes high, and sometimes low.

verses.original: ਕਬ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਕਬ ਅਕਿ ਡਾਲਿ ਕਬ ਉਚੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kab cha(n)dhan kab ak ddaal kab uchee pareet ||
verses.translation: Sometimes it is perched on the sandalwood tree, and sometimes it is on the branch of the poisonous swallow-wort. Sometimes, it soars through the heavens.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲਗੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam chalaieeaai saahib lagee reet ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, our Lord and Master leads us on, according to the Hukam of His Command; such is His Way. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਾਣ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kete kaheh vakhaan keh keh jaavanaa ||
verses.translation: Some speak and expound, and while speaking and lecturing, they pass away.

verses.original: ਵੇਦ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: vedh kaheh vakhiaan a(n)t na paavanaa ||
verses.translation: The Vedas speak and expound on the Lord, but they do not know His limits.

verses.original: ਪੜਿਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਬੁਝਿਐ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: paRiaai naahee bhedh bujhiaai paavanaa ||
verses.translation: Not by studying, but through understanding, is the Lord's Mystery revealed.

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਭੇਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: khaT dharasan kai bhekh kisai sach samaavanaa ||
verses.translation: There are six pathways in the Shaastras, but how rare are those who merge in the True Lord through them.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa purakh alakh sabadh suhaavanaa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is Unknowable; through the Word of His Shabad, we are embellished.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਸੰਖ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ne naau bisa(n)kh dharageh paavanaa ||
verses.translation: One who believes in the Name of the Infinite Lord, attains the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਖਾਲਕ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: khaalak kau aadhes ddaaddee gaavanaa ||
verses.translation: I humbly bow to the Creator Lord; I am a minstrel singing His Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਾ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jug jug ek ma(n)n vasaavanaa ||21||
verses.translation: Nanak enshrines the Lord within his mind. He is the One, throughout the ages. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਠੂਹਿਆ ਨਾਗੀ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥ ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣੈ ਦੇ ਕੂਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)tree hoi aThoohiaa naagee lagai jai || aapan hathee aapanai dhe koochaa aape lai ||
verses.translation: Those who charm scorpions and handle snakes only brand themselves with their own hands.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਅਤੀ ਹੂ ਧਕਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukam piaa dhur khasam kaa atee hoo dhakaa khai ||
verses.translation: By the pre-ordained Order of our Lord and Master, they are beaten badly, and struck down.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੜੈ ਡੁਬੈ ਹਕਿ ਨਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh siau manmukh aRai ddubai hak niaai ||
verses.translation: If the self-willed manmukhs fight with the Gurmukh, they are condemned by the Lord, the True Judge.

verses.original: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhuhaa siriaa aape khasam vekhai kar viaupai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master of both worlds. He beholds all and makes the exact determination.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak evai jaaneeaai sabh kichh tiseh rajai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, know this well: everything is in accordance with His Will. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak parakhe aap kau taa paarakh jaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if someone judges himself, only then is he known as a real judge.

verses.original: ਰੋਗੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਦੋਵੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: rog dhaaroo dhovai bujhai taa vaidh sujaan ||
verses.translation: If someone understands both the disease and the medicine, only then is he a wise physician.

verses.original: ਵਾਟ ਨ ਕਰਈ ਮਾਮਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaaT na kariee maamalaa jaanai mihamaan ||
verses.translation: Do not involve yourself in idle business on the way; remember that you are only a guest here.

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਾਣਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: mool jaan galaa kare haan laae haan ||
verses.translation: Speak with those who know the Primal Lord, and renounce your evil ways.

verses.original: ਲਬਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: lab na chaliee sach rahai so visaT paravaan ||
verses.translation: That virtuous person who does not walk in the way of greed, and who abides in Truth, is accepted and famous.

verses.original: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੇ ਆਗਾਸ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sar sa(n)dhe aagaas kau kiau pahuchai baan ||
verses.translation: If an arrow is shot at the sky, how can it reach there?

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੇਦੜੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agai oh aga(n)m hai vaahedhaR jaan ||2||
verses.translation: The sky above is unreachable-know this well, O archer! ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: naaree purakh piaar prem seegaareeaa ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride loves her Husband Lord; she is embellished with His Love.

verses.original: ਕਰਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਰਹਨੀ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: karan bhagat dhin raat na rahanee vaareeaa ||
verses.translation: She worships Him day and night; she cannot be restrained from doing so.

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa ma(n)jh nivaas sabadh savaareeaa ||
verses.translation: In the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, she has made her home; she is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਹਨਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach kahan aradhaas se vechaareeaa ||
verses.translation: She is humble, and she offers her true and sincere prayer.

verses.original: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sohan khasamai paas hukam sidhaareeaa ||
verses.translation: She is beautiful in the Company of her Lord and Master; she walks in the Way of His Will.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਕਹਨਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee kahan aradhaas manahu piaareeaa ||
verses.translation: With her dear friends, she offers her heart-felt prayers to her Beloved.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai dhirag vaas fiTu su jeeviaa ||
verses.translation: Cursed is that home, and shameful is that life, which is without the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਿਆ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: sabadh savaareeaas a(n)mrit peeviaa ||22||
verses.translation: But she who is adorned with the Word of His Shabad, drinks in the Amrit of His Nectar. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮੀਹਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਅਗੀ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo meeh na tirapatiaa agee lahai na bhukh ||
verses.translation: The desert is not satisfied by rain, and the fire is not quenched by desire.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਸਾਇਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਿਸੁਕ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa raaj na tirapatiaa sair bhare kisuk ||
verses.translation: The king is not satisfied with his kingdom, and the oceans are full, but still they thirst for more.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕੇਤੀ ਪੁਛਾ ਪੁਛ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam kee ketee puchhaa puchh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how many times must I seek and ask for the True Name? ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਹਫਲੰ ਤਸਿ ਜਨਮਸਿ ਜਾਵਤੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨ ਬਿੰਦਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: nihafala(n) tas janamas jaavat braham na bi(n)dhate ||
verses.translation: Life is useless, as long as one does not know the Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਸੰਸਾਰਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰਹਿ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: saagara(n) sa(n)saaras gur parasaadhee tareh ke ||
verses.translation: Only a few cross over the world-ocean, by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath hai kahu naanak beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the All-powerful Cause of causes, says Nanak after deep deliberation.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaaran karate vas hai jin kal rakhee dhaar ||2||
verses.translation: The creation is subject to the Creator, who sustains it by His Almighty Power. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ਢਾਢੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: khasamai kai dharabaar ddaaddee vasiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord and Master, His minstrels dwell.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਲਾਣਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa khasam kalaan kamal vigasiaa ||
verses.translation: Singing the Praises of their True Lord and Master, the lotuses of their hearts have blossomed forth.

verses.original: ਖਸਮਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: khasamahu pooraa pai manahu rahasiaa ||
verses.translation: Obtaining their Perfect Lord and Master, their minds are transfixed with ecstasy.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਕਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਸਰਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaman kadde maar sajan sarasiaa ||
verses.translation: Their enemies have been driven out and subdued, and their friends are very pleased.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa satigur sevan sachaa maarag dhasiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Truthful True Guru are shown the True Path.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਧਉਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh beechaar kaal vidhausiaa ||
verses.translation: Reflecting on the True Word of the Shabad, death is overcome.

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee kathe akath sabadh savaariaa ||
verses.translation: Speaking the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, one is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gun geh raas har jeeau mile piaariaa ||23||
verses.translation: Nanak holds tight to the Treasure of Virtue, and meets with the Dear, Beloved Lord. ||23||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਖਤਿਅਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਤ ਖਤਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: khatiahu ja(n)me khate karan ta khatiaa vich paeh ||
verses.translation: Born because of the karma of their past mistakes, they make more mistakes, and fall into mistakes.

verses.original: ਧੋਤੇ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhote mool na utareh je sau dhovan paeh ||
verses.translation: By washing, their pollution is not removed, even though they may wash hundreds of times.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bakhase bakhase'eeh naeh ta paahee paeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if God forgives, they are forgiven; otherwise, they are kicked and beaten. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਝਖਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਛਡਿ ਮੰਗੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bolan jhakhanaa dhukh chhadd ma(n)ge'eeh sukh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it is absurd to ask to be spared from pain by begging for comfort.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਿ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh dhui dhar kapaRe pahireh jai manukh ||
verses.translation: Pleasure and pain are the two garments given, to be worn in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਚੰਗੀ ਚੁਪ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jithai bolan haareeaai tithai cha(n)gee chup ||2||
verses.translation: Where you are bound to lose by speaking, there, you ought to remain silent. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)ddaa dhekh a(n)dhar bhaaliaa ||
verses.translation: After looking around in the four directions, I looked within my own self.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਅਲਖਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachai purakh alakh siraj nihaaliaa ||
verses.translation: There, I saw the True, Invisible Lord Creator.

verses.original: ਉਝੜਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਰਾਹ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aujhaR bhule raeh gur vekhaaliaa ||
verses.translation: I was wandering in the wilderness, but now the Guru has shown me the Way.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sache vaahu sach samaaliaa ||
verses.translation: Hail to the True, True Guru, through whom we merge in the Truth.

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਘਰਾਹੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa ratan gharaahu dheevaa baaliaa ||
verses.translation: I have found the jewel within the home of my own self; the lamp within has been lit.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh salaeh sukhe'ee sach vaaliaa ||
verses.translation: Those who praise the True Word of the Shabad, abide in the peace of Truth.

verses.original: ਨਿਡਰਿਆ ਡਰੁ ਲਗਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਸਿ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: niddariaa ddar lag garab s gaaliaa ||
verses.translation: But those who do not have the Fear of God, are overtaken by fear. They are destroyed by their own pride.

verses.original: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naavahu bhulaa jag firai betaaliaa ||24||
verses.translation: Having forgotten the Name, the world is roaming around like a wild demon. ||24||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਭੈ ਮਰੈ ਭੀ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich ja(n)mai bhai marai bhee bhau man meh hoi ||
verses.translation: In fear we are born, and in fear we die. Fear is always present in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bhai vich je marai sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if one dies in the fear of God, his coming into the world is blessed and approved. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vin jeevai bahut bahut khuseeaa khusee kamai ||
verses.translation: Without the fear of God, you may live very, very long, and savor the most enjoyable pleasures.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhai vin je marai muh kaalai uTh jai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if you die without the fear of God, you will arise and depart with a blackened face. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hoi dhiaal ta saradhaa pooreeaai ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, then your desires will be fulfilled.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hoi dhiaal na kabahoo(n) jhooreeaai ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, you will never grieve.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hoi dhiaal taa dhukh na jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, you will know no pain.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hoi dhiaal taa har ra(n)g maaneeaai ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, you will enjoy the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hoi dhiaal taa jam kaa ddar kehaa ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, then why should you fear death?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hoi dhiaal taa sadh hee sukh dhehaa ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, the body is always at peace.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hoi dhiaal taa nav nidh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, the nine treasures are obtained.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: satigur hoi dhiaal ta sach samaieeaai ||25||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, you shall be absorbed in the True Lord. ||25||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇ ਪੀਅਹਿ ਮਲਵਾਣੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sir khohai pe'eeh malavaanee jooThaa ma(n)g ma(n)g khaahee ||
verses.translation: They pluck the hair out of their heads, and drink in filthy water; they beg endlessly and eat the garbage which others have thrown away.

verses.original: ਫੋਲਿ ਫਦੀਹਤਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਭੜਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: fol fadheehat muh lain bhaRaasaa paanee dhekh sagaahee ||
verses.translation: They spread manure, they suck in rotting smells, and they are afraid of clean water.

verses.original: ਭੇਡਾ ਵਾਗੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇਨਿ ਭਰੀਅਨਿ ਹਥ ਸੁਆਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bheddaa vaagee sir khohain bhareean hath suaahee ||
verses.translation: Their hands are smeared with ashes, and the hair on their heads is plucked out-they are like sheep!

verses.original: ਮਾਊ ਪੀਊ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਨਿ ਟਬਰ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: maauoo peeuoo kirat gavain Tabar rovan dhaahee ||
verses.translation: They have renounced the lifestyle of their mothers and fathers, and their families and relatives cry out in distress.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਨ ਪਤਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਨ ਦੀਵਾ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: onaa pi(n)dd na patal kiriaa na dheevaa mue kithaauoo paahee ||
verses.translation: No one offers the rice dishes at their last rites, and no one lights the lamps for them. After their death, where will they be sent?

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਨਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath dhen na ddoiee brahaman a(n)n na khaahee ||
verses.translation: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage give them no place of protection, and no Brahmin will eat their food.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa kucheel raheh dhin raatee mathai Tike naahee ||
verses.translation: They remain polluted forever, day and night; they do not apply the ceremonial tilak mark to their foreheads.

verses.original: ਝੁੰਡੀ ਪਾਇ ਬਹਨਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਮਰਣੈ ਦੜਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jhu(n)ddee pai bahan nit maranai dhaR dheebaan na jaahee ||
verses.translation: They sit together in silence, as if in mourning; they do not go to the Lord's Court.

verses.original: ਲਕੀ ਕਾਸੇ ਹਥੀ ਫੁੰਮਣ ਅਗੋ ਪਿਛੀ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: lakee kaase hathee fu(n)man ago pichhee jaahee ||
verses.translation: With their begging bowls hanging from their waists, and their fly-brushes in their hands, they walk along in single file.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੰਗਮ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁੰਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa oi jogee naa oi ja(n)gam naa oi kaajee mu(n)laa ||
verses.translation: They are not Yogis, and they are not Jangams, followers of Shiva. They are not Qazis or Mullahs.

verses.original: ਦਯਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਫਿਟਾ ਵਤੈ ਗਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhay vigoe fireh vigute fiTaa vatai galaa ||
verses.translation: Ruined by the Merciful Lord, they wander around in disgrace, and their entire troop is contaminated.

verses.original: ਜੀਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeeaa maar jeevaale soiee avar na koiee rakhai ||
verses.translation: The Lord alone kills and restores to life; no one else can protect anyone from Him.

verses.original: ਦਾਨਹੁ ਤੈ ਇਸਨਾਨਹੁ ਵੰਜੇ ਭਸੁ ਪਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਖੁਥੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaanahu tai isanaanahu va(n)je bhas piee sir khuthai ||
verses.translation: They go without giving alms or any cleansing baths; their shaven heads become covered with dust.

verses.original: ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਰਤਨ ਉਪੰਨੇ ਮੇਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: paanee vichahu ratan upa(n)ne mer keeaa maadhaanee ||
verses.translation: The jewel emerged from the water, when the mountain of gold was used to churn it.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਪੁਰਬੀ ਲਗੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath dhevee thaape purabee lagai baanee ||
verses.translation: The gods established the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the festivals are celebrated and hymns are chanted.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਨਾਤੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: nai nivaajaa naatai poojaa naavan sadhaa sujaanee ||
verses.translation: After bathing, the Muslims recite their prayers, and after bathing, the Hindus perform their worship services. The wise always take cleansing baths.

verses.original: ਮੁਇਆ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: muiaa jeevadhiaa gat hovai jaa(n) sir paieeaai paanee ||
verses.translation: At the time of death, and at the time of birth, they are purified, when water is poured on their heads.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਸੈਤਾਨੀ ਏਨਾ ਗਲ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sirakhuthe saitaanee enaa gal na bhaanee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the shaven-headed ones are devils. They are not pleased to hear these words.

verses.original: ਵੁਠੈ ਹੋਇਐ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਜੀਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: vuThai hoiaai hoi bilaaval jeeaa jugat samaanee ||
verses.translation: When it rains, there is happiness. Water is the key to all life.

verses.original: ਵੁਠੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਕਪਾਹਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਪੜਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: vuThai a(n)n kamaadh kapaahaa sabhasai paRadhaa hovai ||
verses.translation: When it rains, the corn grows, and the sugar cane, and the cotton, which provides clothing for all.

verses.original: ਵੁਠੈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਸੁਰਹੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: vuThai ghaahu chareh nit surahee saa dhan dhahee vilovai ||
verses.translation: When it rains, the cows always have grass to graze upon, and housewives can churn the milk into butter.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਿਇ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਸਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਇਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: tit ghi hom jag sadh poojaa piaai kaaraj sohai ||
verses.translation: With that ghee, sacred feasts and worship services are performed; all these efforts are blessed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਨਦੀ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਖੀ ਨਾਤੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: guroo samu(n)dh nadhee sabh sikhee naatai jit vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the ocean, and all His Teachings are the river. Bathing within it, glorious greatness is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਨਾਵਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਸਤ ਚਟੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak je sirakhuthe naavan naahee taa sat chaTe sir chhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if the shaven-headed ones do not bathe, then seven handfuls of ashes are upon their heads. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਗੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੇਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: agee paalaa k kare sooraj kehee raat ||
verses.translation: What can the cold do to the fire? How can the night affect the sun?

verses.original: ਚੰਦ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh aneraa k kare paun paanee kiaa jaat ||
verses.translation: What can the darkness do to the moon? What can social status do to air and water?

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਚੀਜੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dharatee cheejee k kare jis vich sabh kichh hoi ||
verses.translation: What are personal possessions to the earth, from which all things are produced?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak taa pat jaaneeaai jaa pat rakhai soi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is known as honorable, whose honor the Lord preserves. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਬਹਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਲਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh sache subahaan sadhaa kalaaniaa ||
verses.translation: It is of You, O my True and Wondrous Lord, that I sing forever.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sachaa dheebaan hor aavan jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Yours is the True Court. All others are subject to coming and going.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach j ma(n)geh dhaan s tudhai jehiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who ask for the gift of the True Name are like You.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach teraa furamaan sabadhe sohiaa ||
verses.translation: Your Command is True; we are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad.

verses.original: ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)niaai giaan dhiaan tudhai te paiaa ||
verses.translation: Through faith and trust, we receive spiritual wisdom and meditation from You.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: karam pavai neesaan na chalai chalaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, the banner of honor is obtained. It cannot be taken away or lost.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sachaa dhaataar nit dheveh chaReh savaiaa ||
verses.translation: You are the True Giver; You give continually. Your Gifts continue to increase.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: naanak ma(n)gai dhaan jo tudh bhaiaa ||26||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for that gift which is pleasing to You. ||26||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheekhiaa aakh bujhaiaa sifatee sach sameau ||
verses.translation: Those who have accepted the Guru's Teachings, and who have found the path, remain absorbed in the Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਦੇਸੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin kau kiaa upadheseeaai jin gur naanak dheau ||1||
verses.translation: What teachings can be imparted to those who have the Divine Guru Nanak as their Guru? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap bujhaae soiee boojhai ||
verses.translation: We understand the Lord only when He Himself inspires us to understand Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis aap sujhaae tis sabh kichh soojhai ||
verses.translation: He alone knows everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives knowledge.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: keh keh kathanaa maiaa loojhai ||
verses.translation: One may talk and preach and give sermons but still yearn after Maya.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਰੇ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee sagal kare aakaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, has created the entire creation.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aape jaanai sarab veechaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself knows the inner nature of all.

verses.original: ਅਖਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਖਿਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: akhar naanak akhio aap ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself uttered the Word.

verses.original: ਲਹੈ ਭਰਾਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: lahai bharaat hovai jis dhaat ||2||
verses.translation: Doubt departs from one who receives this gift. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau ddaaddee vekaar kaarai laiaa ||
verses.translation: I was a minstrel, out of work, when the Lord took me into His service.

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਕੈ ਵਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raat dhihai kai vaar dhurahu furamaiaa ||
verses.translation: To sing His Praises day and night, He gave me His Order, right from the start.

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee sachai mahal khasam bulaiaa ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has summoned me, His minstrel, to the True Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਪੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachee sifat saalaeh kapaRaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: He has dressed me in the robes of His True Praise and Glory.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa a(n)mirat naam bhojan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name has become my food.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖਾਧਾ ਰਜਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee khaadhaa raj tin sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings, who eat this food and are satisfied, find peace.

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee kare pasaau sabadh vajaiaa ||
verses.translation: His minstrel spreads His Glory, singing and vibrating the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੭॥ ਸੁਧੁ
verses.translit: naanak sach saalaeh pooraa paiaa ||27|| sudhu
verses.translation: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, I have obtained His Perfection. ||27||Sudh||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe dhupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay & Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਭਉ ਮੁਚੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਵਡਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhau much bhaaraa vaddaa tol ||
verses.translation: The Fear of God is overpowering, and so very heavy,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਤਿ ਹਉਲੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mat haulee bole bol ||
verses.translation: while the intellect is lightweight, as is the speech one speaks.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਚਲੀਐ ਸਹੀਐ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sir dhar chaleeaai saheeaai bhaar ||
verses.translation: So place the Fear of God upon your head, and bear that weight;

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nadharee karamee gur beechaar ||1||
verses.translation: by the Grace of the Merciful Lord, contemplate the Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲੰਘਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bin koi na la(n)ghas paar ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, no one crosses over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhau raakhiaa bhai savaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This Fear of God adorns the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai tan agan bhakhai bhai naal ||
verses.translation: The fire of fear within the body is burnt away by the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhau ghaReeaai sabadh savaar ||
verses.translation: Through this Fear of God, we are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਾੜਤ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bin ghaaRat kach nikach ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, all that is fashioned is false.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਸਚਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਸਟ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa sachaa a(n)dhee saT ||2||
verses.translation: Useless is the mold, and useless are the hammer-strokes on the mold. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੁਧੀ ਬਾਜੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: budhee baajee upajai chaau ||
verses.translation: The desire for the worldly drama arises in the intellect,

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਤਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahas siaanap pavai na taau ||
verses.translation: but even with thousands of clever mental tricks, the heat of the Fear of God does not come into play.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਵਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naanak manmukh bolan vaau ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the speech of the self-willed manmukh is just wind.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa akhar vaau dhuaau ||3||1||
verses.translation: His words are worthless and empty, like the wind. ||3||1||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਡਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ddar ghar ghar ddar ddar ddar jai ||
verses.translation: Place the Fear of God within the home of your heart; with this Fear of God in your heart, all other fears shall be frightened away.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: so ddar kehaa jit ddar ddar pai ||
verses.translation: What sort of fear is that, which frightens other fears?

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bin dhoojee naahee jai ||
verses.translation: Without You, I have other place of rest at all.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo kichh varatai sabh teree rajai ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever happens is all according to Your Will. ||1||

verses.original: ਡਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਡਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ddareeaai je ddar hovai hor ||
verses.translation: Be afraid, if you have any fear, other than the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਡਰਣਾ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ddar ddar ddaranaa man kaa sor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Afraid of fear, and living in fear, the mind is held in tumult. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naa jeeau marai na ddoobai tarai ||
verses.translation: The soul does not die; it does not drown, and it does not swim across.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin kichh keeaa so kichh karai ||
verses.translation: The One who created everything does everything.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukame aavai hukame jai ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of His Command we come, and by the Hukam of His Command we go.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aagai paachhai hukam samai ||2||
verses.translation: Before and after, His Command is pervading. ||2||

verses.original: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਆਸਾ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s het aasaa asamaan ||
verses.translation: Cruelty, attachment, desire and egotism

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭੂਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨੈ ਸਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich bhookh bahut nai saan ||
verses.translation: there is great hunger in these, like the raging torrent of a wild stream.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhau khaanaa peenaa aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Let the Fear of God be your food, drink and support.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਖਾਧੇ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vin khaadhe mar hoh gavaar ||3||
verses.translation: Without doing this, the fools simply die. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa koi koiee koi koi ||
verses.translation: If anyone really has anyone else - how rare is that person!

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko teraa too(n) sabhanaa kaa soi ||
verses.translation: All are Yours - You are the Lord of all.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke jeea ja(n)t dhan maal ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures, wealth and property belong to Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhan bikham beechaar ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it is so difficult to describe and contemplate Him. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: maataa mat pitaa sa(n)tokh ||
verses.translation: Let wisdom be your mother, and contentment your father.

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sat bhaiee kar eh visekh ||1||
verses.translation: Let Truth be your brother - these are your best relatives. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹਣਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahanaa hai kichh kahan na jai ||
verses.translation: He has been described, but He cannot be described at all.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tau kudharat keemat nahee pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your All-pervading creative nature cannot be estimated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਮ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਸਸੁਰ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: saram surat dhui sasur bhe ||
verses.translation: Modesty, humility and intuitive understanding are my mother-in-law and father-in-law;

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਲਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karanee kaaman kar man le ||2||
verses.translation: I have made good deeds my spouse. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahaa sa(n)jog veeaahu vijog ||
verses.translation: Union with the Holy is my wedding date, and separation from the world is my marriage.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)tat kahu naanak jog ||3||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, Truth is the child born of this Union. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: paunai paanee aganee kaa mel ||
verses.translation: The union of air, water and fire

verses.original: ਚੰਚਲ ਚਪਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)chal chapal budh kaa khel ||
verses.translation: the body is the play-thing of the fickle and unsteady intellect.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: nau dharavaaje dhasavaa dhuaar ||
verses.translation: It has nine doors, and then there is the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਬੁਝੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bujh re giaanee eh beechaar ||1||
verses.translation: Reflect upon this and understand it, O wise one. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਥਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੁਨਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kathataa bakataa sunataa soiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the One who speaks, teaches and listens.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap beechaare su giaanee hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who contemplates his own self is truly wise. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਟੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਪਉਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee maaTee bolai paun ||
verses.translation: The body is dust; the wind speaks through it.

verses.original: ਬੁਝੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੂਆ ਹੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: bujh re giaanee mooaa hai kaun ||
verses.translation: Understand, O wise one, who has died.

verses.original: ਮੂਈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mooiee surat baadh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Awareness, conflict and ego have died,

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਜੋ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: oh na mooaa jo dhekhanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: but the One who sees does not die. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jai kaaran taT teerath jaahee ||
verses.translation: For the sake of it, you journey to sacred shrines and holy rivers;

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ratan padhaarath ghaT hee maahee ||
verses.translation: but this priceless jewel is within your own heart.

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR pa(n)ddit baadh vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read endlessly; they stir up arguments and controversies,

verses.original: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bheetar hodhee vasat na jaanai ||3||
verses.translation: but they do not know the secret deep within. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hau na mooaa meree muiee balai ||
verses.translation: I have not died - that evil nature within me has died.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਜੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: oh na mooaa jo rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: The One who is pervading everywhere does not die.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur braham dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed God to me,

verses.original: ਮਰਤਾ ਜਾਤਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: marataa jaataa nadhar na aaiaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: and now I see that there is no such thing as birth or death. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa dhakhanee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla, Dakhanee:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun boojhai maanai naau || taa kai sadh balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the one who listens and hears, who understands and believes in the Name.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap bhulaae Thaur na Thaau ||
verses.translation: When the Lord Himself leads us astray, there is no other place of rest for us to find.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) samajhaaveh mel milaau ||1||
verses.translation: You impart understanding, and You unite us in Your Union. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਮੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam milai chalai mai naal ||
verses.translation: I obtain the Naam, which shall go along with me in the end.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਸਭ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai baadhee sabh kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, all are held in the grip of Death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
verses.translit: khetee vanaj naavai kee oT ||
verses.translation: My farming and my trading are by the Support of the Name.

verses.original: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜ ਕੀ ਪੋਟ ॥
verses.translit: paap pu(n)n beej kee poT ||
verses.translation: The seeds of sin and virtue are bound together.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਚੋਟ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh jeea meh choT ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire and anger are the wounds of the soul.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam visaar chale man khoT ||2||
verses.translation: The evil-minded ones forget the Naam, and then depart. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੀਖ ॥
verses.translit: saache gur kee saachee seekh ||
verses.translation: True are the Teachings of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖ ॥
verses.translit: tan man seetal saach pareekh ||
verses.translation: The body and mind are cooled and soothed, by the touchstone of Truth.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਪੁਰਾਇਨਿ ਰਸ ਕਮਲ ਪਰੀਖ ॥
verses.translit: jal purain ras kamal pareekh ||
verses.translation: This is the true mark of wisdom: that one remains detached, like the water-lily, or the lotus upon the water.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੀਠੇ ਰਸ ਈਖ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate meeThe ras ieekh ||3||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, one becomes sweet, like the juice of the sugar cane. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਗੜਿ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: hukam sa(n)jogee gaR dhas dhuaar ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the castle of the body has ten gates.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch vaseh mil jot apaar ||
verses.translation: The five passions dwell there, together with the Divine Light of the Infinite.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aap tulai aape vanajaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is the merchandise, and He Himself is the trader.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam savaaranahaar ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are adorned and rejuvenated. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਤੋ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaato jai kahaa te aavai ||
verses.translation: How can we know where we came from?

verses.original: ਕਹ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਹ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: keh upajai keh jai samaavai ||
