verses.translation: Where did we originate, and where will we go and merge?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kiau baadhio kiau mukatee paavai ||
verses.translation: How are we bound, and how do we obtain liberation?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kiau abinaasee sahaj samaavai ||1||
verses.translation: How do we merge with intuitive ease into the Eternal, Imperishable Lord? ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam ridhai a(n)mrit mukh naam ||
verses.translation: With the Naam in the heart and the Ambrosial Naam on our lips,

verses.original: ਨਰਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: narahar naam narahar nihakaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: through the Name of the Lord, we rise above desire, like the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje aavai sahaje jai ||
verses.translation: With intuitive ease we come, and with intuitive ease we depart.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man te upajai man maeh samai ||
verses.translation: From the mind we originate, and into the mind we are absorbed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤੋ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mukato ba(n)dh na pai ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, we are liberated, and are not bound.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਛੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabadh beechaar chhuTai har nai ||2||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated through the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਰਵਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: taravar pa(n)khee bahu nis baas ||
verses.translation: At night, lots of birds settle on the tree.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukheeaa man moh vinaas ||
verses.translation: Some are happy, and some are sad. Caught in the desires of the mind, they perish.

verses.original: ਸਾਝ ਬਿਹਾਗ ਤਕਹਿ ਆਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: saajh bihaag takeh aagaas ||
verses.translation: And when the life-night comes to its end, then they look to the sky.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis dhaaveh karam likhiaas ||3||
verses.translation: They fly away in all ten directions, according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਥਾਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam sa(n)jogee goil thaaT ||
verses.translation: Those who are committed to the Naam, see the world as merely a temporary pasture.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਫੂਟੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh fooTai bikh maaT ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire and anger are broken, like a jar of poison.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਵਖਰ ਸੂਨੋ ਘਰੁ ਹਾਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin vakhar soono ghar haaT ||
verses.translation: Without the merchandise of the Name, the house of the body and the store of the mind are empty.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur mil khole bajar kapaaT ||4||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, the hard and heavy doors are opened. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪੂਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: saadh milai poorab sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: One meets the Holy Saint only through perfect destiny.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਹਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: sach rahase poore har log ||
verses.translation: The Lord's perfect people rejoice in the Truth.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan dhe lai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Surrendering their minds and bodies, they find the Lord with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kai laagau pai ||5||6||
verses.translation: Nanak falls at their feet. ||5||6||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh maiaa meh cheet ||
verses.translation: The conscious mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya.

verses.original: ਝੂਠ ਵਿਕਾਰਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTh vikaar jaagai hit cheet ||
verses.translation: The conscious mind is awake only to falsehood, corruption and attachment.

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਪਾਪ ਲੋਭ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee paap lobh kee keet ||
verses.translation: It gathers in the assets of sin and greed.

verses.original: ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tar taaree man naam sucheet ||1||
verses.translation: So swim across the river of life, O my mind, with the Sacred Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu saache mai teree Tek ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! - Great! Great is my True Lord! I seek Your All-powerful Support.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau paapee too(n) niramal ek ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sinner - You alone are pure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਭੜਵਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: agan paanee bolai bhaRavaau ||
verses.translation: Fire and water join together, and the breath roars in its fury!

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa i(n)dhree ek suaau ||
verses.translation: The tongue and the sex organs each seek to taste.

verses.original: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhisaT vikaaree naahee bhau bhaau ||
verses.translation: The eyes which look upon corruption do not know the Love and the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap maare taa paae naau ||2||
verses.translation: Conquering self-conceit, one obtains the Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai fir maran na hoi ||
verses.translation: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, shall never again have to die.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂਏ ਕਿਉ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin mooe kiau pooraa hoi ||
verses.translation: Without such a death, how can one attain perfection?

verses.original: ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਵਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: parapa(n)ch viaap rahiaa man dhoi ||
verses.translation: The mind is engrossed in deception, treachery and duality.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: thir naarain kare su hoi ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever the Immortal Lord does, comes to pass. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚੜਉ ਜਾ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bohith chaRau jaa aavai vaar ||
verses.translation: So get aboard that boat when your turn comes.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੇ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: Thaake bohith dharageh maar ||
verses.translation: Those who fail to embark upon that boat shall be beaten in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach saalaahee dha(n)n gurdhuaar ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, where the Praises of the True Lord are sung.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak dhar ghar eka(n)kaar ||4||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One Creator Lord is pervading hearth and home. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਲਟਿਓ ਕਮਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aulaTio kamal braham beechaar ||
verses.translation: The inverted heart-lotus has been turned upright, through reflective meditation on God.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਗਗਨਿ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat dhaar gagan dhas dhuaar ||
verses.translation: From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan bedhiaa aap muraar ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is pervading the three worlds. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: re man mere bharam na keejai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, do not give in to doubt.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man maaniaai a(n)mirat ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the mind surrenders to the Name, it drinks in the essence of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam jeet maran man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: So win the game of life; let your mind surrender and accept death.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮੂਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap mooaa man man te jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: When the self dies, the individual mind comes to know the Supreme Mind.

verses.original: ਨਜਰਿ ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: najar bhiee ghar ghar te jaaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: As the inner vision is awakened, one comes to know one's own home, deep within the self. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: jat sat teerath majan naam ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is austerity, chastity and cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਅਧਿਕ ਬਿਥਾਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: adhik bithaar karau kis kaam ||
verses.translation: What good are ostentatious displays?

verses.original: ਨਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nar naarain a(n)tarajaam ||3||
verses.translation: The All-pervading Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਨ ਮਨਉ ਤਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan manau tau par ghar jaau ||
verses.translation: If I had faith in someone else, then I would go to that one's house.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kis jaachau naahee ko thaau ||
verses.translation: But where should I go, to beg? There is no other place for me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmat sahaj samaau ||4||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai su maran dhikhaae ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, we are shown the way to die.

verses.original: ਮਰਣ ਰਹਣ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: maran rahan ras a(n)tar bhaae ||
verses.translation: Remaining alive in this death brings joy deep within.

verses.original: ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: garab nivaar gagan pur paae ||1||
verses.translation: Overcoming egotistical pride, the Tenth Gate is found. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਏ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: maran likhai aae nahee rahanaa ||
verses.translation: Death is pre-ordained - no one who comes can remain here.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jap jaap rahan har saranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So chant and meditate on the Lord, and remain in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta dhubidhaa bhaagai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, duality is dispelled.

verses.original: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: kamal bigaas man har prabh laagai ||
verses.translation: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mind is attached to the Lord God.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai mahaa ras aagai ||2||
verses.translation: One who remains dead while yet alive obtains the greatest happiness hereafter. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai sach sa(n)jam soochaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one becomes truthful, chaste and pure.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee pauRee uoocho uoochaa ||
verses.translation: Climbing up the steps of the Guru's Path, one becomes the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karam milai jam kaa bhau moochaa ||3||
verses.translation: When the Lord grants His Mercy, the fear of death is conquered. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai mil a(n)k samaiaa ||
verses.translation: Uniting in Guru's Union, we are absorbed in His Loving Embrace.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa ghar mahal dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He reveals the Mansion of His Presence, within the home of the self.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak haumai maar milaiaa ||4||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, conquering egotism, we are absorbed into the Lord. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਹ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kirat piaa neh meTai koi ||
verses.translation: Past actions cannot be erased.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa jaanaa kiaa aagai hoi ||
verses.translation: What do we know of what will happen hereafter?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaanaa soiee hooaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him shall come to pass.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avar na karanai vaalaa dhooaa ||1||
verses.translation: There is no other Doer except Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਰਮ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa jaanaa karam kevadd teree dhaat ||
verses.translation: I do not know about karma, or how great Your gifts are.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam tere naam kee jaat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The karma of actions, the Dharma of righteousness, social class and status, are contained within Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: too evadd dhaataa dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: You are So Great, O Giver, O Great Giver!

verses.original: ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: toT naahee tudh bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: The treasure of Your devotional worship is never exhausted.

verses.original: ਕੀਆ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: keeaa garab na aavai raas ||
verses.translation: One who takes pride in himself shall never be right.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh terai paas ||2||
verses.translation: The soul and body are all at Your disposal. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਹਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: too maar jeevaaleh bakhas milai ||
verses.translation: You kill and rejuvenate. You forgive and merge us into Yourself.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੀ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavee tiau naam japai ||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You inspire us to chant Your Name.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaanaa beenaa saachaa sir merai ||
verses.translation: You are All-knowing, All-seeing and True, O my Supreme Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmat dhei bharosai terai ||3||
verses.translation: Please, bless me with the Guru's Teachings; my faith is in You alone. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tan meh mail naahee man raataa ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord, has no pollution in his body.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee sach sabadh pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, the True Shabad is realized.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: teraa taan naam kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: All Power is Yours, through the greatness of Your Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak rahanaa bhagat saranaiee ||4||10||
verses.translation: Nanak abides in the Sanctuary of Your devotees. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin akath kahaiaa apio peeaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar.

verses.original: ਅਨ ਭੈ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: an bhai visare naam samaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Other fears are forgotten, and they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਡਰੀਐ ਡਰੁ ਡਰਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ddareeaai ddar ddareh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: Why should we fear, when fear is dispelled by the Fear of God?

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kai sabadh pachhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, I recognize God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis nar raam ridhai har raas || sahaj subhai mile saabaas ||2||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's essence are blessed and acclaimed, and intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਹਿ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਝ ਬਿਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: jaeh savaarai saajh biaal ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord puts to sleep, evening and morning

verses.original: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਾਧੇ ਕਾਲ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eit ut manmukh baadhe kaal ||3||
verses.translation: - those self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged by Death, here and hereafter. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis raam ridhai se poore ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, day and night, are perfect.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak raam mile bhram dhoore ||4||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away. ||4||11||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: janam marai trai gun hitakaar ||
verses.translation: One who loves the three qualities is subject to birth and death.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਕਥਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaare bedh katheh aakaar ||
verses.translation: The four Vedas speak only of the visible forms.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: teen avasathaa kaheh vakhiaan ||
verses.translation: They describe and explain the three states of mind,

verses.original: ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tureeaavasathaa satigur te har jaan ||1||
verses.translation: but the fourth state, union with the Lord, is known only through the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam bhagat gur sevaa taranaa ||
verses.translation: Through devotional worship of the Lord, and service to the Guru, one swims across.

verses.original: ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baahuR janam na hoi hai maranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Then, one is not born again, and is not subject to death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath kahai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone speaks of the four great blessings;

verses.original: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)mirat saasat pa(n)ddit mukh soiee ||
verses.translation: the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Pandits speak of them as well.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਥੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur arath beechaar na paiaa ||
verses.translation: But without the Guru, they do not understand their true significance.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mukat padhaarath bhagat har paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The treasure of liberation is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai hiradhai vasiaa har soiee ||
verses.translation: Those, within whose hearts the Lord dwells,

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat paraapat hoiee ||
verses.translation: become Gurmukh; they receive the blessings of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat mukat aana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Through devotional worship of the Lord, liberation and bliss are obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmat paae paramaana(n)dh ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, supreme ecstasy is obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin paiaa gur dhekh dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who meets the Guru, beholds Him, and inspires others to behold Him as well.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa maeh niraas bujhaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the midst of hope, the Guru teaches us to live above hope and desire.

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath sarab sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the meek, the Giver of peace to all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak har charanee man raataa ||4||12||
verses.translation: Nanak's mind is imbued with the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||12||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee chetee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਬਾਜੀ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat kaiaa rahai sukhaalee baajee ih sa(n)saaro ||
verses.translation: With your nectar-like body, you live in comfort, but this world is just a passing drama.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh much kooR kamaaveh bahut uThaaveh bhaaro ||
verses.translation: You practice greed, avarice and great falsehood, and you carry such a heavy burden.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਰੁਲਦੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਜਿਉ ਧਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਛਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) kaiaa mai ruladhee dhekhee jiau dhar upar chhaaro ||1||
verses.translation: O body, I have seen you blowing away like dust on the earth. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun sikh hamaaree ||
verses.translation: Listen - listen to my advice!

verses.original: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਰਹਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukirat keetaa rahasee mere jeeaRe bahuR na aavai vaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Only the good deeds which you have done shall remain with you, O my soul. This opportunity shall not come again! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hau tudh aakhaa meree kaiaa too(n) sun sikh hamaaree ||
verses.translation: I say to you, O my body: listen to my advice!

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਝੂਠੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhaa chi(n)dhaa kareh paraiee jhooThee laitabaaree ||
verses.translation: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip.

verses.original: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: vel paraiee joheh jeeaRe kareh choree buriaaree ||
verses.translation: You gaze upon the wives of others, O my soul; you steal and commit evil deeds.

verses.original: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਹੀਏਹਿ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਹੋਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s chaliaa too(n) pichhai rahe'eeh chhuTaR hoie'eeh naaree ||2||
verses.translation: But when the swan departs, you shall remain behind, like an abandoned woman. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) kaiaa rahe'eeh supana(n)tar tudh kiaa karam kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: O body, you are living in a dream! What good deeds have you done?

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਮੈ ਜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਆ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar choree mai jaa kichh leeaa taa man bhalaa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: When I stole something by deception, then my mind was pleased.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: halat na sobhaa palat na ddoiee ahilaa janam gavaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: I have no honor in this world, and I shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. My life has been lost, wasted in vain! ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau kharee dhuhelee hoiee baabaa naanak meree baat na puchhai koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am totally miserable! O Baba Nanak, no one cares for me at all! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਾਜੀ ਤੁਰਕੀ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਪੜ ਕੇਰੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: taajee turakee suinaa rupaa kapaR kere bhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Turkish horses, gold, silver and loads of gorgeous clothes

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kis hee naal na chale naanak jhaR jhaR pe gavaaraa ||
verses.translation: - none of these shall go with you, O Nanak. They are lost and left behind, you fool!

verses.original: ਕੂਜਾ ਮੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: koojaa mevaa mai sabh kichh chaakhiaa ik a(n)mrit naam tumaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: I have tasted all the sugar candy and sweets, but Your Name alone is Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||

verses.original: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਨੀਵ ਦਿਵਾਲ ਉਸਾਰੀ ਭਸਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhe dhe neev dhivaal usaaree bhasama(n)dhar kee dderee ||
verses.translation: Digging deep foundations, the walls are constructed, but in the end, the buildings return to heaps of dust.

verses.original: ਸੰਚੇ ਸੰਚਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)che sa(n)ch na dheiee kis hee a(n)dh jaanai sabh meree ||
verses.translation: People gather and hoard their possessions, and give nothing to anyone else - the poor fools think that everything is theirs.

verses.original: ਸੋਇਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਸੋਇਨ ਮਾੜੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: soin la(n)kaa soin maaRee sa(n)pai kisai na keree ||5||
verses.translation: Riches do not remain with anyone - not even the golden palaces of Sri Lanka. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੰਨ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun moorakh ma(n)n ajaanaa ||
verses.translation: Listen, you foolish and ignorant mind

verses.original: ਹੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hog tisai kaa bhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - only His Will prevails. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saahu hamaaraa Thaakur bhaaraa ham tis ke vanajaare ||
verses.translation: My Banker is the Great Lord and Master. I am only His petty merchant.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh raas tisai kee maar aape jeevaale ||6||1||13||
verses.translation: This soul and body all are His. He Himself kills, and brings back to life. ||6||1||13||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee chetee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਹਮ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਉ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: avar pa(n)ch ham ek janaa kiau raakhau ghar baar manaa ||
verses.translation: There are five of them, but I am all alone. How can I protect my hearth and home, O my mind?

verses.original: ਮਾਰਹਿ ਲੂਟਹਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maareh looTeh neet neet kis aagai karee pukaar janaa ||1||
verses.translation: They are beating and plundering me over and over again; unto whom can I complain? ||1||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਚਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sree raam naamaa uchar manaa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Supreme Lord, O my mind.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਜਮ ਦਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aagai jam dhal bikham ghanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Otherwise, in the world hereafter, you will have to face the awesome and cruel army of Death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਉਸਾਰਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਸਾ ਧਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ausaar maRolee raakhai dhuaaraa bheetar baiThee saa dhanaa ||
verses.translation: God has erected the temple of the body; He has placed the nine doors, and the soul-bride sits within.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਲੁਟੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat kel kare nit kaaman avar luTen su pa(n)ch janaa ||2||
verses.translation: She enjoys the sweet play again and again, while the five demons are plundering her. ||2||

verses.original: ਢਾਹਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪਕੜੀ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddaeh maRolee looTiaa dhehuraa saa dhan pakaRee ek janaa ||
verses.translation: In this way, the temple is being demolished; the body is being plundered, and the soul-bride, left all alone, is captured.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਡੰਡਾ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਪੜਿਆ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jam dda(n)ddaa gal sa(n)gal paRiaa bhaag ge se pa(n)ch janaa ||3||
verses.translation: Death strikes her down with his rod, the shackles are placed around her neck, and now the five have left. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲੋੜੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਲੁੜੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਖਾਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman loRai suinaa rupaa mitr luRen su khaadhaataa ||
verses.translation: The wife yearns for gold and silver, and her friends, the senses, yearn for good food.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak paap kare tin kaaran jaasee jamapur baadhaataa ||4||2||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she commits sins for their sake; she shall go, bound and gagged, to the City of Death. ||4||2||14||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee chetee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਖਿੰਥਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhraa te ghaT bheetar mu(n)dhraa kaa(n)iaa keejai khi(n)thaataa ||
verses.translation: Let your ear-rings be those ear-rings which pierce deep within your heart. Let your body be your patched coat.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਡੰਡਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch chele vas keejeh raaval ih man keejai dda(n)ddaataa ||1||
verses.translation: Let the five passions be disciples under your control, O begging Yogi, and make this mind your walking stick. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jog jugat iv paavasitaa ||
verses.translation: Thus you shall find the Way of Yoga.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek sabadh dhoojaa hor naasat ka(n)dh mool man laavasitaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: There is only the One Word of the Shabad; everything else shall pass away. Let this be the fruits and roots of your mind's diet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੂੰਡਿ ਮੁੰਡਾਇਐ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੰਗਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: moo(n)dd mu(n)ddaiaai je gur paieeaai ham gur keenee ga(n)gaataa ||
verses.translation: Some try to find the Guru by shaving their heads at the Ganges, but I have made the Guru my Ganges.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਅੰਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan taaranahaar suaamee ek na chetas a(n)dhaataa ||2||
verses.translation: The Saving Grace of the three worlds is the One Lord and Master, but those in darkness do not remember Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਪਟੰਬੁ ਗਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar paTa(n)b galee man laavas sa(n)saa mool na jaavasitaa ||
verses.translation: Practicing hypocrisy and attaching your mind to worldly objects, your doubt shall never depart.

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਕੀ ਧਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ekas charanee je chit laaveh lab lobh kee dhaavasitaa ||3||
verses.translation: If you focus your consciousness on the Feet of the One Lord, what reason would you have to chase after greed? ||3||

verses.original: ਜਪਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਚਸਿ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: japas nira(n)jan rachas manaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Immaculate Lord, and saturate your mind with Him.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਪਟੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe boleh jogee kapaT ghanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Why, O Yogi, do you make so many false and deceptive claims? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੀ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਆਣਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਣੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kamalee ha(n)s iaanaa meree meree karat bihaaneetaa ||
verses.translation: The body is wild, and the mind is foolish. Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, your life is passing away.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਗੀ ਦਾਝੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak naagee dhaajhai fir paachhai pachhutaaneetaa ||4||3||15||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, when the naked body is cremated, then you will come to regret and repent. ||4||3||15||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee chetee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaukhadh ma(n)tr mool man ekai je kar dhiraR chit keejai re ||
verses.translation: O mind, there is only the One medicine, mantra and healing herb - center your consciousness firmly on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke paap karam ke kaaTanahaaraa leejai re ||1||
verses.translation: Take to the Lord, the Destroyer of the sins and karma of past incarnations. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man eko saahib bhaiee re ||
verses.translation: The One Lord and Master is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere teen gunaa sa(n)saar samaaveh alakh na lakhanaa jaiee re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In Your three qualities, the world is engrossed; the Unknowable cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਹਮ ਤਉ ਪੰਡ ਉਚਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sakar kha(n)dd maiaa tan meeThee ham tau pa(n)dd uchaiee re ||
verses.translation: Maya is so sweet to the body, like sugar or molasses. We all carry loads of it.

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਜੁ ਟੂਕਸਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raat aneree soojhas naahee laj Tookas moosaa bhaiee re ||2||
verses.translation: In the dark of the night, nothing can be seen. The mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life, O Siblings of Destiny! ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kareh tetaa dhukh laagai gurmukh milai vaddaiee re ||
verses.translation: As the self-willed manmukhs act, they suffer in pain. The Gurmukh obtains honor and greatness.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tin keeaa soiee hoaa kirat na meTiaa jaiee re ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, that alone happens; past actions cannot be erased. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਊਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: subhar bhare na hoveh uoone jo raate ra(n)g laiee re ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with, and committed to the Lord's Love, are filled to overflowing; they never lack anything.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: tin kee pa(n)k hovai je naanak tau mooRaa kichh paiee re ||4||4||16||
verses.translation: If Nanak could be the dust of their feet, then he, the ignorant one, might also obtain some. ||4||4||16||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee chetee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਤ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਕਤ ਕੇਰਾ ਕਿਦੂ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: kat kee maiee baap kat keraa kidhoo thaavahu ham aae ||
verses.translation: Who is our mother, and who is our father? Where did we come from?

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਿਪਜੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: agan bi(n)b jal bheetar nipaje kaahe ka(n)m upaae ||1||
verses.translation: We are formed from the fire of the womb within, and the bubble of water of the sperm. For what purpose are we created? ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere saahibaa kaun jaanai gun tere ||
verses.translation: O my Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

verses.original: ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahe na jaanee aaugan mere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My own demerits cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਹਮ ਚੀਨੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਸੂ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kete rukh birakh ham cheene kete pasoo upaae ||
verses.translation: I took the form of so many plants and trees, and so many animals.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਗ ਕੁਲੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਖ ਉਡਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kete naag kulee meh aae kete pa(n)kh uddaae ||2||
verses.translation: Many times I entered the families of snakes and flying birds. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਭੰਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: haT paTan bij ma(n)dhar bha(n)nai kar choree ghar aavai ||
verses.translation: I broke into the shops of the city and well-guarded palaces; stealing from them, I snuck home again.

verses.original: ਅਗਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: agahu dhekhai pichhahu dhekhai tujh te kahaa chhapaavai ||3||
verses.translation: I looked in front of me, and I looked behind me, but where could I hide from You? ||3||

verses.original: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਮ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: taT teerath ham nav kha(n)dd dhekhe haT paTan baajaaraa ||
verses.translation: I saw the banks of sacred rivers, the nine continents, the shops and bazaars of the cities.

verses.original: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲਣਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: lai kai takaRee tolan laagaa ghaT hee meh vanajaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: Taking the scale, the merchant begins to weigh his actions within his own heart. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਤੇਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa samu(n)dh saagar neer bhariaa tete aaugan hamaare ||
verses.translation: As the seas and the oceans are overflowing with water, so vast are my own sins.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਹਰ ਉਪਾਵਹੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਥਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karahu kichh mihar upaavahu ddubadhe pathar taare ||5||
verses.translation: Please, shower me with Your Mercy, and take pity upon me. I am a sinking stone - please carry me across! ||5||

verses.original: ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਤਪੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਗੈ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeeaRaa agan baraabar tapai bheetar vagai kaatee ||
verses.translation: My soul is burning like fire, and the knife is cutting deep.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੬॥੫॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak hukam pachhaanai sukh hovai dhin raatee ||6||5||17||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, recognizing the Lord's Command, I am at peace, day and night. ||6||5||17||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: rain gavaiee soi kai dhivas gavaiaa khai ||
verses.translation: The nights are wasted sleeping, and the days are wasted eating.

verses.original: ਹੀਰੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: heere jaisaa janam hai kauddee badhale jai ||1||
verses.translation: Human life is such a precious jewel, but it is being lost in exchange for a mere shell. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam na jaaniaa raam kaa ||
verses.translation: You do not know the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mooRe fir paachhai pachhutaeh re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You fool - you shall regret and repent in the end! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀ ਧਰੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਚਾਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anataa dhan dharanee dhare anat na chaahiaa jai ||
verses.translation: You bury your temporary wealth in the ground, but how can you love that which is temporary?

verses.original: ਅਨਤ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਨ ਜੋ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਆਏ ਅਨਤ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anat kau chaahan jo ge se aae anat gavai ||2||
verses.translation: Those who have departed, after craving for temporary wealth, have returned home without this temporary wealth. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapan leeaa je milai taa sabh ko bhaagaTh hoi ||
verses.translation: If people could gather it in by their own efforts, then everyone would be so lucky.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karamaa upar nibaRai je lochai sabh koi ||3||
verses.translation: According to the karma of past actions, one's destiny unfolds, even though everyone wants to be so lucky. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak karanaa jin keeaa soiee saar karei ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He alone takes care of it.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: hukam na jaapee khasam kaa kisai vaddaiee dhei ||4||1||18||
verses.translation: The Hukam of our Lord and Master's Command cannot be known; He Himself blesses us with greatness. ||4||1||18||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਬਸਾ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haranee hovaa ban basaa ka(n)dh mool chun khaau ||
verses.translation: What if I were to become a deer, and live in the forest, picking and eating fruits and roots

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee meraa sahu milai vaar vaar hau jaau jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: - by Guru's Grace, I am a sacrifice to my Master. Again and again, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਬਨਜਾਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: mai banajaaran raam kee ||
verses.translation: I am the shop-keeper of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa naam vakhar vaapaar jee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Name is my merchandise and trade. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਹੋਵਾ ਅੰਬਿ ਬਸਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kokil hovaa a(n)b basaa sahaj sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: If I were to become a cuckoo, living in a mango tree, I would still contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahaj subhai meraa sahu milai dharasan roop apaar ||2||
verses.translation: I would still meet my Lord and Master, with intuitive ease; the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of His Form, is incomparably beautiful. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਸਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: machhulee hovaa jal basaa jeea ja(n)t sabh saar ||
verses.translation: If I were to become a fish, living in the water, I would still remember the Lord, who watches over all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਮਿਲਉਗੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: auravaar paar meraa sahu vasai hau milaugee baeh pasaar ||3||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord dwells on this shore, and on the shore beyond; I would still meet Him, and hug Him close in my embrace. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਗਨਿ ਹੋਵਾ ਧਰ ਵਸਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naagan hovaa dhar vasaa sabadh vasai bhau jai ||
verses.translation: If I were to become a snake, living in the ground, the Shabad would still dwell in my mind, and my fears would be dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak sadhaa sohaaganee jin jotee jot samai ||4||2||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are forever the happy soul-brides, whose light merges into His Light. ||4||2||19||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee dheepakee mahalaa pehilaa
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee Deepkee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jai ghar keerat aakheeaai karate kaa hoi beechaaro ||
verses.translation: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarahu sirajanahaaro ||1||
verses.translation: - in that house, sing the Songs of Praise, and meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum gaavahu mere nirabhau kaa sohilaa ||
verses.translation: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jaau jit sohilai sadhaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit jeeaRe samaaleean dhekhaigaa dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tere dhaanai keemat naa pavai tis dhaate kavan sumaar ||2||
verses.translation: Your gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)bat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel ||
verses.translation: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come - let's gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਆਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dheh sajan aaseesaReeaa jiau hovai saahib siau mel ||3||
verses.translation: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadhaRe nit pava(n)n ||
verses.translation: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

verses.original: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: sadhanahaaraa simareeaai naanak se dheh aava(n)n ||4||1||20||
verses.translation: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||20||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee guaareree ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree:

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa chaupadhe ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai har melaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, we meet the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape mel milaavai soiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself unites us in His Union.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh sabh bidh aape jaanai ||
verses.translation: My God knows all His Own Ways.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hukame mele sabadh pachhaanai ||1||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He unites those who recognize the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhi bhram bhau jai ||
verses.translation: By the Fear of the True Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhai raachai sach ra(n)g samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Imbued with His Fear, we are absorbed in the Love of the True One. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai har man vasai subhai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, the Lord naturally dwells within the mind.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh bhaaraa keemat nahee pai ||
verses.translation: My God is Great and Almighty; His value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh saalaahai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, I praise Him; He has no end or limitations.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh bakhase bakhasanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: My God is the Forgiver. I pray that He may forgive me. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai sabh mat budh hoi ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, all wisdom and understanding are obtained.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man niramal vasai sach soi ||
verses.translation: The mind becomes pure, when the True Lord dwells within.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: saach vasiaai saachee sabh kaar ||
verses.translation: When one dwells in Truth, all actions become true.

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: uootam karanee sabadh beechaar ||3||
verses.translation: The ultimate action is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur te saachee sevaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, true service is performed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam pachhaanai koi ||
verses.translation: How rare is that Gurmukh who recognizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeevai dhaataa dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Giver, the Great Giver, lives forever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak har naame lagai piaar ||4||1||21||
verses.translation: Nanak enshrines love for the Name of the Lord. ||4||1||21||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur te giaan paae jan koi ||
verses.translation: Those who obtain spiritual wisdom from the Guru are very rare.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੀਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur te boojhai seejhai soi ||
verses.translation: Those who obtain this understanding from the Guru become acceptable.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur te sahaj saach beechaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, we intuitively contemplate the True One.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur te paae mukat dhuaar ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, the Gate of Liberation is found. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag milai gur aai ||
verses.translation: Through perfect good destiny, we come to meet the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saachai sahaj saach samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The true ones are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai tirasanaa agan bujhaae ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, the fire of desire is quenched.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur te saa(n)t vasai man aae ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur te pavit paavan such hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, we become pure, holy and true.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur te sabadh milaavaa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, we are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo sabh bharam bhulaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, everyone wanders in doubt.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai bahutaa dhukh paiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, they suffer in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su naam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Naam become Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dharasan sachai sachee pat hoiee ||3||
verses.translation: True honor is obtained through the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kis no kaheeaai dhaataa ik soiee ||
verses.translation: Why speak of any other? He alone is the Giver.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare sabadh milaavaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: When He grants His Grace, union with the Shabad is obtained.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: mil preetam saache gun gaavaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saache saach samaavaa ||4||2||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, becoming true, I am absorbed in the True One. ||4||2||22||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁ ਥਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: s thaau sach man niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: True is that place, where the mind becomes pure.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach nivaas kare sach soi ||
verses.translation: True is the one who abides in Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee jug chaare jaapai ||
verses.translation: The True Bani of the Word is known throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh saachaa aape aapai ||1||
verses.translation: The True One Himself is everything. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: karam hovai satasa(n)g milaae ||
verses.translation: Through the karma of good actions, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavai bais su thaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glories of the Lord, sitting in that place. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਲਉ ਇਹ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jalau ieh jihavaa dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: Burn this tongue, which loves duality,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਾਖੈ ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ras na chaakhai feekaa aalai ||
verses.translation: which does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and which utters insipid words.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe tan man feekaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Without understanding, the body and mind become tasteless and insipid.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin naavai dhukheeaa chaliaa roi ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the miserable ones depart crying out in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa har ras chaakhiaa sahaj subhai || gur kirapaa te sach samai ||
verses.translation: One whose tongue naturally and intuitively tastes the Lord's sublime essence, by Guru's Grace, is absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: saache raatee gur sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Imbued with Truth, one contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad,

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਧਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit peevai niramal dhaar ||3||
verses.translation: and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, from the immaculate stream within. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਭਾਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam samaavai jo bhaaddaa hoi ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is collected in the vessel of the mind.

verses.original: ਊਂਧੈ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: uoo(n)dhai bhaa(n)ddai Tikai na koi ||
verses.translation: Nothing is collected if the vessel is upside-down.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee man naam nivaas ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Naam abides within the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sach bhaa(n)ddaa jis sabadh piaas ||4||3||23||
verses.translation: O Nanak, True is that vessel of the mind, which thirsts for the Shabad. ||4||3||23||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik gaavat rahe man saadh na pai ||
verses.translation: Some sing on and on, but their minds do not find happiness.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich gaaveh birathaa jai ||
verses.translation: In egotism, they sing, but it is wasted uselessly.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਣਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan gaaveh jin naam piaar ||
verses.translation: Those who love the Naam, sing the song.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saachee baanee sabadh beechaar ||1||
verses.translation: They contemplate the True Bani of the Word, and the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਤ ਰਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gaavat rahai je satigur bhaavai ||
verses.translation: They sing on and on, if it pleases the True Guru.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan raataa naam suhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are embellished and adorned, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik gaaveh ik bhagat kareh ||
verses.translation: Some sing, and some perform devotional worship.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਸਨੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: naam na paaveh bin asaneh ||
verses.translation: Without heart-felt love, the Naam is not obtained.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sachee bhagat gur sabadh piaar ||
verses.translation: True devotional worship consists of love for the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: apanaa pir raakhiaa sadhaa ur dhaar ||2||
verses.translation: The devotee keeps his Beloved clasped tightly to his heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat kareh moorakh aap janaaveh ||
verses.translation: The fools perform devotional worship by showing off;

verses.original: ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਟਪਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: nach nach Tapeh bahut dhukh paaveh ||
verses.translation: they dance and dance and jump all around, but they only suffer in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਨਚਿਐ ਟਪਿਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: nachiaai Tapiaai bhagat na hoi ||
verses.translation: By dancing and jumping, devotional worship is not performed.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai bhagat paae jan soi ||3||
verses.translation: But one who dies in the Word of the Shabad, obtains devotional worship. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal bhagat karaae soi ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He inspires them to perform devotional worship.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachee bhagat vichahu aap khoi ||
verses.translation: True devotional worship consists of eliminating selfishness and conceit from within.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh saachaa sabh bidh jaanai ||
verses.translation: My True God knows all ways and means.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak bakhase naam pachhaanai ||4||4||24||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He forgives those who recognize the Naam. ||4||4||24||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਧਾਤੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man maare dhaat mar jai ||
verses.translation: When someone kills and subdues his own mind, his wandering nature is also subdued.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂਏ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin mooe kaise har pai ||
verses.translation: Without such a death, how can one find the Lord?

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man marai dhaaroo jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: Only a few know the medicine to kill the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man sabadh marai boojhai jan soi ||1||
verses.translation: One whose mind dies in the Word of the Shabad, understands Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no bakhase dhe vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: He grants greatness to those whom He forgives.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh har vasai man aaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh karanee kaar kamaavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh practices doing good deeds;

verses.original: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: taa is man kee sojhee paavai ||
verses.translation: thus he comes to understand this mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਗਲ ਮਿਕਦਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man mai mat maigal mikadhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The mind is like an elephant, drunk with wine.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur a(n)kas maar jeevaalanahaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru is the rod which controls it, and shows it the way. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man asaadh saadhai jan koi ||
verses.translation: The mind is uncontrollable; how rare are those who subdue it.

verses.original: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: achar charai taa niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who move the immovable become pure.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਇਆ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ih man liaa savaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs embellish and beautify this mind.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai vichahu taje vikaar ||3||
verses.translation: They eradicate egotism and corruption from within. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਅਨੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur raakhian mel milai ||
verses.translation: Those who, by pre-ordained destiny, are united in the Lord's Union,

verses.original: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kadhe na vichhuReh sabadh samai ||
verses.translation: are never separated from Him again; they are absorbed in the Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee kalaa aape hee jaanai ||
verses.translation: He Himself knows His Own Almighty Power.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam pachhaanai ||4||5||25||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||25||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich sabh jag bauraanaa ||
verses.translation: The entire world has gone insane in egotism.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai bharam bhulaanaa ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, it wanders deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahu chi(n)taa chitavai aap na pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: The mind is distracted by great anxiety; no one recognizes one's own self.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਿਹਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa karatiaa anadhin vihaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Occupied with their own affairs, their nights and days are passing away. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai raam ramahu mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord in your hearts, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh rasanaa har rasan rasaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh's tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hiradhai jin raam pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs recognize the Lord in their own hearts;

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan sev jug chaare jaataa ||
verses.translation: they serve the Lord, the Life of the World. They are famous throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar gur sabadh pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: They subdue egotism, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare prabh karam bidhaataa ||2||
verses.translation: God, the Architect of Destiny, showers His Mercy upon them. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: se jan sache jo gur sabadh milaae ||
verses.translation: True are those who merge into the Word of the Guru's Shabad;

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤ ਵਰਜੇ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat varaje Thaak rahaae ||
verses.translation: they restrain their wandering mind and keep it steady.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam nav nidh gur te paae ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the nine treasures. It is obtained from the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa te har vasai man aae ||3||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: raam raam karatiaa sukh saa(n)t sareer ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, the body becomes peaceful and tranquil.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar vasai na laagai jam peer ||
verses.translation: He dwells deep within - the pain of death does not touch Him.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਜੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: aape saahib aap vajeer ||
verses.translation: He Himself is our Lord and Master; He is His Own Advisor.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: naanak sev sadhaa har gunee gaheer ||4||6||26||
verses.translation: O Nanak, serve the Lord forever; He is the treasure of glorious virtue. ||4||6||26||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau visarai jis ke jeea paraanaa ||
verses.translation: Why forget Him, unto whom the soul and the breath of life belong?

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau visarai sabh maeh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: Why forget Him, who is all-pervading?

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jit seviaai dharageh pat paravaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Serving Him, one is honored and accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam viTahu bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਦਿ ਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) visareh tadh hee mar jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If I were to forget You, at that very instant, I would die. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tin too(n) visareh j tudh aap bhulaae ||
verses.translation: Those whom You Yourself have led astray, forget You.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tin too(n) visareh j dhoojai bhaae ||
verses.translation: Thse who are in love with duality forget You.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: manmukh agiaanee jonee paae ||2||
verses.translation: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs are consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥ ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jin ik man tuThaa se satigur sevaa laae || jin ik man tuThaa tin har ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to the One Lord are assigned to His service and enshrine Him within their minds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmatee har naam samaae ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa potai pu(n)n se giaan beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Those who have virtue as their treasure, contemplate spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa potai pu(n)n tin haumai maaree ||
verses.translation: Those who have virtue as their treasure, subdue egotism.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak jo naam rate tin kau balihaaree ||4||7||27||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||7||27||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਥਿਆ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) akath kiau kathiaa jaeh ||
verses.translation: You are Indescribable; how can I describe You?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh maaran man maeh samaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who subdue their minds, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are absorbed in You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tere gun anek keemat neh paeh ||1||
verses.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are countless; their value cannot be estimated. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis kee baanee tis maeh samaanee ||
verses.translation: The Word of His Bani belongs to Him; in Him, it is diffused.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teree akath kathaa gur sabadh vakhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Speech cannot be spoken; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is chanted. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਹ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh satigur teh satasa(n)gat banaiee ||
verses.translation: Where the True Guru is - there is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh satigur sahaje har gun gaiee ||
verses.translation: Where the True Guru is - there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are intuitively sung.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਹਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeh satigur tahaa haumai sabadh jalaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Where the True Guru is - there egotism is burnt away, through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਥਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sevaa mahalee thaau paae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs serve Him; they obtain a place in the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)tar har naam vasaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs enshrine the Naam within the mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat har naam samaae ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhaat kare dhaataar ||
verses.translation: The Giver Himself gives His Gifts,

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: poore satigur siau lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: as we enshrine love for the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate tin kau jaikaar ||4||8||28||
verses.translation: Nanak celebrates those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||28||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ ਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: ekas te sabh roop heh ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: All forms and colors come from the One Lord.

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਹਲੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee baisa(n)tar sabh sahala(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Air, water and fire are all kept together.

verses.original: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n vekhai har prabh ra(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord God beholds the many and various colors. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ek acharaj eko hai soiee ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is wondrous and amazing! He is the One, the One and Only.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh veechaare viralaa koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How rare is that Gurmukh who meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਭਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj bhavai prabh sabhanee thaiee ||
verses.translation: God is naturally pervading all places.

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa gupat pragaT prabh banat banaiee ||
verses.translation: Sometimes He is hidden, and sometimes He is revealed; thus God has made the world of His making.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape sutiaa dhei jagaiee ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself wakes us from sleep. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee keemat kinai na hoiee ||
verses.translation: No one can estimate His value,

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: keh keh kathan kahai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: although everyone has tried, over and over again, to describe Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh samaavai boojhai har soiee ||3||
verses.translation: Those who merge in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, come to understand the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun vekhai sabadh milaae ||
verses.translation: They listen to the Shabad continually; beholding Him, they merge into Him.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee gur sevaa te paae ||
verses.translation: They obtain glorious greatness by serving the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate har naam samaae ||4||9||29||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||9||29||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh sootaa maiaa moh piaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are asleep, in love and attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaage gun giaan beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are awake, contemplating spiritual wisdom and the Glory of God.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: se jan jaage jin naam piaar ||1||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who love the Naam, are awake and aware. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje jaagai savai na koi ||
verses.translation: One who is awake to this intuitive wisdom does not fall asleep.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te boojhai jan koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How rare are those humble beings who understand this through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਸੰਤੁ ਅਨਾੜੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)t anaaRee kadhe na boojhai ||
verses.translation: The unsaintly blockhead shall never understand.

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: kathanee kare tai maiaa naal loojhai ||
verses.translation: He babbles on and on, but he is infatuated with Maya.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh agiaanee kadhe na seejhai ||2||
verses.translation: Blind and ignorant, he shall never be reformed. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug meh raam naam nisataaraa ||
verses.translation: In this age, salvation comes only from the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: viralaa ko paae gur sabadh veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap tarai sagale kul udhaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: They save themselves, and save all their family and ancestors as well. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis kalijug meh karam dharam na koiee ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, no one is interested in good karma, or Dharmic faith.

verses.original: ਕਲੀ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kalee kaa janam cha(n)ddaal kai ghar hoiee ||
verses.translation: This Dark Age was born in the house of evil.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam binaa ko mukat na hoiee ||4||10||30||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is liberated. ||4||10||30||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa teejaa guaareree ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Third Mehla, Gwaarayree:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa amar sachaa paatisaahu ||
verses.translation: True is the Lord King, True is His Royal Command.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man saachai raate har veparavaahu || sachai mahal sach naam samaahu ||1||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are attuned to the True, Carefree Lord enter the True Mansion of His Presence, and merge in the True Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sun man mere sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my mind: contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam japahu bhavajal utarahu paar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਭਰਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bharame aavai bharame jai ||
verses.translation: In doubt he comes, and in doubt he goes.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag janamiaa dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: This world is born out of the love of duality.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: manmukh na chetai aavai jai ||2||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord; he continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap bhulaa k prabh aap bhulaiaa ||
verses.translation: Does he himself go astray, or does God lead him astray?

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih jeeau viddaanee chaakaree laiaa ||
verses.translation: This soul is enjoined to the service of someone else.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mahaa dhukh khaTe birathaa janam gavaiaa ||3||
