verses.translit: mere man so prabh sadhaa naal hai suaamee kahu kithai har pahu naseeaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, God is always with you; He is your Lord and Master. Tell me, where could you run to get away from the Lord?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har aape bakhas le prabh saachaa har aap chhaddaae chhuTeeaai ||1||
verses.translation: The True Lord God Himself grants forgiveness; we are emancipated only when the Lord Himself emancipates us. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap har har har man japeeaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har - chant it in your mind.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee saranaiee bhaj pau mere manaa gur satigur peechhai chhuTeeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Quickly now, run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, O my mind; following the Guru, the True Guru, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere man sevahu so prabh srab sukhadhaataa jit seviaai nij ghar vaseeaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve God, the Giver of all peace; serving Him, you shall come to dwell in your own home deep within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਘਸੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jai lahahu ghar apanaa ghas cha(n)dhan har jas ghaseeaai ||2||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, go and enter your own home; anoint yourself with the sandalwood oil of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਸੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har har har har har jas uootam lai laahaa har man haseeaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are exalted and sublime. Earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and let your mind be happy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har aap dhiaa kar dhevai taa a(n)mrit har ras chakheeaai ||3||
verses.translation: If the Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy, bestows it, then we partake of the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਜਮਿ ਘੁਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere man naam binaa jo dhoojai laage te saakat nar jam ghuTeeaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and attached to duality, those faithless cynics are strangled by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਚੋਰ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: te saakat chor jinaa naam visaariaa man tin kai nikaT na bhiTeeaai ||4||
verses.translation: Such faithless cynics, who have forgotten the Naam, are thieves. O my mind, do not even go near them. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਲੇਖਾ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere man sevahu alakh nira(n)jan narahar jit seviaai lekhaa chhuTeeaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve the Unknowable and Immaculate Lord, the Man-lion; serving Him, your account will be cleared.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਘਟੀਐ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੯॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har prabh poore ke'ee khin maasaa tol na ghaTeeaai ||5||5||19||57||
verses.translation: The Lord God has made servant Nanak perfect; he is not diminished by even the tiniest particle. ||5||5||19||57||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hamare praan vasagat prabh tumarai meraa jeeau pi(n)dd sabh teree ||
verses.translation: My breath of life is in Your Power, God; my soul and body are totally Yours.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਘਣੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karahu har dharas dhikhaavahu merai man tan loch ghaneree ||1||
verses.translation: Be merciful to me, and show me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. There is such a great longing within my mind and body! ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਮਿਲਣ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: raam merai man tan loch milan har keree ||
verses.translation: O my Lord, there is such a great longing within my mind and body to meet the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaal kirapaa ki(n)chat gur keenee har miliaa aai prabh meree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the Guru, the Merciful Guru, showed just a little mercy to me, my Lord God came and met me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo hamarai man chit hai suaamee saa bidh tum har jaanahu meree ||
verses.translation: Whatever is in my conscious mind, O Lord and Master - that condition of mine is known only to You, Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਵਾ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam japee sukh paiee nit jeevaa aas har teree ||2||
verses.translation: Night and day, I chant Your Name, and I find peace. I live by placing my hopes in You, Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur dhaatai pa(n)th bataiaa har miliaa aai prabh meree ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, has shown me the Way; my Lord God came and met me.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਭ ਆਸ ਪੁਜੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin anadh bhiaa vaddabhaagee sabh aas pujee jan keree ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, I am filled with bliss; by great good fortune, all of the hopes of His humble servant have been fulfilled. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaga(n)naath jagadheesur karate sabh vasagat hai har keree ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe, everything is under Your control.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੦॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saranaagat aae har raakhahu paij jan keree ||4||6||20||58||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please, preserve the honor of Your humble servant. ||4||6||20||58||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਹਾਢੇ ॥
verses.translit: eih manooaa khin na Tikai bahu ra(n)gee dheh dheh dhis chal chal haadde ||
verses.translation: This mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts of distractions, it wanders around aimlessly in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa paiaa vaddabhaagee har ma(n)tr dheeaa man Thaadde ||1||
verses.translation: I have found the Perfect Guru, through great good fortune; He has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and my mind has become quiet and tranquil. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾਂਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam ham satigur laale kaa(n)dde ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I am the slave of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਾਗੁ ਦਗਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
verses.translit: hamarai masatak dhaag dhagaanaa ham karaj guroo bahu saadde ||
verses.translation: My forehead has been branded with His brand; I owe such a great debt to the Guru.

verses.original: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਢੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paraupakaar pu(n)n bahu keeaa bhau dhutar taar paraadde ||2||
verses.translation: He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ ਗਾਢੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau preet ridhai har naahee tin koore gaaddan gaadde ||
verses.translation: Those who do not have love for the Lord within their hearts, harbor only false intentions and goals.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਰਭਿ ਗਲਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau paanee kaagadh binas jaat hai tiau manmukh garabh galaadde ||3||
verses.translation: As paper breaks down and dissolves in water, the self-willed manmukh wastes away in arrogant pride. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham jaaniaa kachhoo na jaaneh aagai jiau har raakhai tiau Thaadde ||
verses.translation: I know nothing, and I do not know the future; as the Lord keeps me, so do I stand.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਤਰੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: ham bhool chook gur kirapaa dhaarahu jan naanak kutare kaadde ||4||7||21||59||
verses.translation: For my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace; servant Nanak is Your obedient dog. ||4||7||21||59||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo kha(n)ddal kha(n)ddaa he ||
verses.translation: The body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poorab likhat likhe gur paiaa man har liv ma(n)ddal ma(n)ddaa he ||1||
verses.translation: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar saadhoo a(n)julee pu(n)n vaddaa he ||
verses.translation: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar dda(n)ddaut pun vaddaa he ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat har ras saadh na jaaniaa tin a(n)tar haumai ka(n)ddaa he ||
verses.translation: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the taste of the Lord's sublime essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau chaleh chubhai dhukh paaveh jamakaal saheh sir dda(n)ddaa he ||2||
verses.translation: The more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan har har naam samaane dhukh janam maran bhav kha(n)ddaa he ||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: abinaasee purakh paiaa paramesar bahu sobh kha(n)dd brahama(n)ddaa he ||3||
verses.translation: They have obtained the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they obtain great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vadd vaddaa he ||
verses.translation: I am poor and meek, God, but I am Yours! Save me, please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam adhaar Tek hai har naame hee sukh ma(n)ddaa he ||4||8||22||60||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||8||22||60||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਧੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis gaR meh har raam rai hai kichh saadh na paavai dheeThaa ||
verses.translation: Within this body-fortress is the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King, but the stubborn ones do not find the taste.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har dheen dhiaal anugrahu keeaa har gur sabadhee chakh ddeeThaa ||1||
verses.translation: When the Lord, Merciful to the meek, showed His Mercy, I found and tasted it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam har keeratan gur liv meeThaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Lovingly focused upon the Guru, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has become sweet to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: har agam agochar paarabraham hai mil satigur laag baseeThaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who are committed to the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, meet the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਪਰੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin gur bachan sukhaane heearai tin aagai aan pareeThaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are pleased with the Guru's Teachings - the Lord's Presence is revealed to them. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh heearaa at kaThor hai tin a(n)tar kaar kareeThaa ||
verses.translation: The hearts of the self-willed manmukhs are hard and cruel; their inner beings are dark.

verses.original: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਫੋਲਿ ਫੁਲੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: biseear kau bahu dhoodh peeaaieeaai bikh nikasai fol fuleeThaa ||3||
verses.translation: Even if the poisonous snake is fed large amounts of milk, it will still yield only poison. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਘਸਿ ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh aan milaavahu gur saadhoo ghas garuR sabadh mukh leeThaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please unite me with the Holy Guru, so that I might joyfully grind and eat the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੂਆ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੩॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gur ke laale gole lag sa(n)gat karooaa meeThaa ||4||9||23||61||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Guru; in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the bitter becomes sweet. ||4||9||23||61||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har arath sareer ham bechiaa poore gur kai aage ||
verses.translation: For the sake of the Lord, Har, Har, I have sold my body to the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaatai naam dhiRaiaa mukh masatak bhaag sabhaage ||1||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. A very blessed and fortunate destiny is recorded upon my forehead. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam gurmat har liv laage ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I am lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT ramieeaa ramat raam rai gur sabadh guroo liv laage ||
verses.translation: The All-pervading Sovereign Lord King is contained in each and every heart. Through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am lovingly centered on the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau man tan dhevau kaaT guroo kau meraa bhram bhau gur bachanee bhaage ||2||
verses.translation: Cutting my mind and body into pieces, I offer them to my Guru. The Guru's Teachings have dispelled my doubt and fear. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਆਨਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhiaarai dheepak aan jalaae gur giaan guroo liv laage ||
verses.translation: In the darkness, the Guru has lit the lamp of the Guru's wisdom; I am lovingly focused on the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੀ ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: agiaan a(n)dheraa binas binaasio ghar vasat lahee man jaage ||3||
verses.translation: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, and my mind has been awakened; within the home of my inner being, I have found the genuine article. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat badhik maiaadhaaree tin jam johan laage ||
verses.translation: The vicious hunters, the faithless cynics, are hunted down by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਉਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਨ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aun satigur aagai sees na bechiaa oi aaveh jaeh abhaage ||4||
verses.translation: They have not sold their heads to the True Guru; those wretched, unfortunate ones continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa binau sunahu prabh Thaakur ham saran prabhoo har maage ||
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, O God, my Lord and Master: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲਜ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਬੇਚਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੪॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kee laj paat guroo hai sir bechio satigur aage ||5||10||24||62||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak's honor and respect is the Guru; he has sold his head to the True Guru. ||5||10||24||62||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ham aha(n)kaaree aha(n)kaar agiaan mat gur miliaai aap gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am egotistical and conceited, and my intellect is ignorant. Meeting the Guru, my selfishness and conceit have been abolished.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haumai rog giaa sukh paiaa dhan dha(n)n guroo har raiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The illness of egotism is gone, and I have found peace. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam gur kai bachan har paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have found the Lord, through the Teachings of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: merai heearai preet raam rai kee gur maarag pa(n)th bataiaa ||
verses.translation: My heart is filled with love for the Sovereign Lord King; the Guru has shown me the path and the way to find Him.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meraa jeeau pi(n)dd sabh satigur aagai jin vichhuRiaa har gal laiaa ||2||
verses.translation: My soul and body all belong to the Guru; I was separated, and He has led me into the Lord's Embrace. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: merai a(n)tar preet lagee dhekhan kau gur hiradhe naal dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Deep within myself, I would love to see the Lord; the Guru has inspired me to see Him within my heart.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sahaj ana(n)dh bhiaa man morai gur aagai aap vechaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Within my mind, intuitive peace and bliss have arisen; I have sold myself to the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ham aparaadh paap bahu keene kar dhusaTee chor churaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sinner - I have committed so many sins; I am a villainous, thieving thief.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੫॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: ab naanak saranaagat aae har raakhahu laaj har bhaiaa ||4||11||25||63||
verses.translation: Now, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary; preserve my honor, Lord, as it pleases Your Will. ||4||11||25||63||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat baajai sabadh anaahadh gurmat manooaa gaavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the unstruck music resounds; through the Guru's Teachings, the mind sings.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur dharasan paiaa dhan dha(n)n guroo liv laavai ||1||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I received the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has led me to love the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har liv laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa Thaakur satigur pooraa man gur kee kaar kamaavai ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is the Perfect True Guru. My mind works to serve the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ham mal mal dhoveh paav guroo ke jo har har kathaa sunaavai ||2||
verses.translation: I massage and wash the Feet of the Guru, who recites the Sermon of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai gurmat raam rasain jihavaa har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: The Teachings of the Guru are in my heart; the Lord is the Source of nectar. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man rasak rasak har ras aaghaane fir bahur na bhookh lagaavai ||3||
verses.translation: My mind is immersed in, and drenched with the Lord's essence. Fulfilled with the Lord's Love, I shall never feel hunger again. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਾਵ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: koiee karai upaav anek bahutere bin kirapaa naam na paavai ||
verses.translation: People try all sorts of things, but without the Lord's Mercy, His Name is not obtained.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੬॥੬੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har kirapaa dhaaree mat gurmat naam dhiraRaavai ||4||12||26||64||
verses.translation: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, he has enshrined the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||26||64||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ji(n)dhoo jap naam kara(n)maa ||
verses.translation: O my soul, as Gurmukh, do this deed: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: mat maataa mat jeeau naam mukh raamaa ||
verses.translation: Make that teaching your mother, that it may teach you to keep the Lord's Name in your mouth.

verses.original: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tokh pitaa kar gur purakh ajanamaa ||
verses.translation: Let contentment be your father; the Guru is the Primal Being, beyond birth or incarnation.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee mil raamaa ||1||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, you shall meet with the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur jogee purakh miliaa ra(n)g maanee jeeau ||
verses.translation: I have met the Guru, the Yogi, the Primal Being; I am delighted with His Love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur har ra(n)g rataRaa sadhaa nirabaanee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Guru is imbued with the Love of the Lord; He dwells forever in Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee mil sughaR sujaanee jeeau ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I met the most accomplished and all-knowing Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meraa man tan har ra(n)g bhi(n)naa ||2||
verses.translation: My mind and body are drenched in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu sa(n)tahu mil naam japaahaa ||
verses.translation: Come, O Saints - let's meet together and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: vich sa(n)gat naam sadhaa lai laahaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, let's earn the lasting profit of the Naam.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar sevaa sa(n)taa a(n)mrit mukh paahaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Let's serve the Saints, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਅੜੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mil poorab likhiaRe dhur karamaa ||3||
verses.translation: By one's karma and pre-ordained destiny, they are met. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: saavan varas a(n)mirat jag chhaiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the month of Saawan, the clouds of Ambrosial Nectar hang over the world.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰੁ ਕੁਹੁਕਿਅੜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man mor kuhukiaRaa sabadh mukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: The peacock of the mind chirps, and receives the Word of the Shabad, in its mouth;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mrit vuThaRaa miliaa har raiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord rains down, and the Sovereign Lord King is met.

verses.translit: jan naanak prem rata(n)naa ||4||1||27||65||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||1||27||65||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰੀਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aau sakhee gun kaaman kareehaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Come, O sisters - let's make virtue our charms.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਹ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)t janaa ra(n)g maaneh raleeaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Let's join the Saints, and enjoy the pleasure of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur dheepak giaan sadhaa man baleeaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom burns steadily in my mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਢੁਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har tuThai ddul ddul mileeaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, being pleased and moved by pity, has led me to meet Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan prem lagaa har ddole jeeau ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are filled with love for my Darling Lord.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਚੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai mele mitr satigur vechole jeeau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, has united me with my Friend.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਸੰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man dhevaa(n) sa(n)taa meraa prabh mele jeeau ||
verses.translation: I offer my mind to the Guru, who has led me to meet my God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਘੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har viTaRiahu sadhaa ghole jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: vas mere piaariaa vas mere govidhaa har kar kirapaa man vas jeeau ||
verses.translation: Dwell, O my Beloved, dwell, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, show mercy to me and come to dwell within my mind.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaRaa fal paiaa mere govi(n)dhaa gur pooraa vekh vigas jeeau ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O my Lord of the Universe; I am transfixed with ecstasy, gazing upon the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har naam miliaa sohaaganee mere govi(n)dhaa man anadhin anadh rahas jeeau ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-brides receive the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; night and day, their minds are blissful and happy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਨਿ ਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har paiaRaa vaddabhaageeiee mere govi(n)dhaa nit lai laahaa man has jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the Lord is found, O my Lord of the Universe; earning profit continually, the mind laughs with joy. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har aap upaae har aape vekhai har aape kaarai laiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself creates, and the Lord Himself beholds; the Lord Himself assigns all to their tasks.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਬਖਸ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਫਕਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eik khaaveh bakhas toT na aavai ikanaa fakaa paiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Some partake of the bounty of the Lord's favor, which never runs out, while others receive only a handful.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਿਖ ਮੰਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eik raaje takhat baheh nit sukhe'ee ikanaa bhikh ma(n)gaiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Some sit upon thrones as kings, and enjoy constant pleasures, while others must beg for charity.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥੬੬॥
verses.translit: sabh iko sabadh varatadhaa mere govidhaa jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa jeeau ||4||2||28||66||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad is pervading in everyone, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||4||2||28||66||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man maahee man maahee mere govi(n)dhaa har ra(n)g rataa man maahee jeeau ||
verses.translation: From within my mind, from within my mind, O my Lord of the Universe, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord, from within my mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g naal na lakheeaai mere govidhaa gur pooraa alakh lakhaahee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Love is with me, but it cannot be seen, O my Lord of the Universe; the Perfect Guru has led me to see the unseen.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਸਭ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam paragaasiaa mere govi(n)dhaa sabh dhaaladh dhukh leh jaahee jeeau ||
verses.translation: He has revealed the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Lord of the Universe; all poverty and pain have departed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har padh uootam paiaa mere govi(n)dhaa vaddabhaagee naam samaahee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: I have obtained the supreme status of the Lord, O my Lord of the Universe; by great good fortune, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠੜਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: nainee mere piaariaa nainee mere govidhaa kinai har prabh ddiThaRaa nainee jeeau ||
verses.translation: With his eyes, O my Beloved, with his eyes, O my Lord of the Universe - has anyone ever seen the Lord God with his eyes?

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man tan bahut bairaagiaa mere govi(n)dhaa har baajhahu dhan kumalainee jeeau ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are sad and depressed, O my Lord of the Universe; without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is withering away.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa mil paiaa mere govidhaa meraa har prabh sajan sainee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Saints, O my Lord of the Universe, I have found my Lord God, my Companion, my Best Friend.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਰੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har aai miliaa jagajeevan mere govi(n)dhaa mai sukh vihaanee rainee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Life of the World, has come to meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. The night of my life now passes in peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai melahu sa(n)t meraa har prabh sajan mai man tan bhukh lagaieeaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: O Saints, unite me with my Lord God, my Best Friend; my mind and body are hungry for Him.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau reh na sakau bin dhekhe mere preetam mai a(n)tar birahu har laieeaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved; deep within, I feel the pain of separation from the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har raiaa meraa sajan piaaraa gur mele meraa man jeevaieeaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Sovereign Lord King is my Beloved, my Best Friend. Through the Guru, I have met Him, and my mind has been rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: merai man tan aasaa pooreeaa mere govi(n)dhaa har miliaa man vaadhaieeaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The hopes of my mind and body have been fulfilled, O my Lord of the Universe; meeting the Lord, my mind vibrates with joy. ||3||

verses.original: ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaaree mere govi(n)dhaa vaaree mere piaariaa hau tudh viTaRiahu sadh vaaree jeeau ||
verses.translation: A sacrifice, O my Lord of the Universe, a sacrifice, O my Beloved; I am forever a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan prem pira(n)m kaa mere govidhaa har poo(n)jee raakh hamaaree jeeau ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are filled with love for my Husband Lord; O my Lord of the Universe, please preserve my assets.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਰੈਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur visaT mel mere govi(n)dhaa har mele kar raibaaree jeeau ||
verses.translation: Unite me with the True Guru, Your Advisor, O my Lord of the Universe; through His guidance, He shall lead me to the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੭॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaa kar paiaa mere govi(n)dhaa jan naanak saran tumaaree jeeau ||4||3||29||67||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Lord's Name, by Your Mercy, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||29||67||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: chojee mere govi(n)dhaa chojee mere piaariaa har prabh meraa chojee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Playful is my Lord of the Universe; playful is my Beloved. My Lord God is wondrous and playful.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਪੀ ਖੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har aape kaan(h) upaidhaa mere govidhaa har aape gopee khojee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself created Krishna, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is the milkmaids who seek Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har aape sabh ghaT bhogadhaa mere govi(n)dhaa aape raseeaa bhogee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself enjoys every heart, O my Lord of the Universe; He Himself is the Ravisher and the Enjoyer.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har sujaan na bhuliee mere govi(n)dhaa aape satigur jogee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord is All-knowing - He cannot be fooled, O my Lord of the Universe. He is the True Guru, the Yogi. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aape jagat upaidhaa mere govidhaa har aap khelai bahu ra(n)gee jeeau ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself plays in so many ways!

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨੰਗ ਨੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa bhog bhogaidhaa mere govi(n)dhaa ik nagan fireh na(n)g na(n)gee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Some enjoy enjoyments, O my Lord of the Universe, while others wander around naked, the poorest of the poor.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aape jagat upaidhaa mere govidhaa har dhaan dhevai sabh ma(n)gee jeeau ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord gives His gifts to all who beg for them.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagataa naam aadhaar hai mere govi(n)dhaa har kathaa ma(n)geh har cha(n)gee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: His devotees have the Support of the Naam, O my Lord of the Universe; they beg for the sublime sermon of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਲੋਚ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har aape bhagat karaidhaa mere govi(n)dhaa har bhagataa loch man pooree jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself inspires His devotees to worship Him, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord fulfills the desires of the minds of His devotees.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aape jal thal varatadhaa mere govidhaa rav rahiaa nahee dhooree jeeau ||
verses.translation: He Himself is permeating and pervading the waters and the lands, O my Lord of the Universe; He is All-pervading - He is not far away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)tar baahar aap hai mere govidhaa har aap rahiaa bharapooree jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is within the self, and outside as well, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is fully pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har aatam raam pasaariaa mere govi(n)dhaa har vekhai aap hadhooree jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is diffused everywhere, O my Lord of the Universe. The Lord Himself beholds all; His Immanent Presence is pervading everywhere. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)tar vaajaa paun hai mere govi(n)dhaa har aap vajaae tiau vaajai jeeau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, the music of the praanic wind is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; as the Lord Himself plays this music, so does it vibrate and resound.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)tar naam nidhaan hai mere govi(n)dhaa gur sabadhee har prabh gaajai jeeau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, the treasure of the Naam is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord God is revealed.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aape saran pavaidhaa mere govi(n)dhaa har bhagat janaa raakh laajai jeeau ||
verses.translation: He Himself leads us to enter His Sanctuary, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord preserves the honor of His devotees.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੮॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee mil sa(n)gatee mere govi(n)dhaa jan naanak naam sidh kaajai jeeau ||4||4||30||68||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one joins the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, O my Lord of the Universe; O servant Nanak, through the Naam, one's affairs are resolved. ||4||4||30||68||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai har naamai har birahu lagaiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord has implanted a longing for the Lord's Name within me.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa har prabh mit milai sukh paiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: I have met the Lord God, my Best Friend, and I have found peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh dhekh jeevaa meree maiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Beholding my Lord God, I live, O my mother.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: meraa naam sakhaa har bhaiee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my Friend and Brother. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavahu sa(n)t jeeau mere har prabh kere jeeau ||
verses.translation: O Dear Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap gurmukh naam jeeau bhaag vaddere jeeau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O very fortunate ones.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam jeeau praan har mere jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my soul and my breath of life.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: fir bahuR na bhavajal fere jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: I shall never again have to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਖਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiau har prabh vekhaa merai man tan chaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: How shall I behold my Lord God? My mind and body yearn for Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har melahu sa(n)t jeeau man lagaa bhaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints; my mind is in love with Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee paieeaai har preetam raau jeeau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the Sovereign Lord, my Beloved.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee jap naau jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: O very fortunate ones, chant the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan vaddaRee govi(n)dh prabh aasaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Within my mind and body, there is such a great longing for God, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har melahu sa(n)t jeeau govidh prabh paasaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints. God, the Lord of the Universe, is so close to me.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur mat naam sadhaa paragaasaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Naam is always revealed;

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਿਅੜੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੧॥੬੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanak pooriaRee man aasaa jeeau ||4||5||31||69||
verses.translation: the desires of servant Nanak's mind have been fulfilled. ||4||5||31||69||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa birahee naam milai taa jeevaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: If I receive my Love, the Naam, then I live.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man a(n)dhar a(n)mrit gurmat har leevaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the temple of the mind, is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, we drink it in.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man har ra(n)g rataRaa har ras sadhaa peevaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: My mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. I continually drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har paiaRaa man jeevaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: I have found the Lord within my mind, and so I live. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan prem lagaa har baan jeeau ||
verses.translation: The arrow of the Lord's Love has pierced by mind and body.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa preetam mitr har purakh sujaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Primal Being, is All-knowing; He is my Beloved and my Best Friend.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur mele sa(n)t har sughaR sujaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Saintly Guru has united me with the All-knowing and All-seeing Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau naam viTahu kurabaan jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau har har sajan har meet dhasaiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: I seek my Lord, Har, Har, my Intimate, my Best Friend.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਸਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਪਵਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har dhasahu sa(n)tahu jee har khoj pavaiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Show me the way to the Lord, Dear Saints; I am searching all over for Him.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur tuThaRaa dhase har paiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Kind and Compassionate True Guru has shown me the Way, and I have found the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har naame naam samaiee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Name of the Lord, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai vedhan prem har birahu lagaiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: I am consumed with the pain of separation from the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur saradhaa poor a(n)mrit mukh paiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has fulfilled my desire, and I have received the Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har hoh dhiaal har naam dhiaaiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord has become merciful, and now I meditate on the Name of the Lord.

verses.translit: jan naanak har ras paiee jeeau ||4||6||20||18||32||70||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||6||20||18||32||70||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa raag gauRee guaareree chaupadhe
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla, Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kin bidh kusal hot mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: How can happiness be found, O my Siblings of Destiny?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiau paieeaai har raam sahaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How can the Lord, our Help and Support, be found? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kusal na gireh meree sabh maiaa ||
verses.translation: There is no happiness in owning one's own home, in all of Maya,

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: uooche ma(n)dhar su(n)dhar chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: or in lofty mansions casting beautiful shadows.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jhooThe laalach janam gavaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: In fraud and greed, this human life is being wasted. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: hasatee ghoRe dhekh vigaasaa ||
verses.translation: He is pleased at the sight of his elephants and horses

verses.original: ਲਸਕਰ ਜੋੜੇ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: lasakar joRe neb khavaasaa ||
verses.translation: and his armies assembled, his servants and his soldiers.

verses.original: ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੇ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gal jevaRee haumai ke faasaa ||2||
verses.translation: But the noose of egotism is tightening around his neck. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: raaj kamaavai dheh dhis saaree ||
verses.translation: His rule may extend in all ten directions;

verses.original: ਮਾਣੈ ਰੰਗ ਭੋਗ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maanai ra(n)g bhog bahu naaree ||
verses.translation: he may revel in pleasures, and enjoy many women

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau narapat supanai bhekhaaree ||3||
verses.translation: - but he is just a beggar, who in his dream, is a king. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ek kusal mo kau satiguroo bataiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has shown me that there is only one pleasure.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har jo kichh kare su har kiaa bhagataa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord does, is pleasing to the Lord's devotee.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak haumai maar samaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has abolished his ego, and he is absorbed in the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ein bidh kusal hot mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: This is the way to find happiness, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: eiau paieeaai har raam sahaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||
verses.translation: This is the way to find the Lord, our Help and Support. ||1||Second Pause||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiau bhrameeaai bhram kis kaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: Why do you doubt? What do you doubt?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa jal thal maheeal raviaa soiee ||
verses.translation: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ubare manmukh pat khoiee ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis raakhai aap raam dhiaaraa ||
verses.translation: One who is protected by the Merciful Lord

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis nahee dhoojaa ko pahuchanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - no one else can rival him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh varatai ek ana(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The Infinite One is pervading among all.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਉ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: taa too(n) sukh soau hoi achi(n)taa ||
verses.translation: So sleep in peace, and don't worry.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: oh sabh kichh jaanai jo varata(n)taa ||2||
verses.translation: He knows everything which happens. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਜਿਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mue jin dhoojee piaasaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are dying in the thirst of duality.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਹਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahu jonee bhaveh dhur kirat likhiaasaa ||
verses.translation: They wander lost through countless incarnations; this is their pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਖਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaisaa beejeh taisaa khaasaa ||3||
verses.translation: As they plant, so shall they harvest. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh dharas man bhiaa vigaasaa ||
verses.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision, my mind has blossomed forth.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh nadharee aaiaa braham paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: And now everywhere I look, God is revealed to me.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kee har pooran aasaa ||4||2||71||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak's hopes have been fulfilled by the Lord. ||4||2||71||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਭਏ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiee janam bhe keeT pata(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: In so many incarnations, you were a worm and a moth;

verses.original: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਗਜ ਮੀਨ ਕੁਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiee janam gaj meen kura(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: in so many incarnations, you were an elephant, a fish and a deer.

verses.original: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਰਪ ਹੋਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kiee janam pa(n)khee sarap hoio ||
verses.translation: In so many incarnations, you were a bird and a snake.

verses.original: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਹੈਵਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਖ ਜੋਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kiee janam haivar birakh joio ||1||
verses.translation: In so many incarnations, you were yoked as an ox and a horse. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil jagadhees milan kee bareeaa ||
verses.translation: Meet the Lord of the Universe - now is the time to meet Him.

verses.original: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਇਹ ਦੇਹ ਸੰਜਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chira(n)kaal ieh dheh sa(n)jareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: After so very long, this human body was fashioned for you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਸੈਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiee janam sail gir kariaa ||
verses.translation: In so many incarnations, you were rocks and mountains;

verses.original: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਗਰਭ ਹਿਰਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiee janam garabh hir khariaa ||
verses.translation: in so many incarnations, you were aborted in the womb;

verses.original: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਸਾਖ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiee janam saakh kar upaiaa ||
verses.translation: in so many incarnations, you developed branches and leaves;

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh jon bhramaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: you wandered through 8.4 million incarnations. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g bhio janam paraapat ||
verses.translation: Through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you obtained this human life.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar sevaa bhaj har har gurmat ||
verses.translation: Do seva - selfless service; follow the Guru's Teachings, and vibrate the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tiaag maan jhooTh abhimaan ||
verses.translation: Abandon pride, falsehood and arrogance.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeevat mareh dharageh paravaan ||3||
verses.translation: Remain dead while yet alive, and you shall be welcomed in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh hoaa su tujh te hog ||
verses.translation: Whatever has been, and whatever shall be, comes from You, Lord.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: avar na dhoojaa karanai jog ||
verses.translation: No one else can do anything at all.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa mileeaai jaa laih milai ||
verses.translation: We are united with You, when You unite us with Yourself.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak har har gun gai ||4||3||72||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||72||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੋਅਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: karam bhoom meh boahu naam ||
verses.translation: In the field of karma, plant the seed of the Naam.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hoi tumaaraa kaam ||
verses.translation: Your works shall be brought to fruition.

verses.original: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: fal paaveh miTai jam traas ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain these fruits, and the fear of death shall be dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nit gaaveh har har gun jaas ||1||
verses.translation: Sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam a(n)tar ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Keep the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, enshrined in your heart,

verses.original: ਸੀਘਰ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: seeghar kaaraj leh savaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and your affairs shall be quickly resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਸਾਵਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: apane prabh siau hoh saavadhaan ||
verses.translation: Be always attentive to your God;

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: taa too(n) dharageh paaveh maan ||
verses.translation: thus you shall be honored in His Court.

verses.original: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aukat siaanap sagalee tiaag ||
verses.translation: Give up all your clever tricks and devices,

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee charanee laag ||2||
verses.translation: and hold tight to the Feet of the Saints. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਹਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jeea heh jaa kai haath ||
verses.translation: The One, who holds all creatures in His Hands,

verses.original: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: kadhe na vichhuRai sabh kai saath ||
verses.translation: is never separated from them; He is with them all.

verses.original: ਉਪਾਵ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
verses.translit: aupaav chhodd gahu tis kee oT ||
verses.translation: Abandon your clever devices, and grasp hold of His Support.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nimakh maeh hovai teree chhoT ||3||
verses.translation: In an instant, you shall be saved. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa nikaT kar tis no jaan ||
verses.translation: Know that He is always near at hand.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee aagiaa sat kar maan ||
verses.translation: Accept the Order of God as True.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan miTaavahu aap ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, eradicate selfishness and conceit.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੩॥
verses.translit: har har naam naanak jap jaap ||4||4||73||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||4||73||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa bachan sadhaa abinaasee ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word is eternal and everlasting.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan kaTee jam faasee ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word cuts away the noose of Death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa bachan jeea kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word is always with the soul.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan rachai raam kai ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, one is immersed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo gur dheeaa su man kai kaam ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Guru gives, is useful to the mind.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa keeaa sat kar maan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Saint does - accept that as True. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਟਲ ਅਛੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa bachan aTal achhedh ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word is infallible and unchanging.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan kaTe bhram bhedh ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, doubt and prejudice are dispelled.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa bachan katahu na jai ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word never goes away;

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan har ke gun gai ||2||
verses.translation: through the Guru's Word, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa bachan jeea kai saath ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word accompanies the soul.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa bachan anaath ko naath ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word is the Master of the masterless.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan narak na pavai ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word saves one from falling into hell.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan rasanaa a(n)mrit ravai ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, the tongue savors the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa bachan paragaT sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word is revealed in the world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan na aavai haar ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, no one suffers defeat.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੪॥
verses.translit: jis jan hoe aap kirapaal || naanak satigur sadhaa dhiaal ||4||5||74||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru is always kind and compassionate, unto those whom the Lord Himself has blessed with His Mercy. ||4||5||74||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin keetaa maaTee te ratan ||
verses.translation: He makes jewels out of the dust,

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: garabh meh raakhiaa jin kar jatan ||
verses.translation: and He managed to preserve you in the womb.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin dheenee sobhaa vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: He has given you fame and greatness;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis prabh kau aaTh pahar dhiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: meditate on that God, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਮਈਆ ਰੇਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: ramieeaa ren saadh jan paavau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil apunaa khasam dhiaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮੂੜ ਤੇ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin keetaa mooR te bakataa ||
verses.translation: He transformed me, the fool, into a fine speaker,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਬੇਸੁਰਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin keetaa besurat te surataa ||
verses.translation: and He made the unconscious become conscious;

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis parasaadh navai nidh paiee ||
verses.translation: by His Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so prabh man te bisarat naahee ||2||
verses.translation: May I never forget that God from my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin dheeaa nithaave kau thaan ||
verses.translation: He has given a home to the homeless;

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin dheeaa nimaane kau maan ||
verses.translation: He has given honor to the dishonored.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin keenee sabh pooran aasaa ||
verses.translation: He has fulfilled all desires;

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: simarau dhin rain saas giraasaa ||3||
verses.translation: remember Him in meditation, day and night, with every breath and every morsel of food. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲਕ ਕਾਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis prasaadh maiaa silak kaaTee ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, the bonds of Maya are cut away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh a(n)mrit bikh khaaTee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the bitter poison has become Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak is te kichh naahee ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I cannot do anything;

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੫॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaare kau saalaahee ||4||6||75||
verses.translation: I praise the Lord, the Protector. ||4||6||75||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee saran naahee bhau sog ||
verses.translation: In His Sanctuary, there is no fear or sorrow.

verses.original: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aus te baahar kachhoo na hog ||
verses.translation: Without Him, nothing at all can be done.

verses.original: ਤਜੀ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tajee siaanap bal budh bikaar ||
verses.translation: I have renounced clever tricks, power and intellectual corruption.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaas apane kee raakhanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: God is the Protector of His servant. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: jap man mere raam raam ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, Raam, Raam, with love.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghar baahar terai sadh sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Within your home, and beyond it, He is always with you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee Tek manai meh raakh ||
verses.translation: Keep His Support in your mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mirat ras chaakh ||
verses.translation: Taste the ambrosial essence, the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: avar jatan kahahu kaun kaaj ||
verses.translation: Of what use are other efforts?

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਜ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa raakhai aap laaj ||2||
verses.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself protects our honor. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa maanukh kahahu kiaa jor ||
verses.translation: What is the human? What power does he have?

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa maiaa kaa sabh sor ||
verses.translation: All the tumult of Maya is false.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavanahaar suaamee ||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master is the One who acts, and causes others to act.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sagal ghaTaa ke a(n)tarajaamee ||3||
verses.translation: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa sukh saachaa eh ||
verses.translation: Of all comforts, this is the true comfort.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes manai meh leh ||
verses.translation: Keep the Guru's Teachings in your mind.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau raam naam liv laagee ||
verses.translation: Those who bear love for the Name of the Lord

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੭੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak so dha(n)n vaddabhaagee ||4||7||76||
verses.translation: - says Nanak, they are blessed, and very fortunate. ||4||7||76||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਉਤਾਰੀ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun har kathaa utaaree mail ||
verses.translation: Listening to the Lord's sermon, my pollution has been washed away.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਸੁਖ ਸੈਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa puneet bhe sukh sail ||
verses.translation: I have become totally pure, and I now walk in peace.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag paiaa saadhasa(n)g ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham siau laago ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: I have fallen in love with the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਜਨੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japat jan taario ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His servant has been carried across.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: agan saagar gur paar utaario ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has lifted me up and carried me across the ocean of fire. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar keeratan man seetal bhe ||
verses.translation: Singing the Kirtan of His Praises, my mind has become peaceful;

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh ge ||
verses.translation: the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪੇਖੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nidhaan pekhe man maeh ||
verses.translation: I have seen all the treasures within my own mind;

verses.original: ਅਬ ਢੂਢਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ab ddooddan kaahe kau jaeh ||2||
verses.translation: why should I now go out searching for them? ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apune jab bhe dhiaal ||
verses.translation: When God Himself becomes merciful,

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਸੇਵਕ ਘਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hoiee sevak ghaal ||
verses.translation: the work of His servant becomes perfect.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaT ke'ee apane dhaas ||
verses.translation: He has cut away my bonds, and made me His slave.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: simar simar simar gunataas ||3||
verses.translation: Remember, remember, remember Him in meditation; He is the treasure of excellence. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eko man eko sabh Thai ||
verses.translation: He alone is in the mind; He alone is everywhere.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahio sabh jai ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai sabh bharam chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has dispelled all doubts.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੭੭॥
verses.translit: har simarat naanak sukh paiaa ||4||8||77||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak has found peace. ||4||8||77||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਗਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਸਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: agale mue s paachhai pare ||
verses.translation: Those who have died have been forgotten.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਕੁ ਖਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo ubare se ba(n)dh lak khare ||
verses.translation: Those who survive have fastened their belts.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਧੰਧੇ ਮਹਿ ਓਇ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dha(n)dhe meh oi lapaTaae ||
verses.translation: They are busily occupied in their affairs;

verses.original: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣ ਦਿੜੀ ਉਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aun te dhugun dhiRee un maae ||1||
verses.translation: they cling twice as hard to Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਛੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: oh belaa kachh cheet na aavai ||
verses.translation: No one thinks of the time of death;

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਾਹੂ ਲਪਟਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: binas jai taahoo lapaTaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: people grasp to hold that which shall pass away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ba(n)dhee moorakh dheh ||
verses.translation: The fools - their bodies are bound down by desires.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਅਸਨੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lapaTio asaneh ||
verses.translation: They are mired in sexual desire, anger and attachment;

verses.original: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੋ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sir uoopar Thaaddo dharam rai ||
verses.translation: the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands over their heads.

verses.original: ਮੀਠੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meeThee kar kar bikhiaa khai ||2||
verses.translation: Believing it to be sweet, the fools eat poison. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ ਹਉ ਸਾਧਉ ਬੈਰੁ ॥ ਹਮਰੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਘਾਲੈ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau ba(n)dhau hau saadhau bair || hamaree bhoom kaun ghaalai pair ||
verses.translation: They say, ""I shall tie up my enemy, and I shall cut him down. Who dares to set foot upon my land?

verses.original: ਹਉ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau pa(n)ddit hau chatur siaanaa ||
verses.translation: I am learned, I am clever and wise.""

verses.original: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karanaihaar na bujhai bigaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: The ignorant ones do not recognize their Creator. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: apunee gat mit aape jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself knows His Own state and condition.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ko kahai kiaa aakh vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: What can anyone say? How can anyone describe Him?

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit jit laaveh tit tit laganaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever He attaches us to - to that we are attached.

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੂ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: apanaa bhalaa sabh kaahoo ma(n)ganaa ||4||
verses.translation: Everyone begs for their own good. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh teraa too(n) karanaihaar ||
verses.translation: Everything is Yours; You are the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t naahee kichh paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: You have no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas apane kau dheejai dhaan ||
verses.translation: Please give this gift to Your servant,

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੫॥੯॥੭੮॥
verses.translit: kabahoo na visarai naanak naam ||5||9||78||
verses.translation: that Nanak might never forget the Naam. ||5||9||78||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਛੁਟਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: anik jatan nahee hot chhuTaaraa ||
verses.translation: By all sorts of efforts, people do not find salvation.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਆਗਲ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahut siaanap aagal bhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through clever tricks, the weight is only piled on more and more.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: har kee sevaa niramal het ||
verses.translation: Serving the Lord with a pure heart,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh kee dharageh sobhaa set ||1||
verses.translation: you shall be received with honor at God's Court. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਓਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: man mere gahu har naam kaa olaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤੁਝੈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾਤਾ ਝੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tujhai na laagai taataa jholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The hot winds shall never even touch you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bohith bhai saagar maeh ||
verses.translation: Like a boat in the ocean of fear;

verses.original: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੀਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhakaar dheepak dheepaeh ||
verses.translation: like a lamp which illumines the darkness;

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਸੀਤ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਸਿ ਦੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: agan seet kaa laahas dhookh ||
verses.translation: like fire which takes away the pain of cold

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੂਖ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam japat man hovat sookh ||2||
verses.translation: - just so, chanting the Name, the mind becomes peaceful. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: autar jai tere man kee piaas ||
verses.translation: The thirst of your mind shall be quenched,

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hovai sagalee aas ||
verses.translation: and all hopes shall be fulfilled.

verses.original: ਡੋਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: ddolai naahee tumaraa cheet ||
verses.translation: Your consciousness shall not waver.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam jap gurmukh meet ||3||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam as Gurmukh, O my friend. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam aaukhadh soiee jan paavai ||
verses.translation: He alone receives the panacea, the medicine of the Naam,

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jis aap dhivaavai ||
verses.translation: unto whom the Lord, in His Grace, bestows it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam jaa kai hiradhai vasai ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਸੈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੭੯॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh teh naanak nasai ||4||10||79||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, his pains and sorrows are eliminated. ||4||10||79||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
