verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahut dharab kar man na aghaanaa ||
verses.translation: Even with vast sums of wealth, the mind is not satisfied.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: anik roop dhekh neh pateeaanaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon countless beauties, the man is not satisfied.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਜਾਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr urajhio jaan meree ||
verses.translation: He is so involved with his wife and sons - he believes that they belong to him.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਓਇ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: oh binasai oi bhasamai dderee ||1||
verses.translation: That wealth shall pass away, and those relatives shall be reduced to ashes. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: bin har bhajan dhekhau bilalaate ||
verses.translation: Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, they are crying out in pain.

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag tan dhirag dhan maiaa sa(n)g raate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Their bodies are cursed, and their wealth is cursed - they are imbued with Maya. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਦਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bigaaree kai sir dheejeh dhaam ||
verses.translation: The servant carries the bags of money on his head,

verses.original: ਓਇ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਉਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: oi khasamai kai gireh un dhookh sahaam ||
verses.translation: but it goes to his master's house, and he receives only pain.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਤ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau supanai hoi baisat raajaa ||
verses.translation: The man sits as a king in his dreams,

verses.original: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਸਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਕਾਜਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: netr pasaarai taa niraarath kaajaa ||2||
verses.translation: but when he opens his eyes, he sees that it was all in vain. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਾ ਖੇਤ ਊਪਰਿ ਪਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jiau raakhaa khet uoopar paraae ||
verses.translation: The watchman oversees the field of another,

verses.original: ਖੇਤੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: khet khasam kaa raakhaa uTh jaae ||
verses.translation: but the field belongs to his master, while he must get up and depart.

verses.original: ਉਸੁ ਖੇਤ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਾ ਕੜੈ ॥
verses.translit: aus khet kaaran raakhaa kaRai ||
verses.translation: He works so hard, and suffers for that field,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪੜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis kai paalai kachhoo na paRai ||3||
verses.translation: but still, nothing comes into his hands. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa raaj tisai kaa supanaa ||
verses.translation: The dream is His, and the kingdom is His;

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin maiaa dheenee tin laiee tirasanaa ||
verses.translation: He who has given the wealth of Maya, has infused the desire for it.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਬਿਨਾਹੇ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap binaahe aap kare raas ||
verses.translation: He Himself annihilates, and He Himself restores.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੮੦॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh aagai aradhaas ||4||11||80||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to God. ||4||11||80||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: bahu ra(n)g maiaa bahu bidh pekhee ||
verses.translation: I have gazed upon the many forms of Maya, in so many ways.

verses.original: ਕਲਮ ਕਾਗਦ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਲੇਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: kalam kaagadh siaanap lekhee ||
verses.translation: With pen and paper, I have written clever things.

verses.original: ਮਹਰ ਮਲੂਕ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਖਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: mahar malook hoi dhekhiaa khaan ||
verses.translation: I have seen what it is to be a chief, a king, and an emperor,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa te naahee man tirapataan ||1||
verses.translation: but they do not satisfy the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: so sukh mo kau sa(n)t bataavahu ||
verses.translation: Show me that peace, O Saints,

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa boojhai man tirapataavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: which will quench my thirst and satisfy my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਸੁ ਪਵਨ ਹਸਤਿ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: as pavan hasat asavaaree ||
verses.translation: You may have horses as fast as the wind, elephants to ride on,

verses.original: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: choaa cha(n)dhan sej su(n)dhar naaree ||
verses.translation: sandalwood oil, and beautiful women in bed,

verses.original: ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਆਖਾਰੇ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naT naaTik aakhaare gaiaa ||
verses.translation: actors in dramas, singing in theaters

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa meh man sa(n)tokh na paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: - but even with them, the mind does not find contentment. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਖਤੁ ਸਭਾ ਮੰਡਨ ਦੋਲੀਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: takhat sabhaa ma(n)ddan dholeeche ||
verses.translation: You may have a throne at the royal court, with beautiful decorations and soft carpets,

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮੇਵੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਾਗੀਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal meve su(n)dhar baageeche ||
verses.translation: all sorts of luscious fruits and beautiful gardens,

verses.original: ਆਖੇੜ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aakheR birat raajan kee leelaa ||
verses.translation: the excitement of the chase and princely pleasures

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਹੀਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man na suhelaa parapa(n)ch heelaa ||3||
verses.translation: - but still, the mind is not made happy by such illusory diversions. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa sa(n)tan sach kahiaa ||
verses.translation: In their kindness, the Saints have told me of the True One,

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਇਹੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh ih aana(n)dh lahiaa ||
verses.translation: and so I have obtained all comforts and joy.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g har keeratan gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak vaddabhaagee paieeaai ||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, through great good fortune, I have found this. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai har dhan soiee suhelaa ||
verses.translation: One who obtains the wealth of the Lord becomes happy.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥੮੧॥
verses.translit: prabh kirapaa te saadhasa(n)g melaa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||12||81||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat. ||1||Second Pause||12||81||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: praanee jaanai ih tan meraa ||
verses.translation: The mortal claims this body as his own.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਲਪਟੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahur bahur uaahoo lapaTeraa ||
verses.translation: Again and again, he clings to it.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਕਾ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr girasat kaa faasaa ||
verses.translation: He is entangled with his children, his wife and household affairs.

verses.original: ਹੋਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hon na paieeaai raam ke dhaasaa ||1||
verses.translation: He cannot be the slave of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kavan su bidh jit raam gun gai ||
verses.translation: What is that way, by which the Lord's Praises might be sung?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kavan su mat jit tarai ieh mai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What is that intellect, by which this person might swim across, O mother? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਭਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo bhalaiee so buraa jaanai ||
verses.translation: That which is for his own good, he thinks is evil.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: saach kahai so bikhai samaanai ||
verses.translation: If someone tells him the truth, he looks upon that as poison.

verses.original: ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਤ ਅਰੁ ਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaanai naahee jeet ar haar ||
verses.translation: He cannot tell victory from defeat.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਵਲੇਵਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eih valevaa saakat sa(n)saar ||2||
verses.translation: This is the way of life in the world of the faithless cynic. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਲਾਹਲ ਸੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo halaahal so peevai bauraa ||
verses.translation: The demented fool drinks in the deadly poison,

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਉਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam jaanai kar kauraa ||
verses.translation: while he believes the Ambrosial Naam to be bitter.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g kai naahee ner ||
verses.translation: He does not even approach the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਫੇਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh bhramataa fer ||3||
verses.translation: he wanders lost through 8.4 million incarnations. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕੈ ਜਾਲਿ ਫਹਾਏ ਪੰਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: ekai jaal fahaae pa(n)khee ||
verses.translation: The birds are caught in the net of Maya;

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: ras ras bhog kareh bahu ra(n)gee ||
verses.translation: immersed in the pleasures of love, they frolic in so many ways.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੮੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jis bhe kirapaal || gur poorai taa ke kaaTe jaal ||4||13||82||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Perfect Guru has cut away the noose from those, unto whom the Lord has shown His Mercy. ||4||13||82||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: tau kirapaa te maarag paieeaai ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, we find the Way.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kirapaa te naam dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kirapaa te ba(n)dhan chhuTai ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, we are released from our bondage.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau kirapaa te haumai tuTai ||1||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, egotism is eradicated. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਲਾਗਹ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: tum laavahu tau laageh sev ||
verses.translation: As You assign me, so I take to Your service.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham te kachhoo na hovai dhev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By myself, I cannot do anything at all, O Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗਾਵਾ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai taa gaavaa baanee ||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, then I sing the Word of Your Bani.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai taa sach vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, then I speak the Truth.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai taa satigur miaa ||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, then the True Guru showers His Mercy upon me.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa prabh teree dhiaa ||2||
verses.translation: All peace comes by Your Kindness, God. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai so niramal karamaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You is a pure action of karma.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai so sach dharamaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You is the true faith of Dharma.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nidhaan gun tum hee paas ||
verses.translation: The treasure of all excellence is with You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too(n) saahib sevak aradhaas ||3||
verses.translation: Your servant prays to You, O Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal hoi har ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The mind and body become immaculate through the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa paavau satasa(n)g ||
verses.translation: All peace is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam terai rahai man raataa ||
verses.translation: My mind remains attuned to Your Name;

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੮੩॥
verses.translit: eih kaliaan naanak kar jaataa ||4||14||83||
verses.translation: Nanak affirms this as his greatest pleasure. ||4||14||83||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਜੇਤੇ ਤੈ ਚਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: aan rasaa jete tai chaakhe ||
verses.translation: You may taste the other flavors,

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh na tirasanaa teree laathe ||
verses.translation: but your thirst shall not depart, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ras kaa too(n) chaakheh saadh ||
verses.translation: If you taste the sweet flavor of the Lord's sublime essence

verses.original: ਚਾਖਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chaakhat hoi raheh bisamaadh ||1||
verses.translation: - upon tasting it, you shall be wonder-struck and amazed. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਉ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit rasanaa peeau piaaree ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved tongue, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eeh ras raatee hoi tirapataaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Imbued with this sublime essence, you shall be satisfied. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹੇ ਜਿਹਵੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: he jihave too(n) raam gun gaau ||
verses.translation: O tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh nimakh har har har dhiaau ||
verses.translation: Each and every moment, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aan na suneeaai katahoo(n) jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Do not listen to any other, and do not go anywhere else.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat vaddabhaagee paieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, you shall find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਹਵੇ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਗਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar jihave aaraadh || paarabraham Thaakur aagaadh ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, O tongue, dwell upon God, the Unfathomable, Supreme Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa uoohaa sadhaa suhelee ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, you shall be happy forever.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਰਸਨ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavat rasan amolee ||3||
verses.translation: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O tongue, you shall become priceless. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਪੇਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: banasapat maulee fal ful pedde ||
verses.translation: All the vegetation will blossom forth for you, flowering in fruition;

verses.original: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: eeh ras raatee bahur na chhodde ||
verses.translation: imbued with this sublime essence, you shall never leave it again.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਨ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aan na ras kas lavai na laiee ||
verses.translation: No other sweet and tasty flavors can compare to it.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur bhe hai sahaiee ||4||15||84||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has become my Support. ||4||15||84||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man ma(n)dhar tan saajee baar ||
verses.translation: The mind is the temple, and the body is the fence built around it.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਧੇ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eis hee madhe basat apaar ||
verses.translation: The infinite substance is within it.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: eis hee bheetar suneeat saahu ||
verses.translation: Within it, the great merchant is said to dwell.

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਬਾਪਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਊਹਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kavan baapaaree jaa kaa uoohaa visaahu ||1||
verses.translation: Who is the trader who deals there? ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan ko ko biauhaaree ||
verses.translation: How rare is that trader who deals in the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat bhojan kare aahaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He takes the Ambrosial Nectar as his food. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arapee sev kareejai ||
verses.translation: He dedicates his mind and body to serving the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan su jugat jit kar bheejai ||
verses.translation: How can we please the Lord?

verses.original: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਤਜਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: pai lagau taj meraa terai ||
verses.translation: I fall at His Feet, and I renounce all sense of 'mine and yours'.

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kavanu su jan jo saudhaa jorai ||2||
verses.translation: Who can settle this bargain? ||2||

verses.original: ਮਹਲੁ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: mahal saeh kaa kin bidh paavai ||
verses.translation: How can I attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan su bidh jit bheetar bulaavai ||
verses.translation: How can I get Him to call me inside?

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) vadd saahu jaa ke koT vanajaare ||
verses.translation: You are the Great Merchant; You have millions of traders.

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਲੇ ਸੰਚਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kavanu su dhaataa le sa(n)chaare ||3||
verses.translation: Who is the benefactor? Who can take me to Him? ||3||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat nij ghar paiaa ||
verses.translation: Seeking and searching, I have found my own home, deep within my own being.

verses.original: ਅਮੋਲ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: amol ratan saach dhikhalaiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord has shown me the priceless jewel.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਬ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jab mele saeh ||
verses.translation: When the Great Merchant shows His Mercy, He blends us into Himself.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵੇਸਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੮੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur kai vesaeh ||4||16||85||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, place your faith in the Guru. ||4||16||85||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee mahalaa panjavaa guaareree ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehla, Gwaarayree:

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: rain dhinas rahai ik ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they remain in the Love of the One.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau jaanai sadh hee sa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: They know that God is always with them.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਓ ਉਨਿ ਵਰਤਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur naam keeo un varatan ||
verses.translation: They make the Name of their Lord and Master their way of life;

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tirapat aghaavan har kai dharasan ||1||
verses.translation: they are satisfied and fulfilled with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g raate man tan hare ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Love of the Lord, their minds and bodies are rejuvenated,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee saranee pare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: entering the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਆਤਮ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal aatam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Support of the soul.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਹਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ek nihaareh aagiaakaar ||
verses.translation: They see only the One, and obey His Order.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eko banaj eko biauhaaree ||
verses.translation: There is only one trade, and one occupation.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: avar na jaaneh bin nira(n)kaaree ||2||
verses.translation: They know no other than the Formless Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog dhuhahoo(n) te mukate ||
verses.translation: They are free of both pleasure and pain.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਜੁਗਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa alipat jog ar jugate ||
verses.translation: They remain unattached, joined to the Lord's Way.

verses.original: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: dheeseh sabh meh sabh te rahate ||
verses.translation: They are seen among all, and yet they are distinct from all.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਓਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਤੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paarabraham kaa oi dhiaan dharate ||3||
verses.translation: They focus their meditation on the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kee mahimaa kavan vakhaanau ||
verses.translation: How can I describe the Glories of the Saints?

verses.original: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: agaadh bodh kichh mit nahee jaanau ||
verses.translation: Their knowledge is unfathomable; their limits cannot be known.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham moh kirapaa keejai ||
verses.translation: O Supreme Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon me.

verses.original: ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੮੬॥
verses.translit: dhoor sa(n)tan kee naanak dheejai ||4||17||86||
verses.translation: Bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||17||86||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meraa sakhaa too(n)hee meraa meet ||
verses.translation: You are my Companion; You are my Best Friend.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meraa preetam tum sa(n)g heet ||
verses.translation: You are my Beloved; I am in love with You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meree pat toohai meraa gahanaa ||
verses.translation: You are my honor; You are my decoration.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਮਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tujh bin nimakh na jaiee rahanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) mere laalan too(n) mere praan ||
verses.translation: You are my Intimate Beloved, You are my breath of life.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) mere saahib too(n) mere khaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my Lord and Master; You are my Leader. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau tum raakhahu tiv hee rahanaa ||
verses.translation: As You keep me, so do I survive.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo tum kahahu soiee moh karanaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever You say, that is what I do.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹਾ ਤੁਮ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh pekhau tahaa tum basanaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see You dwelling.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nirabhau naam japau teraa rasanaa ||2||
verses.translation: O my Fearless Lord, with my tongue, I chant Your Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meree nav nidh too(n) bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: You are my nine treasures, You are my storehouse.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਰਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g rasaa too(n) maneh adhaar ||
verses.translation: I am imbued with Your Love; You are the Support of my mind.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meree sobhaa tum sa(n)g racheeaa ||
verses.translation: You are my Glory; I am blended with You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too(n) meree oT too(n) hai meraa takeeaa ||3||
verses.translation: You are my Shelter; You are my Anchoring Support. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar tuhee dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.

verses.original: ਮਰਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maram tumaaraa gur te paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained Your secret from the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te dhiraRiaa ik ekai ||
verses.translation: Through the True Guru, the One and only Lord was implanted within me;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੭॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas har har har Tekai ||4||18||87||
verses.translation: servant Nanak has taken to the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||18||87||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat harakh sog bisathaar ||
verses.translation: It torments us with the expression of pleasure and pain.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat surag narak avataar ||
verses.translation: It torments us through incarnations in heaven and hell.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਧਨ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat dhan niradhan pekh sobhaa ||
verses.translation: It is seen to afflict the rich, the poor and the glorious.

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਬਿਆਧੀ ਬਿਆਪਸਿ ਲੋਭਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mool biaadhee biaapas lobhaa ||1||
verses.translation: The source of this illness which torments us is greed. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa biaapat bahu parakaaree ||
verses.translation: Maya torments us in so many ways.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t jeeveh prabh oT tumaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But the Saints live under Your Protection, God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat aha(n)budh kaa maataa ||
verses.translation: It torments us through intoxication with intellectual pride.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat putr kalatr sa(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: It torments us through the love of children and spouse.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਹਸਤਿ ਘੋੜੇ ਅਰੁ ਬਸਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat hasat ghoRe ar basataa ||
verses.translation: It torments us through elephants, horses and beautiful clothes.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਰੂਪ ਜੋਬਨ ਮਦ ਮਸਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: biaapat roop joban madh masataa ||2||
verses.translation: It torments us through the intoxication of wine and the beauty of youth. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਕ ਅਰੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat bhoom ra(n)k ar ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: It torments landlords, paupers and lovers of pleasure.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat geet naadh sun sa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: It torments us through the sweet sounds of music and parties.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਸੇਜ ਮਹਲ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat sej mahal seegaar ||
verses.translation: It torments us through beautiful beds, palaces and decorations.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅੰਧਿਆਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhoot biaapat a(n)dhiaar ||3||
verses.translation: It torments us through the darkness of the five evil passions. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਹਉ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat karam karai hau faasaa ||
verses.translation: It torments those who act, entangled in ego.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਪਤਿ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: biaapat girasat biaapat udhaasaa ||
verses.translation: It torments us through household affairs, and it torments us in renunciation.

verses.original: ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਇਹ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: aachaar biauhaar biaapat ieh jaat ||
verses.translation: It torments us through character, lifestyle and social status.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh biaapat bin har ra(n)g raat ||4||
verses.translation: It torments us through everything, except for those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan ke ba(n)dhan kaaTe har rai ||
verses.translation: The Sovereign Lord King has cut away the bonds of His Saints.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau kahaa biaapai mai ||
verses.translation: How can Maya torment them?

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੯॥੮੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jin dhoor sa(n)t paiee || taa kai nikaT na aavai maiee ||5||19||88||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, Maya does not draw near those who have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||19||88||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਦ ਪਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: nainahu needh par dhirasaT vikaar ||
verses.translation: The eyes are asleep in corruption, gazing upon the beauty of another.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸੋਏ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sravan soe sun ni(n)dh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The ears are asleep, listening to slanderous stories.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਸੋਈ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa soiee lobh meeThai saadh ||
verses.translation: The tongue is asleep, in its desire for sweet flavors.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man soiaa maiaa bisamaadh ||1||
verses.translation: The mind is asleep, fascinated by Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: eis gireh meh koiee jaagat rahai ||
verses.translation: Those who remain awake in this house are very rare;

verses.original: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਵਸਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saabat vasat oh apanee lahai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: by doing so, they receive the whole thing. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਅਪਨੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: sagal sahelee apanai ras maatee ||
verses.translation: All of my companions are intoxicated with their sensory pleasures;

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gireh apune kee khabar na jaatee ||
verses.translation: they do not know how to guard their own home.

verses.original: ਮੁਸਨਹਾਰ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: musanahaar pa(n)ch baTavaare ||
verses.translation: The five thieves have plundered them;

verses.original: ਸੂਨੇ ਨਗਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਠਗਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: soone nagar pare Thagahaare ||2||
verses.translation: the thugs descend upon the unguarded village. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aun te raakhai baap na maiee ||
verses.translation: Our mothers and fathers cannot save us from them;

verses.original: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aun te raakhai meet na bhaiee ||
verses.translation: friends and brothers cannot protect us from them

verses.original: ਦਰਬਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: dharab siaanap naa oi rahate ||
verses.translation: they cannot be restrained by wealth or cleverness.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਓਇ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਤੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g oi dhusaT vas hote ||3||
verses.translation: Only through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, can those villains be brought under control. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa moh saari(n)gapaan ||
verses.translation: Have Mercy upon me, O Lord, Sustainer of the world.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan dhoor sarab nidhaan ||
verses.translation: The dust of the feet of the Saints is all the treasure I need.

verses.original: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: saabat poo(n)jee satigur sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the True Guru, one's investment remains intact.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak jaagai paarabraham kai ra(n)g ||4||
verses.translation: Nanak is awake to the Love of the Supreme Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: so jaagai jis prabh kirapaal ||
verses.translation: He alone is awake, unto whom God shows His Mercy.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨੦॥੮੯॥
verses.translit: eeh poo(n)jee saabat dhan maal ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||20||89||
verses.translation: This investment, wealth and property shall remain intact. ||1||Second Pause||20||89||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਖਾਨ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai vas khaan sulataan ||
verses.translation: Kings and emperors are under His Power.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai vas hai sagal jahaan ||
verses.translation: The whole world is under His Power.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa keeaa sabh kichh hoi ||
verses.translation: Everything is done by His doing;

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis te baahar naahee koi ||1||
verses.translation: other than Him, there is nothing at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kahu bena(n)tee apune satigur paeh ||
verses.translation: Offer your prayers to your True Guru;

verses.original: ਕਾਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaaj tumaare dhei nibaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He will resolve your affairs. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uooch jaa kaa dharabaar ||
verses.translation: The Darbaar of His Court is the most exalted of all.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sagal bhagat jaa kaa naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: His Name is the Support of all His devotees.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪਿਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sarab biaapit pooran dhanee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Master is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kee sobhaa ghaT ghaT banee ||2||
verses.translation: His Glory is manifest in each and every heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat dhukh dderaa ddahai ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, the home of sorrow is abolished.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat jam kichhoo na kahai ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹੋਤ ਸੂਕੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat hot sooke hare ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, the dry branches become green again.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਡੂਬਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis simarat ddoobat paahan tare ||3||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, sinking stones are made to float. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sabhaa kau sadhaa jaikaar ||
verses.translation: I salute and applaud the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam jan praan adhaar ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Support of the breath of life of His servant.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak meree sunee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord has heard my prayer;

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੦॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh mo kau naam nivaas ||4||21||90||
verses.translation: by the Grace of the Saints, I dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||21||90||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dharasan agan nivaaree ||
verses.translation: By the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, the fire of desire is quenched.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTat haumai maaree ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, egotism is subdued.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sa(n)g naahee man ddolai ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the True Guru, the mind does not waver.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee gurmukh bolai ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh speaks the Ambrosial Word of Gurbani. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਾ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag saachaa jaa sach meh raate ||
verses.translation: He sees the True One pervading the whole world; he is imbued with the True One.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: seetal saat gur te prabh jaate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have become cool and tranquil, knowing God, through the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh japai har naau ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, one chants the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh har keeratan gaau ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, one sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਮਿਟੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh sagal dhukh miTe ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, all pains are erased.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh ba(n)dhan te chhuTe ||2||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from bondage. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kirapaa te miTe moh bharam ||
verses.translation: By the kind Mercy of the Saints, emotional attachment and doubt are removed.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਰੇਣ ਮਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: saadh ren majan sabh dharam ||
verses.translation: Taking a bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy - this is true Dharmic faith.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kirapaal dhiaal govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: By the kindness of the Holy, the Lord of the Universe becomes merciful.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhaa meh ieh hamaree ji(n)dh ||3||
verses.translation: The life of my soul is with the Holy. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਬੈਠਣੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidh kirapaal dhiaavau || saadhasa(n)g taa baiThan paavau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Merciful Lord, the Treasure of Mercy, I have obtained a seat in the Saadh Sangat.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun kau prabh keenee dhiaa ||
verses.translation: I am worthless, but God has been kind to me.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੯੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak naam liaa ||4||22||91||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, Nanak has taken to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||22||91||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g japio bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord God.

verses.original: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: keval naam dheeo gur ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ॥
verses.translit: taj abhimaan bhe niravair ||
verses.translation: Shedding my ego, I have become free of hate.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar poojahu gur pair ||1||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship the Guru's Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਬਿਗਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: ab mat binasee dhusaT bigaanee ||
verses.translation: Now, my evil sense of alienation is eliminated,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab te suniaa har jas kaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: since I have heard the Praises of the Lord with my ears. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sookh aana(n)dh nidhaan ||
verses.translation: The Savior Lord is the treasure of intuitive peace, poise and bliss.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaar rakh lei nidhaan ||
verses.translation: He shall save me in the end.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh binase bhai bharam ||
verses.translation: My pains, sufferings, fears and doubts have been erased.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rakhe kar karam ||2||
verses.translation: He has mercifully saved me from coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੇਖੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: pekhai bolai sunai sabh aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself beholds, speaks and hears all.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sa(n)g taa kau man jaap ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the One who is always with you.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh bhio paragaas ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the Light has dawned.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਏਕੈ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: poor rahe ekai gunataas ||3||
verses.translation: The One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is perfectly pervading everywhere. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਣਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: kahat pavitr sunat puneet || gun govi(n)dh gaaveh nit neet ||
verses.translation: Pure are those who speak, and sanctified are those who hear and sing, forever and ever, the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jaa kau hoh kirapaal ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Mercy,

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੨॥
verses.translit: tis jan kee sabh pooran ghaal ||4||23||92||
verses.translation: all one's efforts are fulfilled. ||4||23||92||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੋਲਾਵੈ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan toR bolaavai raam ||
verses.translation: He breaks our bonds, and inspires us to chant the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: man meh laagai saach dhiaan || miTeh kales sukhee hoi raheeaai ||
verses.translation: With the mind centered in meditation on the True Lord, anguish is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaisaa dhaataa satigur kaheeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Such is the True Guru, the Great Giver. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so sukhadhaataa j naam japaavai ||
verses.translation: He alone is the Giver of peace, who inspires us to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa tis sa(n)g milaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, He leads us to merge with Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis hoi dhiaal tis aap milaavai ||
verses.translation: He unites with Himself those unto whom He has shown His Mercy.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nidhaan guroo te paavai ||
verses.translation: All treasures are received from the Guru.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap tiaag miTai aavan jaanaa ||
verses.translation: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, coming and going come to an end.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g paarabraham pachhaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Supreme Lord God is recognized. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: jan uoopar prabh bhe dhiaal ||
verses.translation: God has become merciful to His humble servant.
